relations.name: feya_commerce_v_case_admission_preview_safe_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT s.signal_fingerprint,
    s.signal_code,
    s.signal_type,
    s.signal_scope,
    s.accountable_domain,
    s.priority,
    s.materiality_score,
    s.maturity_state,
    s.case_admission_recommendation,
    c.case_id AS existing_case_id,
    c.case_code AS existing_case_code,
    c.case_status AS existing_case_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.case_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'EXISTING_CASE'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED'::text) THEN 'OWNER_ATTENTION'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'WORK_QUEUE'::text) THEN 'WORK_QUEUE'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'DEFER_UNTIL_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE'::text) THEN 'DEFER'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'MONITOR'::text) THEN 'MONITOR'::text
            WHEN ((s.case_admission_recommendation = 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text) AND (s.priority = ANY (ARRAY['P0'::text, 'P1'::text]))) THEN 'CASE_CANDIDATE'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text) THEN 'WORK_QUEUE'::text
            ELSE 'MONITOR'::text
        END AS admission_decision,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.case_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Signal is already represented by an active Growth Case.'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED'::text) THEN 'Route to Owner Attention Queue; do not create a domain case before the owner decision.'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'WORK_QUEUE'::text) THEN 'Handle in the owning domain work queue; avoid unnecessary Growth Case overhead.'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'DEFER_UNTIL_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE'::text) THEN 'Expected pre-launch gap; create a case only when the related business objective becomes active.'::text
            WHEN (s.case_admission_recommendation = 'MONITOR'::text) THEN 'Observe; current evidence does not justify a case.'::text
            WHEN ((s.case_admission_recommendation = 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text) AND (s.priority = ANY (ARRAY['P0'::text, 'P1'::text]))) THEN 'Material implementation blocker is eligible for an explicit Growth Case.'::text
            ELSE 'Handle as implementation work without automatic case creation.'::text
        END AS admission_reason,
    s.title,
    s.summary,
    s.next_action,
    s.entity_scope_json,
    s.evidence_json,
    s.generated_at
   FROM (feya_commerce_v_growth_signal_candidates_safe_v1 s
     LEFT JOIN feya_growth_cases_v1 c ON (((c.case_fingerprint = s.signal_fingerprint) AND (c.case_status <> ALL (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_content_brief_compiler_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT g.brief_queue_id,
    g.canonical_product_id,
    'content_brief_compiler_v1'::text AS compiler_version,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) THEN 'BLOCKED_PRODUCT_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (g.generation_gate_status ~~ 'BLOCKED_%'::text) THEN 'BLOCKED_GENERATION_GATE'::text
            WHEN ((g.primary_keyword IS NULL) OR (g.plan_status = 'draft_needs_keyword_review'::text)) THEN 'BLOCKED_KEYWORD_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (sp.seo_page_id IS NULL) THEN 'BLOCKED_NO_SEO_PAGE'::text
            WHEN (g.plan_status = 'draft_waiting_metrics'::text) THEN 'SHADOW_READY_WAITING_METRICS'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(own.primary_ownership_count, 0) = 0) THEN 'SHADOW_READY_NEEDS_OSPM_OWNERSHIP'::text
            ELSE 'SHADOW_READY'::text
        END AS compiler_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) THEN false
            WHEN (g.generation_gate_status ~~ 'BLOCKED_%'::text) THEN false
            WHEN ((g.primary_keyword IS NULL) OR (g.plan_status = 'draft_needs_keyword_review'::text)) THEN false
            WHEN (sp.seo_page_id IS NULL) THEN false
            ELSE true
        END AS can_generate_shadow,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) THEN false
            WHEN (g.generation_gate_status ~~ 'BLOCKED_%'::text) THEN false
            WHEN (g.plan_status <> ALL (ARRAY['selected'::text, 'approved'::text])) THEN false
            WHEN (g.primary_keyword IS NULL) THEN false
            WHEN (sp.seo_page_id IS NULL) THEN false
            WHEN (COALESCE(own.primary_ownership_count, 0) = 0) THEN false
            WHEN (sp.indexation_intent <> ALL (ARRAY['candidate'::text, 'indexable'::text])) THEN false
            WHEN (sp.protected_winner_flag IS TRUE) THEN false
            WHEN (policy.config_json IS NULL) THEN false
            ELSE true
        END AS can_produce_canonical_brief,
    g.generation_gate_status,
    g.safe_generation_status,
    p.product_fact_quality_status,
    p.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
    g.plan_status,
    g.primary_keyword,
    g.page_goal_code,
    g.primary_axis_code,
    g.primary_term_code,
    sp.seo_page_id,
    sp.url_path,
    sp.lifecycle_state AS page_lifecycle_state,
    sp.indexation_intent,
    sp.protected_winner_flag,
    COALESCE(own.ownership_count, 0) AS ownership_count,
    COALESCE(own.primary_ownership_count, 0) AS primary_ownership_count,
    COALESCE(bt.business_truth_count, 0) AS business_truth_count,
    COALESCE(bt.business_truth_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS business_truth_json,
    policy.version_no AS content_policy_version,
    jsonb_build_object('brief_contract', 'seo_content_brief.v1-shadow', 'compiler_version', 'content_brief_compiler_v1', 'brief_queue_id', g.brief_queue_id, 'canonical_product_id', g.canonical_product_id, 'target_language', p.target_language, 'page', jsonb_build_object('seo_page_id', sp.seo_page_id, 'page_type', sp.page_type, 'url_path', sp.url_path, 'market_code', sp.market_code, 'locale', sp.locale, 'lifecycle_state', sp.lifecycle_state, 'indexation_intent', sp.indexation_intent, 'protected_winner', sp.protected_winner_flag, 'ownership_count', COALESCE(own.ownership_count, 0), 'primary_ownership_count', COALESCE(own.primary_ownership_count, 0)), 'product', jsonb_build_object('current_title', p.current_title, 'product_type', p.product_type, 'material', p.material, 'normalized_material_primary', p.normalized_material_primary, 'color', p.color, 'normalized_color_primary', p.normalized_color_primary, 'size_mode', p.size_mode, 'fit_type', p.fit_type, 'production_profile', p.production_profile, 'shipping_profile', p.shipping_profile, 'handmade_flag', p.handmade_flag, 'styled_imagery_flag', p.styled_imagery_flag, 'public_media_count', p.public_media_count, 'public_configuration_count', p.public_configuration_count, 'product_fact_quality_status', p.product_fact_quality_status, 'product_fact_warning_codes', p.product_fact_warning_codes_json, 'product_fact_quality', p.product_fact_quality_json), 'strategy_shadow', jsonb_build_object('page_goal_code', g.page_goal_code, 'page_goal_name_ru', g.page_goal_name_ru, 'primary_axis_code', g.primary_axis_code, 'primary_term_code', g.primary_term_code, 'primary_term_name_ru', g.primary_term_name_ru, 'primary_axis_source', g.primary_axis_source, 'primary_dna_canonical_flag', g.primary_dna_canonical_flag, 'target_page_level', g.target_page_level, 'strategy_is_canonical_ownership', false), 'keyword_plan_shadow', jsonb_build_object('plan_status', g.plan_status, 'primary_keyword', g.primary_keyword, 'secondary_keywords', g.secondary_keywords_json, 'supporting_terms', g.supporting_terms_json, 'image_alt_terms', g.image_alt_terms_json, 'blocked_terms', g.blocked_terms_json, 'placement_rules', g.placement_json, 'evidence', g.keyword_evidence_json, 'qa_notes', g.keyword_qa_notes_json, 'is_canonical_query_ownership', false), 'business_truth', COALESCE(bt.business_truth_json, '[]'::jsonb), 'content_policy', COALESCE(policy.config_json, '{}'::jsonb), 'existing_content', COALESCE(p.existing_content_json, '{}'::jsonb), 'legacy_generator_contract', jsonb_build_object('contract_code', contract.contract_code, 'contract_version', contract.contract_version, 'required_fields', contract.required_fields_json, 'length_rules', contract.length_rules_json, 'blocked_claims', contract.blocked_claims_json, 'required_output_schema', contract.required_output_schema_json, 'note', 'Legacy generator contract is retained for compatibility and is not the sole canonical content policy.'), 'compiler_limits', jsonb_build_object('query_ownership_required_for_canonical', true, 'business_truth_active_only', true, 'raw_ai_context_excluded', true, 'generation_notes_excluded', true)) AS compiled_brief_json
   FROM ((((((feya_v_gen_payload_v3_all g
     JOIN feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_generation_payload_safe_v1 p ON ((p.brief_queue_id = g.brief_queue_id)))
     LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_seo_pages_v1 sp ON (((sp.canonical_product_id = g.canonical_product_id) AND (sp.page_type = 'product'::text) AND (sp.portfolio_status = 'active'::text) AND (sp.market_code = 'US'::text) AND (sp.locale = 'en-US'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS ownership_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((o.ownership_role = 'primary'::text) AND (o.ownership_status = ANY (ARRAY['intended'::text, 'active'::text, 'protected'::text])) AND (o.effective_to IS NULL))))::integer AS primary_ownership_count
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1 o
          WHERE ((o.seo_page_id = sp.seo_page_id) AND (o.effective_to IS NULL))) own ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS business_truth_count,
            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('truth_code', b.truth_code, 'truth_type', b.truth_type, 'scope_type', b.scope_type, 'scope_key', b.scope_key, 'locale', b.locale, 'value', b.value_json, 'public_copy', b.public_copy, 'version_no', b.version_no) ORDER BY b.truth_type, b.truth_code), '[]'::jsonb) AS business_truth_json
           FROM feya_commerce_business_truth_v1 b
          WHERE ((b.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (b.valid_to IS NULL) AND (b.locale = p.target_language) AND ((b.scope_type = 'GLOBAL'::text) OR ((b.scope_type = 'PRODUCT'::text) AND (b.scope_key = (g.canonical_product_id)::text)) OR ((b.scope_type = 'PRODUCTION_PROFILE'::text) AND (b.scope_key = p.production_profile)) OR ((b.scope_type = 'SHIPPING_PROFILE'::text) AND (b.scope_key = p.shipping_profile))))) bt ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.version_no,
            r.config_json
           FROM feya_growth_registry_items_v1 r
          WHERE ((r.registry_type = 'policy'::text) AND (r.item_code = 'CONTENT_POLICY_CANONICAL_V1'::text) AND (r.active_flag = true) AND (r.item_state = 'AVAILABLE'::text))
          ORDER BY r.version_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) policy ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.contract_code,
            c.contract_version,
            c.required_fields_json,
            c.length_rules_json,
            c.blocked_claims_json,
            c.required_output_schema_json
           FROM feya_v_seo_brief_contract_active_v1 c
          WHERE ((c.brief_type = p.brief_type) AND (c.target_language = p.target_language))
          ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) contract ON (true));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT d.id AS draft_id,
    d.canonical_product_id,
    d.product_slug,
    pd.card_title,
    d.status AS draft_status,
    d.review_status AS human_review_status,
    d.source_mode,
    d.pack_version,
    d.source_brief_version,
    d.output_contract_version,
    COALESCE((d.metrics_status_snapshot ->> 'status'::text), 'missing'::text) AS metrics_status,
    COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot ->> 'status'::text), 'missing'::text) AS validation_status,
    COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'similarity_cannibalization'::text), 'not_checked'::text) AS similarity_status,
    COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'image_alt_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) AS image_alt_truth_status,
    d.cqa_status,
    d.cqa_policy_version,
    d.cqa_reviewed_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) THEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb))
            ELSE 1
        END AS approval_blocker_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) THEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb))
            ELSE 1
        END AS product_truth_blocker_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ((d.review_status = 'rejected'::text) OR (d.status = 'rejected'::text) OR (d.status = 'changes_requested'::text)) THEN 'REVISION_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN ((d.cqa_status = ANY (ARRAY['pass'::text, 'pass_with_warnings'::text])) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'component_claim_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) <> 'pass'::text)) THEN 'CQA_RECORDED_NEEDS_COMPONENT_CLAIM_CHECK'::text
            WHEN (d.cqa_status = ANY (ARRAY['pass'::text, 'pass_with_warnings'::text])) THEN 'CQA_RECORDED'::text
            WHEN (d.cqa_status = ANY (ARRAY['revision_required'::text, 'domain_review_required'::text, 'reject'::text])) THEN upper(d.cqa_status)
            WHEN ((
            CASE
                WHEN (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) THEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb))
                ELSE 1
            END > 0) OR (
            CASE
                WHEN (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) THEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((d.validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb))
                ELSE 1
            END > 0)) THEN 'BLOCKED_BY_VALIDATION'::text
            WHEN ((d.review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'similarity_cannibalization'::text), 'not_checked'::text) <> 'pass'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED_NEEDS_SIMILARITY_CHECK'::text
            WHEN ((d.review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'image_alt_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) <> 'pass'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED_NEEDS_IMAGE_ALT_CHECK'::text
            WHEN ((d.review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'component_claim_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) <> 'pass'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED_NEEDS_COMPONENT_CLAIM_CHECK'::text
            WHEN (d.review_status = 'approved'::text) THEN 'READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_CQA'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'similarity_cannibalization'::text), 'not_checked'::text) = 'pass'::text) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'image_alt_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) = 'pass'::text) AND (COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'component_claim_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) = 'pass'::text)) THEN 'READY_FOR_HUMAN_AND_CQA_REVIEW'::text
            ELSE 'NEEDS_PRECHECKS'::text
        END AS cqa_shadow_state,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    COALESCE((d.qa_self_report ->> 'component_claim_truth'::text), 'not_checked'::text) AS component_claim_truth_status
   FROM (feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
     LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_product_drafts pd ON ((pd.canonical_product_id = d.canonical_product_id)))
  WHERE (d.archived_at IS NULL);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_growth_signal_candidates_safe_v1
relations.definition:
WITH launch AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.readiness_scope,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.gate_code,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.gate_name,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.gate_status,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.is_blocker,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.summary,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.next_action,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.owner_role,
            feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.evidence_json
           FROM feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2
          WHERE (feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2.gate_status = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCKED'::text, 'WARN'::text]))
        ), keyword_backlog AS (
         SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1.cluster_queue_status = 'NEEDS_CLEANUP_REVIEW'::text)))::integer AS cleanup_review_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1.cluster_queue_status = 'NEEDS_CLEANUP'::text)))::integer AS cleanup_missing_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1.cluster_queue_status = 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text)))::integer AS wait_metrics_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1.cluster_queue_status = 'READY_FOR_SEMANTIC_CLUSTERING'::text)))::integer AS ready_count
           FROM feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1
        ), cqa_backlog AS (
         SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1.cqa_shadow_state = 'READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_CQA'::text)))::integer AS independent_ready,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1.cqa_shadow_state = 'READY_FOR_HUMAN_AND_CQA_REVIEW'::text)))::integer AS human_cqa_ready,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1.cqa_shadow_state = 'APPROVED_NEEDS_SIMILARITY_CHECK'::text)))::integer AS approved_needs_similarity,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1.cqa_shadow_state = ANY (ARRAY['REVISION_REQUIRED'::text, 'BLOCKED_BY_VALIDATION'::text]))))::integer AS blocked_or_revision
           FROM feya_commerce_v_content_qa_shadow_status_safe_v1
        ), brief_queue AS (
         SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.can_generate_shadow))::integer AS shadow_ready,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.can_produce_canonical_brief))::integer AS canonical_ready,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.can_generate_shadow AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
                  WHERE ((d.canonical_product_id = c.canonical_product_id) AND (d.archived_at IS NULL))))))))::integer AS shadow_ready_without_draft
           FROM feya_commerce_v_content_brief_compiler_status_safe_v1 c
        ), cap AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_name,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.owner_role,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_state,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.implementation_state,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.public_summary,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.limitations_summary,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.version_no,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.updated_at
           FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
        )
 SELECT signal_fingerprint,
    signal_code,
    signal_type,
    signal_scope,
    accountable_domain,
    priority,
    materiality_score,
    maturity_state,
    signal_state,
    case_admission_recommendation,
    title,
    summary,
    next_action,
    entity_scope_json,
    evidence_json,
    generated_at
   FROM ( SELECT md5(((('LAUNCH|'::text || l.readiness_scope) || '|'::text) || l.gate_code)) AS signal_fingerprint,
            ((('LAUNCH_'::text || l.readiness_scope) || '_'::text) || l.gate_code) AS signal_code,
            'READINESS_BLOCKER'::text AS signal_type,
            l.readiness_scope AS signal_scope,
            l.owner_role AS accountable_domain,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((l.gate_status = 'BLOCKED'::text) AND (l.readiness_scope = ANY (ARRAY['PUBLIC_SITE'::text, 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text]))) THEN 'P1'::text
                    WHEN (l.gate_status = 'BLOCKED'::text) THEN 'P2'::text
                    ELSE 'P3'::text
                END AS priority,
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ((l.gate_status = 'BLOCKED'::text) AND (l.readiness_scope = ANY (ARRAY['PUBLIC_SITE'::text, 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text]))) THEN 90
                    WHEN (l.gate_status = 'BLOCKED'::text) THEN 70
                    ELSE 40
                END)::numeric AS materiality_score,
            'PRE_LAUNCH'::text AS maturity_state,
            l.gate_status AS signal_state,
                CASE
                    WHEN (l.owner_role = 'HUMAN_OWNER'::text) THEN 'OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED'::text
                    WHEN ((l.readiness_scope = ANY (ARRAY['COMMERCE'::text, 'MEASUREMENT'::text])) AND (l.gate_code <> 'MEASUREMENT_SPEC_REGISTRY'::text)) THEN 'DEFER_UNTIL_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE'::text
                    WHEN (l.gate_status = 'BLOCKED'::text) THEN 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text
                    ELSE 'MONITOR'::text
                END AS case_admission_recommendation,
            l.gate_name AS title,
            l.summary,
            l.next_action,
            jsonb_build_object('readiness_scope', l.readiness_scope, 'gate_code', l.gate_code) AS entity_scope_json,
            l.evidence_json,
            now() AS generated_at
           FROM launch l
        UNION ALL
         SELECT md5('OSPM|KEYWORD_CLEANUP_BACKLOG'::text) AS md5,
            'OSPM_KEYWORD_CLEANUP_BACKLOG'::text,
            'PIPELINE_BACKLOG'::text,
            'SEO_PORTFOLIO'::text,
            'OSPM'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((k.cleanup_review_count + k.cleanup_missing_count) >= 100) THEN 'P1'::text
                    ELSE 'P2'::text
                END AS "case",
            LEAST((100)::numeric, ((((k.cleanup_review_count + k.cleanup_missing_count))::numeric / (5)::numeric) + (20)::numeric)) AS "least",
            'PRE_LAUNCH'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((k.cleanup_review_count + k.cleanup_missing_count) > 0) THEN 'OPEN'::text
                    ELSE 'CLEAR'::text
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN ((k.cleanup_review_count + k.cleanup_missing_count) > 0) THEN 'WORK_QUEUE'::text
                    ELSE 'MONITOR'::text
                END AS "case",
            'Keyword cleanup review backlog'::text,
            'Keyword cleanup must be reviewed before semantic query clustering can become canonical.'::text,
            'Process reviewed cleanup decisions; do not auto-create query clusters from pending cleanup.'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('domain', 'keywords') AS jsonb_build_object,
            jsonb_build_object('needs_cleanup_review', k.cleanup_review_count, 'needs_cleanup', k.cleanup_missing_count, 'wait_for_metrics', k.wait_metrics_count, 'ready_for_semantic_clustering', k.ready_count) AS jsonb_build_object,
            now() AS now
           FROM keyword_backlog k
          WHERE ((k.cleanup_review_count + k.cleanup_missing_count) > 0)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT md5('CQA|READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT'::text) AS md5,
            'CQA_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_QUEUE'::text,
            'REVIEW_QUEUE'::text,
            'CONTENT_QA'::text,
            'CQA'::text,
            'P2'::text,
            LEAST((100)::numeric, (((c.independent_ready)::numeric * (2)::numeric) + (30)::numeric)) AS "least",
            'PRE_LAUNCH'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.independent_ready > 0) THEN 'OPEN'::text
                    ELSE 'CLEAR'::text
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.independent_ready > 0) THEN 'WORK_QUEUE'::text
                    ELSE 'MONITOR'::text
                END AS "case",
            'Drafts ready for independent CQA'::text,
            'Human-approved/prechecked drafts are waiting for independent CQA.'::text,
            'Run independent CQA in dry-run first; do not auto-publish.'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('domain', 'content_qa') AS jsonb_build_object,
            jsonb_build_object('ready_for_independent_cqa', c.independent_ready, 'ready_for_human_and_cqa', c.human_cqa_ready, 'approved_needs_similarity', c.approved_needs_similarity, 'blocked_or_revision', c.blocked_or_revision) AS jsonb_build_object,
            now() AS now
           FROM cqa_backlog c
          WHERE (c.independent_ready > 0)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT md5('SCO|SHADOW_READY_WITHOUT_DRAFT'::text) AS md5,
            'SCO_SHADOW_DRAFT_OPPORTUNITY'::text,
            'OPPORTUNITY_QUEUE'::text,
            'CONTENT_GENERATION'::text,
            'SCO'::text,
            'P2'::text,
            LEAST((100)::numeric, (((b.shadow_ready_without_draft)::numeric / (2)::numeric) + (20)::numeric)) AS "least",
            'PRE_LAUNCH'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.shadow_ready_without_draft > 0) THEN 'OPEN'::text
                    ELSE 'CLEAR'::text
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.shadow_ready_without_draft > 0) THEN 'WORK_QUEUE'::text
                    ELSE 'MONITOR'::text
                END AS "case",
            'Shadow-ready content briefs without active drafts'::text,
            'Deterministic compiler has enough truth/context for shadow generation, but canonical ownership/metrics are still unresolved.'::text,
            'Use SCO shadow dry-run in small batches; keep generated drafts behind prechecks/human/CQA gates.'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('domain', 'content_generation') AS jsonb_build_object,
            jsonb_build_object('shadow_ready', b.shadow_ready, 'shadow_ready_without_active_draft', b.shadow_ready_without_draft, 'canonical_ready', b.canonical_ready) AS jsonb_build_object,
            now() AS now
           FROM brief_queue b
          WHERE (b.shadow_ready_without_draft > 0)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT md5('GDAE|GOOGLE_ADS_KEYWORD_METRICS'::text) AS md5,
            'GDAE_GOOGLE_ADS_KEYWORD_METRICS_DEGRADED'::text,
            'DATA_CAPABILITY_DEGRADED'::text,
            'KEYWORD_METRICS'::text,
            'GDAE'::text,
            'P2'::text,
            (60)::numeric AS "numeric",
            'PRE_LAUNCH'::text,
            c.capability_state,
            'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text,
            'Google Ads Keyword Planning access degraded'::text,
            c.public_summary,
            c.limitations_summary,
            jsonb_build_object('capability_code', c.capability_code) AS jsonb_build_object,
            jsonb_build_object('capability_state', c.capability_state, 'implementation_state', c.implementation_state) AS jsonb_build_object,
            now() AS now
           FROM cap c
          WHERE ((c.capability_code = 'GOOGLE_ADS_KEYWORD_METRICS'::text) AND (c.capability_state = ANY (ARRAY['DEGRADED'::text, 'UNAVAILABLE'::text])))) signals
  WHERE (signal_state <> 'CLEAR'::text);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_growth_signal_candidates_safe_v2
relations.definition:
WITH active_objectives AS (
         SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_type = 'COMMERCE'::text)))::integer AS commerce_objectives,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_type = 'MEASUREMENT'::text)))::integer AS measurement_objectives,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_type = 'ORGANIC_GROWTH'::text)))::integer AS organic_objectives,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_type = 'COMMERCIAL_GROWTH'::text)))::integer AS commercial_objectives,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_type = 'LAUNCH'::text)))::integer AS launch_objectives
           FROM feya_growth_objectives_v1
          WHERE (feya_growth_objectives_v1.objective_status = 'ACTIVE'::text)
        )
 SELECT s.signal_fingerprint,
    s.signal_code,
    s.signal_type,
    s.signal_scope,
    s.accountable_domain,
    s.priority,
    s.materiality_score,
    s.maturity_state,
    s.signal_state,
        CASE
            WHEN ((s.case_admission_recommendation = 'DEFER_UNTIL_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE'::text) AND (s.signal_scope = 'COMMERCE'::text) AND (a.commerce_objectives > 0)) THEN 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text
            WHEN ((s.case_admission_recommendation = 'DEFER_UNTIL_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE'::text) AND (s.signal_scope = 'MEASUREMENT'::text) AND (a.measurement_objectives > 0)) THEN 'IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION'::text
            ELSE s.case_admission_recommendation
        END AS case_admission_recommendation,
    s.title,
    s.summary,
    s.next_action,
    s.entity_scope_json,
    (s.evidence_json || jsonb_build_object('active_objective_counts', jsonb_build_object('COMMERCE', a.commerce_objectives, 'MEASUREMENT', a.measurement_objectives, 'ORGANIC_GROWTH', a.organic_objectives, 'COMMERCIAL_GROWTH', a.commercial_objectives, 'LAUNCH', a.launch_objectives))) AS evidence_json,
    s.generated_at
   FROM (feya_commerce_v_growth_signal_candidates_safe_v1 s
     CROSS JOIN active_objectives a);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1
relations.definition:
WITH cap AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.owner_role,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_state,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.implementation_state,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.public_summary,
            feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.limitations_summary
           FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_products_api) AS storefront_products,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_seo_pages_v1
                  WHERE ((feya_commerce_seo_pages_v1.portfolio_status = 'active'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_pages_v1.indexation_intent = 'indexable'::text))) AS indexable_pages,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1
                  WHERE ((feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1.ownership_role = 'primary'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1.ownership_status = ANY (ARRAY['intended'::text, 'active'::text, 'protected'::text])) AND (feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1.effective_to IS NULL))) AS primary_ownership_rows,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1
                  WHERE ((feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1.archived_at IS NULL) AND (feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1.status = 'ready_for_publish'::text))) AS ready_for_publish_drafts,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_business_truth_v1
                  WHERE ((feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.truth_type = 'RETURNS'::text) AND (feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.valid_to IS NULL))) AS active_return_truth,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM feya_commerce_business_truth_v1
                  WHERE ((feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.truth_type = 'RETURNS'::text) AND (feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) AND (feya_commerce_business_truth_v1.valid_to IS NULL))) AS review_return_truth
        )
 SELECT readiness_scope,
    gate_code,
    gate_name,
    gate_status,
    is_blocker,
    summary,
    next_action,
    owner_role,
    evidence_json
   FROM ( SELECT 'PUBLIC_SITE'::text AS readiness_scope,
            'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text AS gate_code,
            'Production domain connected'::text AS gate_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) = 'AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS gate_status,
            true AS is_blocker,
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.public_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'Production domain state is unknown.'::text) AS summary,
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'Connect the intended production domain.'::text) AS next_action,
            'TSEO'::text AS owner_role,
            jsonb_build_object('capability_state', COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS evidence_json
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'PUBLIC_SITE'::text,
            'ADMIN_SECURITY'::text,
            'Admin authentication enforced'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.implementation_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'ADMIN_AUTH'::text)), 'missing'::text) = 'enforced_verified'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS "case",
            true,
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.public_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'ADMIN_AUTH'::text)), 'Admin Auth capability is missing.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            'Explicitly allowlist approved admin account(s), enable FEYA_ADMIN_AUTH_REQUIRED, and verify login/logout/unauthorized blocking.'::text,
            'CORE'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('implementation_state', COALESCE(( SELECT cap.implementation_state
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'ADMIN_AUTH'::text)), 'missing'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'PUBLIC_SITE'::text,
            'PRODUCT_CATALOG'::text,
            'Product catalog available'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.storefront_products > 0) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS "case",
            true,
            ('Current storefront candidate products available: '::text || counts.storefront_products),
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.storefront_products > 0) THEN 'Keep catalog truth/readiness under review.'::text
                    ELSE 'Populate and validate storefront product candidates.'::text
                END AS "case",
            'CORE'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('storefront_products', counts.storefront_products) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM counts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'PUBLIC_SITE'::text,
            'RETURN_POLICY_CANON'::text,
            'Canonical return policy confirmed'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.active_return_truth > 0) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS "case",
            true,
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.active_return_truth > 0) THEN 'At least one ACTIVE return-policy Business Truth exists.'::text
                    ELSE 'No ACTIVE return-policy Business Truth exists.'::text
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.active_return_truth > 0) THEN 'Maintain versioned return-policy truth.'::text
                    ELSE 'Human Owner must confirm the current storefront return wording before policy publication.'::text
                END AS "case",
            'HUMAN_OWNER'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('active_return_truth', counts.active_return_truth, 'review_required_return_truth', counts.review_return_truth) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM counts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text,

            'Technical search foundation'::text,

                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'SEARCH_LAUNCH_GATE'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) = 'AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'SEARCH_LAUNCH_GATE'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) = 'AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS'::text) THEN 'WARN'::text

            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.public_summary

                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'SEARCH_LAUNCH_GATE'::text)), 'Search launch capability missing.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'SEARCH_LAUNCH_GATE'::text)), 'Complete TSEO launch foundation.'::text) AS "coalesce",

                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'SEARCH_LAUNCH_GATE'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text,
            'INDEXABLE_PAGE_PORTFOLIO'::text,

                    WHEN (counts.indexable_pages > 0) THEN 'PASS'::text

                END AS "case",
            'OSPM'::text,

        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text,

            'Primary query/page ownership exists'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.primary_ownership_rows > 0) THEN 'PASS'::text

            true,
            ('Active primary ownership rows: '::text || counts.primary_ownership_rows),
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.primary_ownership_rows > 0) THEN 'Maintain one primary owner per query cluster/market/locale.'::text
                    ELSE 'Complete keyword cleanup review, semantic clustering and OSPM ownership review.'::text
                END AS "case",
            'OSPM'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('primary_ownership_rows', counts.primary_ownership_rows) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM counts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text,
            'CONTENT_PUBLISH_READINESS'::text,
            'Publish-ready content exists'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (counts.ready_for_publish_drafts > 0) THEN 'PASS'::text

                END AS "case",
            'CQA'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('ready_for_publish_drafts', counts.ready_for_publish_drafts) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM counts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'SEARCH_INDEXING'::text,
            'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text,
            'Search canonical host available'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap

                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS "case",
            true,
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.public_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'Production domain unavailable.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            'Connect and validate zofeya.com before enabling Search indexing.'::text,
            'TSEO'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('capability_state', COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'PRODUCTION_DOMAIN'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'MEASUREMENT'::text,
            'GA4_COLLECTION'::text,
            'GA4 production collection'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'GA4_COLLECTION'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) = 'AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text

            true,

                   FROM cap

            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'GA4_COLLECTION'::text)), 'Configure production GA4 and consent-aware event collection.'::text) AS "coalesce",

                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'GA4_COLLECTION'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL

            'GSC_BULK_EXPORT'::text,
            'Search Console data export'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap
                      WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'GSC_BULK_EXPORT'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) = 'AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text

            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary

            'GDAE'::text,

                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'GSC_BULK_EXPORT'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'MEASUREMENT'::text,
            'MEASUREMENT_SPEC_REGISTRY'::text,

                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
                END AS "case",
            false,
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.public_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'MEASUREMENT_SPEC_REGISTRY'::text)), 'Measurement Spec Registry unavailable.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'MEASUREMENT_SPEC_REGISTRY'::text)), 'Implement Measurement Spec governance.'::text) AS "coalesce",
            'GMEL'::text,
            jsonb_build_object('capability_state', COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'MEASUREMENT_SPEC_REGISTRY'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'MEASUREMENT'::text,

                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap

                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text

            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary

            'GMEL'::text,

                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'MEASUREMENT_ENGINE'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'COMMERCE'::text,

                    WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT cap.capability_state
                       FROM cap

                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text

            COALESCE(( SELECT cap.limitations_summary

                   FROM cap
                  WHERE (cap.capability_code = 'COMMERCE_CHECKOUT'::text)), 'UNAVAILABLE'::text)) AS jsonb_build_object
        UNION ALL

                    ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text

        UNION ALL

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v2
relations.definition:
SELECT feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.readiness_scope,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.gate_code,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.gate_name,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.gate_status,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.is_blocker,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.summary,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.next_action,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.owner_role,
    feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1.evidence_json
   FROM feya_commerce_v_launch_readiness_safe_v1
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'PUBLIC_SITE'::text AS readiness_scope,
    'ADMIN_DATA_BOUNDARY'::text AS gate_code,
    'Internal admin data protected from anonymous access'::text AS gate_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.implementation_state
               FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
              WHERE (feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code = 'ADMIN_DATA_BOUNDARY'::text)), 'missing'::text) = 'hardened_verified'::text) THEN 'PASS'::text
            ELSE 'BLOCKED'::text
        END AS gate_status,
    true AS is_blocker,
    COALESCE(( SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.public_summary
           FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
          WHERE (feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code = 'ADMIN_DATA_BOUNDARY'::text)), 'Protected admin data boundary is missing.'::text) AS summary,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(( SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.implementation_state
               FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
              WHERE (feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code = 'ADMIN_DATA_BOUNDARY'::text)), 'missing'::text) = 'hardened_verified'::text) THEN 'Keep internal admin views server-only.'::text
            ELSE 'Enable admin auth, verify allowlist/login, switch admin reads to protected server mode, then revoke anon SELECT from internal admin views.'::text
        END AS next_action,
    'CORE'::text AS owner_role,
    jsonb_build_object('implementation_state', COALESCE(( SELECT feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.implementation_state
           FROM feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1
          WHERE (feya_commerce_v_growth_capability_status_safe_v1.capability_code = 'ADMIN_DATA_BOUNDARY'::text)), 'missing'::text)) AS evidence_json;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_product_component_configuration_derivation_v1
relations.definition:
WITH component_rows AS (
         SELECT sc.canonical_product_id,
            sc.sellable_configuration_id,
            sc.configuration_name,
            sc.normalized_key,
            sc.is_default_whole_product,
            sc.is_sampler,
            sc.is_public_candidate,
            sc.sort_order,
            cf.canonical_name AS component_family_name,
            cf.normalized_name AS component_family_normalized_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = ANY (ARRAY['top'::text, 'corset'::text])) THEN 'top'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'harness top'::text) THEN 'harness'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'skirt'::text) THEN 'skirt'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'panties'::text) THEN 'panties'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'belt'::text) THEN 'belt'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'choker'::text) THEN 'choker'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = ANY (ARRAY['shoulders'::text, 'shoulder'::text])) THEN 'shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = ANY (ARRAY['arm set'::text, 'bracelet / cuff'::text, 'glove'::text])) THEN 'arms'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'leg covers'::text) THEN 'legs'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'mask'::text) THEN 'mask'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'headpiece'::text) THEN 'headpiece'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'wings'::text) THEN 'wings'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'backpiece'::text) THEN 'backpiece'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'spine'::text) THEN 'spine'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'tail'::text) THEN 'tail'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'dress'::text) THEN 'dress'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'bodysuit'::text) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = 'cape / tunic'::text) THEN 'cape_tunic'::text
                    WHEN (cf.normalized_name = ANY (ARRAY['full set'::text, 'whole product'::text])) THEN 'full_set'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS config_part_tag
           FROM (feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_component_families cf ON ((cf.component_family_id = sc.component_family_id)))
          WHERE (sc.is_public_candidate IS TRUE)
        ), aggregated AS (
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sellable_configuration_id', component_rows.sellable_configuration_id, 'configuration_name', component_rows.configuration_name, 'normalized_key', component_rows.normalized_key, 'component_family_name', component_rows.component_family_name, 'component_family_normalized_name', component_rows.component_family_normalized_name, 'config_part_tag', component_rows.config_part_tag, 'is_default_whole_product', component_rows.is_default_whole_product, 'is_sampler', component_rows.is_sampler, 'sort_order', component_rows.sort_order) ORDER BY component_rows.sort_order, component_rows.configuration_name) AS public_config_component_json,
            array_agg(DISTINCT component_rows.config_part_tag) FILTER (WHERE (component_rows.config_part_tag IS NOT NULL)) AS config_part_tags_raw,
            (count(*))::integer AS public_config_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (component_rows.config_part_tag IS NOT NULL)))::integer AS config_part_signal_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (component_rows.config_part_tag = 'full_set'::text)))::integer AS full_set_signal_count
           FROM component_rows
          GROUP BY component_rows.canonical_product_id
        ), cleaned AS (
         SELECT a.canonical_product_id,
            a.public_config_component_json,
            a.config_part_tags_raw,
            a.public_config_count,
            a.config_part_signal_count,
            a.full_set_signal_count,
            array_remove(a.config_part_tags_raw, 'full_set'::text) AS config_part_tags_without_full_set
           FROM aggregated a
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    public_config_count,
    config_part_signal_count,
    full_set_signal_count,
    public_config_component_json,
    to_jsonb(COALESCE(config_part_tags_raw, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS config_part_tags_json,
    to_jsonb(COALESCE(config_part_tags_without_full_set, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS config_part_tags_without_full_set_json,
        CASE
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('top'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'top'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('harness'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'harness'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('skirt'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'skirt'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('headpiece'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'headpiece'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('mask'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'mask'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('shoulders'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'shoulders'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('arms'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'arms'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('legs'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'legs'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('dress'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'dress'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(config_part_tags_without_full_set) > 0)) THEN config_part_tags_without_full_set[1]
            WHEN (full_set_signal_count > 0) THEN 'full_set'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS config_primary_part,
        CASE
            WHEN ((full_set_signal_count > 0) OR (cardinality(COALESCE(config_part_tags_without_full_set, ARRAY[]::text[])) > 1)) THEN 'multi_piece_costume_set'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('top'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'top_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'bodysuit_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('harness'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'harness_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('skirt'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'skirt_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('headpiece'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'headpiece_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('mask'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'mask_product'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('dress'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'dress_product'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS config_derived_product_type,
    jsonb_build_object('public_config_count', public_config_count, 'config_part_signal_count', config_part_signal_count, 'full_set_signal_count', full_set_signal_count, 'config_part_tags', to_jsonb(COALESCE(config_part_tags_raw, ARRAY[]::text[])), 'config_primary_part',
        CASE
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('top'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'top'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('harness'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'harness'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('skirt'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'skirt'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('headpiece'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'headpiece'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('mask'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'mask'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('shoulders'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'shoulders'::text
            WHEN ((config_part_tags_without_full_set IS NOT NULL) AND ('arms'::text = ANY (config_part_tags_without_full_set))) THEN 'arms'::text

        ), derived AS (
         SELECT p.canonical_product_id,

WITH base AS (
         SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
            p.source_shop_code,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            p.source_url,
            p.draft_site_title,
            p.card_title,
            p.h1,
            p.product_type,
            p.material AS raw_material,
            p.color AS raw_color,
            lower(COALESCE(p.material, ''::text)) AS material_lc,
            lower(COALESCE(p.color, ''::text)) AS color_lc,
            lower(((((COALESCE(p.draft_site_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.card_title, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.h1, ''::text))) AS title_lc
           FROM feya_commerce_product_drafts p
        ), flags AS (
         SELECT b.canonical_product_id,
            b.source_shop_code,
            b.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            b.source_url,
            b.draft_site_title,
            b.card_title,
            b.h1,
            b.product_type,
            b.raw_material,
            b.raw_color,
            b.material_lc,
            b.color_lc,
            b.title_lc,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])latex([^a-z]|$)'::text) THEN 'MATERIAL_LATEX_REVIEW'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.material_lc ~ 'natural leather|alligator leather'::text) THEN 'MATERIAL_NATURAL_LEATHER_REVIEW'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])leather([^a-z]|$)'::text) AND (b.material_lc !~ 'faux leather|vegan leather'::text)) THEN 'MATERIAL_LEATHER_AMBIGUOUS'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])plastic([^a-z]|$)'::text) AND (b.material_lc !~ 'acrylic|mirror plastic'::text) AND (b.title_lc !~ 'acrylic|mirror'::text)) THEN 'MATERIAL_PLASTIC_REVIEW'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])ceramic([^a-z]|$)'::text) THEN 'MATERIAL_CERAMIC_REVIEW'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.raw_material IS NULL) OR (btrim(b.raw_material) = ''::text)) THEN 'MATERIAL_MISSING'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.raw_color IS NULL) OR (btrim(b.raw_color) = ''::text)) THEN 'COLOR_MISSING_EXTRACT_FROM_TITLE'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.product_type = 'costume_component_or_set'::text) THEN 'PRODUCT_TYPE_GENERIC'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.raw_material ~~ '%,%'::text) THEN 'MATERIAL_MULTI_VALUE_REVIEW'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS warning_codes
           FROM base b
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    source_shop_code,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    source_url,
    draft_site_title,
    card_title,
    h1,
    product_type,
    raw_material,
    raw_color,
        CASE
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'acrylic|mirror plastic|mirror'::text) THEN 'mirror acrylic'::text
            WHEN ((material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])plastic([^a-z]|$)'::text) AND (title_lc ~ 'acrylic|mirror|corset|breastplate|chest plate'::text)) THEN 'mirror acrylic'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'vegan leather|faux leather'::text) THEN 'vegan leather'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'biflex|microdayving|fabric'::text) THEN 'stretch fabric'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'silicone'::text) THEN 'silicone'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'sequins'::text) THEN 'sequins'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS normalized_material_primary,
        CASE
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'gold'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'gold|golden'::text)) THEN 'gold'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'silver'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'silver'::text)) THEN 'silver'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'black'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'black'::text)) THEN 'black'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'white'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'white'::text)) THEN 'white'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'red'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'red|devil'::text)) THEN 'red'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'holographic|iridescent'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'holographic|iridescent'::text)) THEN 'holographic'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS normalized_color_primary,
    to_jsonb(warning_codes) AS warning_codes_json,
    cardinality(warning_codes) AS warning_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_NATURAL_LEATHER_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_LATEX_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_CERAMIC_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_PLASTIC_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_LEATHER_AMBIGUOUS'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN (cardinality(warning_codes) > 0) THEN 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text
            ELSE 'FACTS_OK'::text
        END AS product_fact_quality_status,
    jsonb_build_object('raw_material', raw_material, 'normalized_material_primary',
        CASE
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'acrylic|mirror plastic|mirror'::text) THEN 'mirror acrylic'::text
            WHEN ((material_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])plastic([^a-z]|$)'::text) AND (title_lc ~ 'acrylic|mirror|corset|breastplate|chest plate'::text)) THEN 'mirror acrylic'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'vegan leather|faux leather'::text) THEN 'vegan leather'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'biflex|microdayving|fabric'::text) THEN 'stretch fabric'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'silicone'::text) THEN 'silicone'::text
            WHEN (material_lc ~ 'sequins'::text) THEN 'sequins'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END, 'raw_color', raw_color, 'normalized_color_primary',
        CASE
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'gold'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'gold|golden'::text)) THEN 'gold'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'silver'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'silver'::text)) THEN 'silver'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'black'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'black'::text)) THEN 'black'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'white'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'white'::text)) THEN 'white'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'red'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'red|devil'::text)) THEN 'red'::text
            WHEN ((color_lc ~ 'holographic|iridescent'::text) OR (title_lc ~ 'holographic|iridescent'::text)) THEN 'holographic'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END, 'warning_codes', to_jsonb(warning_codes), 'quality_status',
        CASE
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_NATURAL_LEATHER_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_LATEX_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_CERAMIC_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_PLASTIC_REVIEW'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN ('MATERIAL_LEATHER_AMBIGUOUS'::text = ANY (warning_codes)) THEN 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
            WHEN (cardinality(warning_codes) > 0) THEN 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text
            ELSE 'FACTS_OK'::text
        END) AS product_fact_quality_json
   FROM flags f;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_product_option_text_derivation_v1

WITH option_text AS (
         SELECT om.canonical_product_id,
            lower(string_agg(((((((((COALESCE(om.raw_option_name, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(om.raw_option_value, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(om.raw_option_text, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(om.canonical_option_value, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(om.detected_canonical_axis, ''::text)), ' '::text)) AS option_text_lc,
            (count(*))::integer AS option_mapping_count
           FROM feya_commerce_option_mappings om
          WHERE (COALESCE(om.non_catalog_flag, false) IS FALSE)
          GROUP BY om.canonical_product_id
        ), parts AS (
         SELECT o.canonical_product_id,
            o.option_text_lc,
            o.option_mapping_count,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'corset|bustier|bra top|chest plate|breastplate|top'::text) THEN 'top'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'bodysuit|body suit|bodywear'::text) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text

                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'harness'::text) THEN 'harness'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text

                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'skirt'::text) THEN 'skirt'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'garter|garters|leg covers|leg armor|leg piece|thigh'::text) THEN 'legs'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'shoulder|shoulders|pauldron'::text) THEN 'shoulders'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'arm cuff|arm covers|arm armor|sleeve|bracelet|cuff|glove'::text) THEN 'arms'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'headpiece|crown|horns|headdress|hat'::text) THEN 'headpiece'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'mask|muzzle|helmet'::text) THEN 'mask'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'choker|collar'::text) THEN 'choker'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'belt'::text) THEN 'belt'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'panties|underwear|bottom'::text) THEN 'panties'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'tail'::text) THEN 'tail'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'spine'::text) THEN 'spine'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'wing|wings'::text) THEN 'wings'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'dress|gown'::text) THEN 'dress'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (o.option_text_lc ~ 'full set|whole product|complete set|set'::text) THEN 'full_set'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS option_part_tags
           FROM option_text o
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    option_mapping_count,
    to_jsonb(COALESCE(option_part_tags, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS option_part_tags_json,
    cardinality(COALESCE(option_part_tags, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS option_part_signal_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ('top'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'top'::text
            WHEN ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
            WHEN ('harness'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'harness'::text
            WHEN ('skirt'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'skirt'::text
            WHEN ('headpiece'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'headpiece'::text
            WHEN ('mask'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'mask'::text
            WHEN ('shoulders'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'shoulders'::text
            WHEN ('arms'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'arms'::text
            WHEN ('legs'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'legs'::text
            WHEN ('dress'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'dress'::text
            WHEN (cardinality(COALESCE(option_part_tags, ARRAY[]::text[])) > 0) THEN option_part_tags[1]
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS option_primary_part,
        CASE
            WHEN (('full_set'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) OR (cardinality(COALESCE(array_remove(option_part_tags, 'full_set'::text), ARRAY[]::text[])) > 1)) THEN 'multi_piece_costume_set'::text
            WHEN ('top'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'top_product'::text

            WHEN ('skirt'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'skirt_product'::text
            WHEN ('headpiece'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'headpiece_product'::text
            WHEN ('mask'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'mask_product'::text
            WHEN ('dress'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'dress_product'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS option_derived_product_type,
    jsonb_build_object('option_mapping_count', option_mapping_count, 'option_part_tags', to_jsonb(COALESCE(option_part_tags, ARRAY[]::text[])), 'option_primary_part',
        CASE
            WHEN ('top'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'top'::text
            WHEN ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
            WHEN ('harness'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'harness'::text
            WHEN ('skirt'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'skirt'::text
            WHEN ('headpiece'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'headpiece'::text
            WHEN ('mask'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'mask'::text
            WHEN ('shoulders'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'shoulders'::text
            WHEN ('arms'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'arms'::text
            WHEN ('legs'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'legs'::text
            WHEN ('dress'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'dress'::text
            WHEN (cardinality(COALESCE(option_part_tags, ARRAY[]::text[])) > 0) THEN option_part_tags[1]
            ELSE NULL::text
        END, 'option_derived_product_type',
        CASE
            WHEN (('full_set'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) OR (cardinality(COALESCE(array_remove(option_part_tags, 'full_set'::text), ARRAY[]::text[])) > 1)) THEN 'multi_piece_costume_set'::text
            WHEN ('top'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'top_product'::text
            WHEN ('bodysuit'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'bodysuit_product'::text
            WHEN ('harness'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'harness_product'::text
            WHEN ('skirt'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'skirt_product'::text
            WHEN ('headpiece'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'headpiece_product'::text
            WHEN ('mask'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'mask_product'::text
            WHEN ('dress'::text = ANY (option_part_tags)) THEN 'dress_product'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS option_derivation_json
   FROM parts p;

relations.definition:
WITH public_media AS (
         SELECT m.canonical_product_id,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('media_draft_id', m.media_draft_id, 'source_image_url', m.source_image_url, 'source_image_order', m.source_image_order, 'assigned_role', m.assigned_role, 'alt_text_draft', m.alt_text_draft, 'filename_suggestion', m.filename_suggestion, 'ai_styled_image_flag', m.ai_styled_image_flag, 'readiness_status', m.readiness_status) ORDER BY m.source_image_order, m.media_draft_id) FILTER (WHERE (m.use_publicly_flag IS TRUE)) AS public_media_json,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (m.use_publicly_flag IS TRUE)))::integer AS public_media_count
           FROM feya_commerce_media_drafts m
          GROUP BY m.canonical_product_id
        ), public_configs AS (
         SELECT sc.canonical_product_id,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sellable_configuration_id', sc.sellable_configuration_id, 'configuration_name', sc.configuration_name, 'normalized_key', sc.normalized_key, 'is_default_whole_product', sc.is_default_whole_product, 'is_sampler', sc.is_sampler, 'is_public_candidate', sc.is_public_candidate, 'sort_order', sc.sort_order, 'review_status', sc.review_status) ORDER BY sc.sort_order, sc.configuration_name) FILTER (WHERE (sc.is_public_candidate IS TRUE)) AS public_configurations_json,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (sc.is_public_candidate IS TRUE)))::integer AS public_configuration_count
           FROM feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc
          GROUP BY sc.canonical_product_id
        ), existing_content AS (
         SELECT cd.canonical_product_id,
            jsonb_build_object('site_title', cd.site_title, 'card_title', cd.card_title, 'h1', cd.h1, 'seo_title', cd.seo_title, 'meta_description', cd.meta_description, 'short_description', cd.short_description, 'full_description', cd.full_description, 'what_is_included', cd.what_is_included, 'snippet_status', cd.snippet_status, 'ai_content_status', cd.ai_content_status, 'review_status', cd.review_status) AS existing_content_json,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.canonical_product_id ORDER BY cd.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, cd.created_at DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_content_drafts cd
        )
 SELECT q.brief_queue_id,
    q.canonical_product_id,
    q.brief_type,
    q.target_language,
    q.generation_status,
    q.review_status,
    q.readiness_status,
    q.priority_order,
    q.keyword_metric_status,
    q.current_title,
    p.source_shop_code,
    p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    p.source_url,
    p.draft_site_title,
    p.card_title,
    p.h1,
    p.seo_title,
    p.meta_description,
    p.product_type,
    p.material,
    p.color,
    p.size_mode,
    p.fit_type,
    p.production_profile,
    p.shipping_profile,
    p.handmade_flag,
    p.styled_imagery_flag,
    p.raw_ai_context,
    COALESCE(pm.public_media_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS public_media_json,
    COALESCE(pm.public_media_count, 0) AS public_media_count,
    COALESCE(pc.public_configurations_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS public_configurations_json,
    COALESCE(pc.public_configuration_count, 0) AS public_configuration_count,
    COALESCE(ec.existing_content_json, '{}'::jsonb) AS existing_content_json,
    jsonb_build_object('brand', 'TheFEYA', 'storefront_language', 'en', 'admin_language', 'ru', 'brand_positioning', 'handmade stage, festival and performance fashion designs; limited customization only', 'avoid_positioning', jsonb_build_array('custom atelier from scratch', 'keyword stuffing', 'fake search volume', 'AI image mismatch'), 'customization_policy', 'adjustable/custom sizing, selected color/detail adjustments for existing designs only', 'content_tone', 'luxury fashion, editorial, clear product facts, human natural English', 'must_not_invent', jsonb_build_array('materials not present', 'included pieces not present', 'availability', 'search metrics', 'celebrity/brand/festival endorsements')) AS brand_rules_json,
    jsonb_build_object('required_blocks', jsonb_build_array('site_title', 'card_title', 'h1', 'seo_title', 'meta_description', 'short_description', 'full_description', 'what_is_included', 'image_alt_text', 'filename_suggestions', 'structured_product_facts'), 'seo_title_max_chars', 60, 'meta_description_target_chars', '140-160', 'h1_rule', 'clear product name, not keyword stuffed', 'alt_text_rule', 'describe visible product facts only; no spam', 'keyword_rule', 'final keyword selection waits for real metrics; do not invent keyword volume', 'returns_shipping_production_blocks', 'use approved FEYA snippets later, do not improvise policy text in brief payload') AS generation_instructions_json,
    jsonb_build_object('product_facts', q.product_facts_json, 'target_blocks', q.target_blocks_json, 'brand_rules', jsonb_build_object('limited_customization', true, 'not_custom_from_scratch', true, 'handmade_designs', true), 'metric_dependency', q.keyword_metric_status) AS compact_payload_json
   FROM ((((feya_commerce_product_seo_brief_queue_v1 q
     JOIN feya_commerce_product_drafts p ON ((p.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public_media pm ON ((pm.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public_configs pc ON ((pc.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN existing_content ec ON (((ec.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id) AND (ec.rn = 1))))
  WHERE (q.generation_status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'in_progress'::text]));

        CASE
            WHEN ((product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) AND (normalized_material_primary IS NULL)) THEN 'BLOCK_UNTIL_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ((product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) AND (normalized_material_primary IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'ALLOW_WITH_STRICT_FACT_GUARDRAILS'::text
            WHEN ((product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) AND (normalized_material_primary IS NULL)) THEN 'REVIEW_BEFORE_GENERATION'::text
            WHEN (product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text])) THEN 'ALLOW_WITH_FACT_WARNINGS'::text
            ELSE 'ALLOW'::text
        END AS safe_generation_status
   FROM feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_generation_payload_safe_v1 p;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_proposal_candidates_v1
relations.definition:
WITH latest_approved_cleanup AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.keyword_norm) c.cleanup_id,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.approved_keyword,
            c.approved_keyword_norm,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.ai_intent,
            c.should_use_for_product,
            c.should_use_for_collection,
            c.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c.approved_at
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
          WHERE ((c.review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (c.approved_keyword_norm IS NOT NULL))
          ORDER BY c.keyword_norm, c.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.cleanup_id DESC
        ), membership AS (
         SELECT m_1.keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::integer AS active_membership_count
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m_1
             JOIN feya_commerce_seo_query_clusters_v1 c ON ((c.query_cluster_id = m_1.query_cluster_id)))
          WHERE ((m_1.member_role <> 'excluded'::text) AND (c.cluster_status = ANY (ARRAY['review'::text, 'approved'::text, 'hold'::text])))
          GROUP BY m_1.keyword_norm
        ), latest_metric AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.keyword_norm) s.keyword_norm,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.fetched_at,
            s.data_freshness_status
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 s
          WHERE ((COALESCE(s.geo, 'US'::text) = 'US'::text) AND (COALESCE(s.language, 'en'::text) = 'en'::text))
          ORDER BY s.keyword_norm, s.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.snapshot_id DESC
        )
 SELECT a.cleanup_id,
    a.keyword_id,
    a.keyword_norm,
    a.approved_keyword,
    a.approved_keyword_norm,
    a.keyword_axis,
    a.keyword_pattern,
    a.suggested_page_level,
    a.ai_intent,
    a.should_use_for_product,
    a.should_use_for_collection,
    a.should_use_for_image_alt,
    a.approved_at,
    COALESCE(m.active_membership_count, 0) AS active_membership_count,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.fetched_at AS metric_fetched_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_freshness_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.active_membership_count, 0) > 0) THEN 'ALREADY_CLUSTERED'::text
            WHEN (a.approved_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN 'NOT_READY'::text
            ELSE 'READY_FOR_CLUSTER_PROPOSAL'::text
        END AS proposal_candidate_status
   FROM ((latest_approved_cleanup a
     LEFT JOIN membership m ON ((m.keyword_norm = a.keyword_norm)))
     LEFT JOIN latest_metric lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = a.keyword_norm)));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_proposal_queue_safe_v1
relations.definition:
WITH active_proposal_members AS (
