             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.proposed_members_json) member(value))
          WHERE (p.proposal_status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'REVIEW'::text, 'APPROVED'::text, 'APPLIED'::text]))

 SELECT cleanup_id,

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1
relations.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c.cleanup_id,
            c.run_id,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.original_keyword,
            c.cleaned_keyword,
            c.suggested_keyword,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.ai_intent,
            c.ai_rewrite_status,
            c.should_validate_api,
            c.should_use_for_product,
            c.should_use_for_collection,
            c.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c.should_hold,
            c.warning_flags,
            c.ai_reason,
            c.model_name,
            c.prompt_version,
            c.source_queue_snapshot,
            c.raw_ai_response_json,
            c.review_status,
            c.approved_keyword,
            c.approved_keyword_norm,
            c.approved_at,
            c.approved_by,
            c.created_at,
            c.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.keyword_norm ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
        ), latest_metric AS (
         SELECT s.snapshot_id,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.source_api,
            s.geo,
            s.language,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            s.fetched_at,
            s.raw_payload_json,
            s.data_freshness_status,
            s.created_at,
            s.metric_batch_id,
            s.metric_batch_keyword_id,
            s.keyword_id,
            s.source_request_id,
            s.api_version,
            s.ingestion_run_id,
            s.targeting_context_hash,
            s.access_model,
            s.bid_currency_code,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.keyword_norm, COALESCE(s.geo, 'US'::text), COALESCE(s.language, 'en'::text) ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 s
        ), cluster_membership AS (
         SELECT m.keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::integer AS cluster_membership_count
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m
          WHERE (m.member_role <> 'excluded'::text)
          GROUP BY m.keyword_norm
        )
 SELECT km.keyword_id,
    km.keyword AS source_keyword,
    km.keyword_norm,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lc.approved_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(lc.suggested_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(lc.cleaned_keyword, ''::text), km.keyword) AS semantic_keyword_candidate,
    km.keyword_axis,
    km.keyword_pattern,
    km.suggested_page_level,
    km.priority_tier,
    km.validation_priority,
    km.validation_status AS keyword_master_validation_status,
    km.requires_api_validation,
    km.product_count,
    lc.cleanup_id,
    lc.ai_intent,
    lc.ai_rewrite_status,
    lc.review_status AS cleanup_review_status,
    lc.should_validate_api,
    lc.should_use_for_product,
    lc.should_use_for_collection,
    lc.should_use_for_image_alt,
    lc.should_hold,
    lc.warning_flags,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.fetched_at AS latest_metric_fetched_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_data_freshness_status,
    COALESCE(cm.cluster_membership_count, 0) AS cluster_membership_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lc.should_hold, false) IS TRUE) THEN 'HOLD'::text
            WHEN (lc.cleanup_id IS NULL) THEN 'NEEDS_CLEANUP'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(lc.review_status, 'pending'::text) <> 'approved'::text) THEN 'NEEDS_CLEANUP_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(cm.cluster_membership_count, 0) > 0) THEN 'ALREADY_CLUSTERED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(lc.should_validate_api, km.requires_api_validation, false) IS TRUE) AND ((lm.snapshot_id IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(lm.data_freshness_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['api_not_connected'::text, 'placeholder'::text, 'mock'::text, 'no_real_metrics'::text])) OR ((lm.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (lm.competition IS NULL) AND (lm.competition_index IS NULL)) OR (lm.fetched_at IS NULL) OR (lm.fetched_at < (now() - '90 days'::interval)))) THEN 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text
            ELSE 'READY_FOR_SEMANTIC_CLUSTERING'::text
        END AS cluster_queue_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) THEN 'PRODUCT_INTENT_FAMILY'::text
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 'COLLECTION_INTENT_FAMILY'::text
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 'IMAGE_SEMANTIC_SUPPORT'::text
            ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED'::text
        END AS clustering_lane,
    jsonb_build_object('axis', km.keyword_axis, 'pattern', km.keyword_pattern, 'suggested_page_level', km.suggested_page_level, 'priority_tier', km.priority_tier, 'product_count', km.product_count, 'cleanup_review_status', lc.review_status, 'ai_intent', lc.ai_intent, 'avg_monthly_searches', lm.avg_monthly_searches, 'metric_fetched_at', lm.fetched_at, 'metric_freshness', lm.data_freshness_status) AS clustering_evidence
   FROM (((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 km
     LEFT JOIN latest_cleanup lc ON (((lc.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm) AND (lc.rn = 1))))
     LEFT JOIN latest_metric lm ON (((lm.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm) AND (COALESCE(lm.geo, 'US'::text) = 'US'::text) AND (COALESCE(lm.language, 'en'::text) = 'en'::text) AND (lm.rn = 1))))
     LEFT JOIN cluster_membership cm ON ((cm.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm)))
  WHERE (km.active_flag IS TRUE);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_pilot_report_v1
relations.definition:
WITH snapshots AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.source_api,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.geo,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.language,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.avg_monthly_searches,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition_index,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.low_top_of_page_bid,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.high_top_of_page_bid,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.raw_payload_json,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.data_freshness_status,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.created_at
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1
          WHERE ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.source_api = 'google_ads_keyword_planner'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.geo = 'US'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.language = 'en'::text) AND ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.raw_payload_json ->> 'pilot_run'::text) = 'us_en_tier1_controlled_150'::text))
        ), summary AS (
         SELECT 'summary'::text AS section,
            'pilot_snapshot_rows'::text AS metric,
            NULL::text AS keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::numeric AS value,
            NULL::text AS details
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'metrics_received'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (snapshots.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL)))::numeric AS count,
            NULL::text
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'api_not_connected'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (snapshots.data_freshness_status = 'api_not_connected'::text)))::numeric AS count,
            NULL::text
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'errors'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (0)::numeric AS "numeric",
            'No API call was made; Google Ads API tool/credentials unavailable in this session.'::text
        ), top_prepared AS (
         SELECT 'prepared_batch'::text AS section,
            m.keyword AS metric,
            m.keyword_norm,
            (m.product_count)::numeric AS value,
            ((((m.keyword_axis || ' / '::text) || m.keyword_pattern) || ' / '::text) || m.priority_tier) AS details
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m
             JOIN snapshots s ON ((s.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm)))
          ORDER BY m.product_count DESC, m.keyword
         LIMIT 150
        )
 SELECT summary.section,
    summary.metric,
    summary.keyword_norm,
    summary.value,
    summary.details
   FROM summary
UNION ALL
 SELECT top_prepared.section,
    top_prepared.metric,
    top_prepared.keyword_norm,
    top_prepared.value,
    top_prepared.details
   FROM top_prepared;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_queue_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_word_count,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    product_count,
    suggested_page_level,
    priority_tier,
    validation_priority,
    validation_status,
    requires_api_validation,
    reason,
    source,
    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m
  WHERE ((active_flag IS TRUE) AND (validation_status = 'queued'::text) AND (requires_api_validation IS TRUE) AND (keyword_word_count >= 2) AND (validation_priority <> 'low'::text) AND (COALESCE(reason, ''::text) !~~* '%size phrase%'::text) AND (COALESCE(reason, ''::text) !~~* '%bundle option%'::text) AND (keyword_norm <> ALL (ARRAY['full set'::text, 'whole product'::text, 'choose your set'::text, 'полный комплект'::text])) AND (keyword_norm !~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])(xxs|xs|s us|m us|l us|xl|2x|3x|size|размер|буквенный)([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_compatibility_block_rules_v1 r
          WHERE ((r.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (m.keyword_norm ~ r.block_regex) AND ((r.allowed_regex IS NULL) OR (m.keyword_norm !~ r.allowed_regex)))))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1
relations.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c.cleanup_id,

 SELECT qb.keyword_id,

    qb.keyword_axis AS queue_keyword_axis,
    qb.keyword_pattern AS queue_keyword_pattern,

    lc.keyword_pattern AS ai_keyword_pattern,
    lc.suggested_page_level AS ai_suggested_page_level,

    lc.model_name,
    lc.prompt_version,
    lc.review_status,
    lc.approved_keyword,
    lc.approved_keyword_norm,
    lc.approved_at,
    lc.created_at AS cleanup_created_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (lc.cleanup_id IS NULL) THEN 'needs_ai_cleanup'::text
            WHEN (lc.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) THEN 'needs_human_review'::text

            WHEN lc.should_validate_api THEN 'ready_for_metric_validation'::text
            ELSE 'cleaned_no_validation'::text
        END AS cleanup_pipeline_status
   FROM (queue_base qb
     LEFT JOIN latest_cleanup lc ON (((lc.keyword_norm = qb.keyword_norm) AND (lc.rn = 1))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_candidate_promotion_dry_run_v2
relations.definition:
WITH listing_master_norms AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT vw_seo_keyword_bank_v1_for_listing_master.keyword_norm

        ), bank_best_ranked AS (
         SELECT b.id,
            b.keyword,
            b.keyword_norm,
            b.bank_bucket,
            b.review_status,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.score,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,

            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.region,
            b.language,
            b.metric_source,
            b.page_type,
            b.role,
            b.role_label,
            b.last_checked,
            b.duplicate_count,
            b.reason,
            b.notes,
            b.source_files,
            b.created_at,
            b.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.keyword_norm ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) THEN 1

                END,
                CASE b.review_status
                    WHEN 'approved_draft'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'hold'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'reject'::text THEN 3

                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN 1
                    ELSE 9
                END, b.score DESC NULLS LAST, b.avg_monthly_searches DESC NULLS LAST, b.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, b.keyword) AS rn
           FROM (seo_keyword_bank_v1 b
             LEFT JOIN listing_master_norms lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = b.keyword_norm)))
        ), bank_best AS (
         SELECT bank_best_ranked.id,
            bank_best_ranked.keyword,
            bank_best_ranked.keyword_norm,
            bank_best_ranked.bank_bucket,
            bank_best_ranked.review_status,
            bank_best_ranked.source_clusters,
            bank_best_ranked.score,
            bank_best_ranked.avg_monthly_searches,
            bank_best_ranked.competition,
            bank_best_ranked.competition_index,
            bank_best_ranked.low_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.high_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.region,
            bank_best_ranked.language,
            bank_best_ranked.metric_source,
            bank_best_ranked.page_type,
            bank_best_ranked.role,
            bank_best_ranked.role_label,
            bank_best_ranked.last_checked,
            bank_best_ranked.duplicate_count,
            bank_best_ranked.reason,
            bank_best_ranked.notes,
            bank_best_ranked.source_files,
            bank_best_ranked.created_at,

            ((e.match_text ~~ '%rave%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%edm%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%festival%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%burning man%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%coachella%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%stage%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%performance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%drag%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%clubwear%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dancer%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%futuristic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cyberpunk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%post apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%desert%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cosmic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci-fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%punk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%glam%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%warrior%'::text)) AS has_event_style,
            to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%lego%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokemon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokémon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%barbie%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%disney%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wonder woman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%batman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%harry potter%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%star wars%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mandalorian%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%spongebob%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shrek%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%my little pony%'::text)) THEN 'franchise_brand'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%kids%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '% child%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%children%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%baby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%toddler%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dog costume%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pet costume%'::text)) THEN 'kids_pet'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%diy%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pattern%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%template%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sewing pattern%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%make your own%'::text)) THEN 'diy_pattern'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%bridal%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bride%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wedding%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bridesmaid%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%prom%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%homecoming%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%flapper%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gatsby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%renaissance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medieval%'::text)) THEN 'wrong_occasion'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%n95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%kn95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%surgical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%respirator%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dust mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gas mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%protective face mask%'::text)) THEN 'medical_safety'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%fall protection%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%safety harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%climbing harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wire harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wiring harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%osha%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%ansi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%lanyard%'::text)) THEN 'industrial_harness'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%necklace%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%earrings%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%diamond%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pearl jewelry%'::text)) THEN 'jewelry_only'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text)) AS block_flags
           FROM enriched e
        ), bucketed AS (
         SELECT f.candidate_keyword,
            f.candidate_keyword_norm,
            f.candidate_source,
            f.source_batch,
            f.source_row_type,
            f.avg_monthly_searches,
            f.competition,

            f.low_bid,
            f.high_bid,
            f.bid_currency,
            f.metric_source,
            f.metric_date,
            f.source_review_status,
            f.source_validation_status,
            f.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            f.source_bank_bucket,
            f.source_page_type,
            f.source_role,
            f.source_role_label,
            f.source_clusters,
            f.source_files,
            f.source_reason,
            f.source_notes,
            f.raw_json,
            f.source_priority,
            f.rn,
            f.exists_in_bank,
            f.exists_in_listing_master,
            f.bank_review_status,
            f.bank_bucket,
            f.match_text,
            f.has_metric,
            f.has_usable_metric,
            f.is_no_metric_unknown,
            f.has_component,
            f.has_material_color,
            f.is_faq_intent,
            f.is_commercial_intent,
            f.has_event_style,
            f.block_flags,
                CASE
                    WHEN f.is_faq_intent THEN 'faq'::text
                    WHEN f.is_commercial_intent THEN 'commercial_collection'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_component AND f.has_material_color) THEN 'product_or_alt'::text
                    WHEN f.has_component THEN 'product'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_material_color AND ((f.match_text ~~ '%outfit%'::text) OR (f.match_text ~~ '%costume%'::text) OR (f.match_text ~~ '%dress%'::text) OR (f.match_text ~~ '% set%'::text))) THEN 'visual_collection'::text
                    WHEN f.has_event_style THEN 'collection'::text
                    ELSE 'hold'::text
                END AS proposed_bank_bucket
           FROM flags f
        ), decided AS (
         SELECT b.candidate_keyword,
            b.candidate_keyword_norm,
            b.candidate_source,
            b.source_batch,
            b.source_row_type,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.bid_currency,
            b.metric_source,
            b.metric_date,
            b.source_review_status,
            b.source_validation_status,
            b.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            b.source_bank_bucket,
            b.source_page_type,
            b.source_role,
            b.source_role_label,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.source_files,
            b.source_reason,
            b.source_notes,
            b.raw_json,
            b.source_priority,
            b.rn,
            b.exists_in_bank,
            b.exists_in_listing_master,
            b.bank_review_status,
            b.bank_bucket,
            b.match_text,
            b.has_metric,
            b.has_usable_metric,
            b.is_no_metric_unknown,
            b.has_component,
            b.has_material_color,
            b.is_faq_intent,
            b.is_commercial_intent,
            b.has_event_style,
            b.block_flags,
            b.proposed_bank_bucket,
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(b.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'reject'::text
                    WHEN b.exists_in_bank THEN b.bank_review_status
                    WHEN (b.source_row_type = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (NOT b.has_usable_metric) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (b.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND ((b.competition IS NULL) OR (upper(b.competition) = 'UNKNOWN'::text))) THEN 'hold'::text
                    ELSE 'approved_draft'::text
                END AS proposed_review_status
           FROM bucketed b
        ), actioned AS (
         SELECT d.candidate_keyword,
            d.candidate_keyword_norm,
            d.candidate_source,
            d.source_batch,
            d.source_row_type,
            d.avg_monthly_searches,
            d.competition,
            d.competition_index,
            d.low_bid,
            d.high_bid,
            d.bid_currency,
            d.metric_source,
            d.metric_date,
            d.source_review_status,
            d.source_validation_status,
            d.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            d.source_bank_bucket,
            d.source_page_type,
            d.source_role,
            d.source_role_label,
            d.source_clusters,
            d.source_files,
            d.source_reason,
            d.source_notes,
            d.raw_json,
            d.source_priority,
            d.rn,
            d.exists_in_bank,
            d.exists_in_listing_master,
            d.bank_review_status,
            d.bank_bucket,
            d.match_text,
            d.has_metric,
            d.has_usable_metric,
            d.is_no_metric_unknown,
            d.has_component,
            d.has_material_color,
            d.is_faq_intent,
            d.is_commercial_intent,
            d.has_event_style,
            d.block_flags,
            d.proposed_bank_bucket,
            d.proposed_review_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.exists_in_bank THEN 'excluded_duplicate'::text
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(d.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'excluded_noise'::text
                    WHEN (d.source_row_type = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'needs_manual_review_related_idea'::text
                    WHEN (NOT d.has_usable_metric) THEN 'needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text
                    WHEN (d.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(d.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND ((d.competition IS NULL) OR (upper(d.competition) = 'UNKNOWN'::text))) THEN 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text
                    ELSE 'would_insert'::text
                END AS dry_run_action
           FROM decided d
        )
 SELECT candidate_keyword,
    candidate_keyword_norm,
    candidate_source,
    source_batch,
    source_row_type,
    exists_in_bank,
    exists_in_listing_master,
    has_metric,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_bid,
    high_bid,
    bid_currency,
    metric_source,
    metric_date,
    source_review_status,
    source_validation_status,
    cleanup_pipeline_status,
    source_bank_bucket,
    source_page_type,
    source_role,
    source_role_label,
    proposed_bank_bucket,
    proposed_review_status,
    block_flags,
    dry_run_action,
        CASE
            WHEN exists_in_bank THEN 'Already exists in canonical seo_keyword_bank_v1; no insert.'::text
            WHEN (jsonb_array_length(block_flags) > 0) THEN ('Excluded by block flags: '::text || (block_flags)::text)
            WHEN (source_row_type = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'Google Ads related idea; keep on hold for manual review before any bank promotion.'::text
            WHEN (NOT has_usable_metric) THEN 'No usable metric: UNKNOWN/null metric is not eligible for promotion.'::text
            WHEN (proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'Could not classify into safe keyword bank bucket; manual review required.'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND ((competition IS NULL) OR (upper(competition) = 'UNKNOWN'::text))) THEN 'Zero/empty metric; manual review required.'::text
            WHEN ((bid_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (bid_currency <> 'USD'::text)) THEN (('Clean candidate with usable metric. bid_currency='::text || bid_currency) || ', do_not_copy_bid_to_bank_without_currency_logic.'::text)
            ELSE 'Clean candidate with usable metric; can be considered for future guarded promotion.'::text
        END AS reason,
    source_clusters,
    source_files,
    source_reason,
    source_notes,
    (raw_json || jsonb_build_object('source_batch', source_batch, 'source_row_type', source_row_type, 'bid_currency', bid_currency, 'has_usable_metric', has_usable_metric, 'is_no_metric_unknown', is_no_metric_unknown, 'bank_review_status', bank_review_status, 'bank_bucket', bank_bucket, 'classification_flags', jsonb_build_object('has_component', has_component, 'has_material_color', has_material_color, 'is_faq_intent', is_faq_intent, 'is_commercial_intent', is_commercial_intent, 'has_event_style', has_event_style))) AS raw_json
   FROM actioned;

                    WHEN (g.export_group = ANY (ARRAY['event_component'::text, 'material_component'::text])) THEN 'P2'::text

        ), source_candidates AS (
         SELECT 'feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1'::text AS candidate_source,
            1 AS source_priority,
            m.keyword AS source_keyword,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, m.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS source_keyword_norm,
            NULL::integer AS source_avg_monthly_searches,
            NULL::text AS source_competition,
            NULL::numeric AS source_competition_index,
            NULL::numeric AS source_low_bid,
            NULL::numeric AS source_high_bid,
            NULL::text AS source_metric_source,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS source_metric_date,
            c.review_status AS source_review_status,

            concat_ws(', '::text, m.keyword_axis, m.keyword_pattern) AS source_clusters,
            m.source AS source_files,
            m.reason AS source_reason,
            NULL::text AS source_notes,
            jsonb_build_object('source_table', 'feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1', 'keyword_id', m.keyword_id, 'keyword_axis', m.keyword_axis, 'keyword_pattern', m.keyword_pattern, 'suggested_page_level', m.suggested_page_level, 'priority_tier', m.priority_tier, 'validation_priority', m.validation_priority, 'validation_status', m.validation_status, 'requires_api_validation', m.requires_api_validation, 'product_count', m.product_count, 'sample_products', m.sample_products, 'cleanup_id', c.cleanup_id, 'cleanup_review_status', c.review_status, 'ai_rewrite_status', c.ai_rewrite_status, 'ai_intent', c.ai_intent, 'warning_flags', c.warning_flags, 'ai_reason', c.ai_reason) AS source_raw_json
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m

          WHERE ((m.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, m.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1'::text AS candidate_source,
            2 AS source_priority,
            r.keyword AS source_keyword,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(r.keyword_norm, r.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS source_keyword_norm,
            r.avg_monthly_searches AS source_avg_monthly_searches,
            r.competition AS source_competition,
            r.competition_index AS source_competition_index,
            r.low_top_of_page_bid AS source_low_bid,

                CASE

                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS source_metric_source,
            r.latest_metric_fetched_at AS source_metric_date,
            r.review_status AS source_review_status,
            r.metric_validation_status AS source_validation_status,
            concat_ws(' / '::text, r.review_status, r.metric_validation_status, r.recommendation_status) AS cleanup_pipeline_status,
            r.suggested_page_level AS source_bank_bucket,
            r.suggested_page_level AS source_page_type,
            r.recommendation_status AS source_role,
            (r.recommendation_score)::text AS source_role_label,
            concat_ws(', '::text, r.keyword_axis, r.keyword_pattern) AS source_clusters,
            'feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1'::text AS source_files,

           FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1 r
          WHERE (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(r.keyword_norm, r.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1'::text AS candidate_source,
            3 AS source_priority,
            lm.keyword_norm AS source_keyword,
            lm.keyword_norm AS source_keyword_norm,
            lm.avg_monthly_searches AS source_avg_monthly_searches,
            lm.competition AS source_competition,
            lm.competition_index AS source_competition_index,
            lm.low_top_of_page_bid AS source_low_bid,
            lm.high_top_of_page_bid AS source_high_bid,

            lm.data_freshness_status AS source_review_status,
            lm.data_freshness_status AS source_validation_status,
            lm.data_freshness_status AS cleanup_pipeline_status,
            NULL::text AS source_bank_bucket,
            NULL::text AS source_page_type,
            NULL::text AS source_role,
            NULL::text AS source_role_label,
            NULL::text AS source_clusters,
            'feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1'::text AS source_files,
            lm.data_freshness_status AS source_reason,
            NULL::text AS source_notes,
            jsonb_build_object('source_table', 'feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1', 'source_api', lm.source_api, 'geo', lm.geo, 'language', lm.language, 'data_freshness_status', lm.data_freshness_status, 'raw_payload_json', lm.raw_payload_json) AS source_raw_json
           FROM latest_metrics lm
        ), normalized_candidates AS (
         SELECT sc.candidate_source,
            sc.source_priority,
            sc.source_keyword,
            sc.source_keyword_norm,
            sc.source_avg_monthly_searches,
            sc.source_competition,
            sc.source_competition_index,
            sc.source_low_bid,
            sc.source_high_bid,
            sc.source_metric_source,

            sc.source_role,
            sc.source_role_label,
            sc.source_clusters,
            sc.source_files,
            sc.source_reason,
            sc.source_notes,
            sc.source_raw_json,
            NULLIF(btrim(sc.source_keyword), ''::text) AS candidate_keyword,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(sc.source_keyword_norm, sc.source_keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS candidate_keyword_norm
           FROM source_candidates sc
        ), deduped_candidates AS (
         SELECT x.candidate_source,
            x.source_priority,
            x.source_keyword,
            x.source_keyword_norm,
            x.source_avg_monthly_searches,
            x.source_competition,
            x.source_competition_index,
            x.source_low_bid,
            x.source_high_bid,
            x.source_metric_source,
            x.source_metric_date,
            x.source_review_status,
            x.source_validation_status,
            x.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            x.source_bank_bucket,
            x.source_page_type,
            x.source_role,
            x.source_role_label,
            x.source_clusters,
            x.source_files,
            x.source_reason,
            x.source_notes,
            x.source_raw_json,
            x.candidate_keyword,
            x.candidate_keyword_norm,
            x.rn
           FROM ( SELECT nc.candidate_source,
                    nc.source_priority,
                    nc.source_keyword,
                    nc.source_keyword_norm,
                    nc.source_avg_monthly_searches,
                    nc.source_competition,
                    nc.source_competition_index,
                    nc.source_low_bid,
                    nc.source_high_bid,
                    nc.source_metric_source,
                    nc.source_metric_date,
                    nc.source_review_status,
                    nc.source_validation_status,
                    nc.cleanup_pipeline_status,
                    nc.source_bank_bucket,
                    nc.source_page_type,
                    nc.source_role,
                    nc.source_role_label,
                    nc.source_clusters,
                    nc.source_files,
                    nc.source_reason,
                    nc.source_notes,
                    nc.source_raw_json,
                    nc.candidate_keyword,
                    nc.candidate_keyword_norm,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY nc.candidate_keyword_norm ORDER BY nc.source_priority, nc.source_metric_date DESC NULLS LAST, nc.candidate_keyword) AS rn
                   FROM normalized_candidates nc
                  WHERE (NULLIF(nc.candidate_keyword_norm, ''::text) IS NOT NULL)) x
          WHERE (x.rn = 1)
        ), enriched AS (
         SELECT d.candidate_keyword,
            d.candidate_keyword_norm,
            d.candidate_source,
            (b.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) AS exists_in_bank,
            (lmv.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) AS exists_in_listing_master,
            COALESCE(mt.avg_monthly_searches, d.source_avg_monthly_searches) AS avg_monthly_searches,
            COALESCE(mt.competition, d.source_competition) AS competition,
            COALESCE(mt.competition_index, d.source_competition_index) AS competition_index,
            COALESCE(mt.low_top_of_page_bid, d.source_low_bid) AS low_bid,
            COALESCE(mt.high_top_of_page_bid, d.source_high_bid) AS high_bid,
            COALESCE(mt.source_api, d.source_metric_source) AS metric_source,
            COALESCE(mt.fetched_at, d.source_metric_date) AS metric_date,
            COALESCE(d.source_review_status, b.review_status) AS source_review_status,
            d.source_validation_status,
            d.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            COALESCE(b.bank_bucket, d.source_bank_bucket) AS source_bank_bucket,
            COALESCE(b.page_type, d.source_page_type) AS source_page_type,
            COALESCE(b.role, d.source_role) AS source_role,
            COALESCE(b.role_label, d.source_role_label) AS source_role_label,
            COALESCE(b.source_clusters, d.source_clusters) AS source_clusters,
            COALESCE(b.source_files, d.source_files) AS source_files,
            COALESCE(b.reason, d.source_reason) AS source_reason,
            COALESCE(b.notes, d.source_notes) AS source_notes,
            b.review_status AS bank_review_status,
            b.bank_bucket,
            d.source_raw_json,
            lower(d.candidate_keyword_norm) AS match_text
           FROM (((deduped_candidates d
             LEFT JOIN latest_metrics mt ON ((mt.keyword_norm = d.candidate_keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN bank_best b ON ((b.keyword_norm = d.candidate_keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN listing_master_norms lmv ON ((lmv.keyword_norm = d.candidate_keyword_norm)))
        ), flags AS (
         SELECT e.candidate_keyword,
            e.candidate_keyword_norm,
            e.candidate_source,
            e.exists_in_bank,
            e.exists_in_listing_master,
            e.avg_monthly_searches,
            e.competition,
            e.competition_index,
            e.low_bid,
            e.high_bid,
            e.metric_source,
            e.metric_date,
            e.source_review_status,
            e.source_validation_status,
            e.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            e.source_bank_bucket,
            e.source_page_type,
            e.source_role,
            e.source_role_label,
            e.source_clusters,
            e.source_files,
            e.source_reason,
            e.source_notes,
            e.bank_review_status,
            e.bank_bucket,
            e.source_raw_json,
            e.match_text,
            ((e.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) OR (e.competition IS NOT NULL) OR (e.competition_index IS NOT NULL) OR (e.low_bid IS NOT NULL) OR (e.high_bid IS NOT NULL) OR (e.metric_source IS NOT NULL)) AS has_metric,
            ((e.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) OR (e.competition IS NOT NULL) OR (e.competition_index IS NOT NULL) OR (e.low_bid IS NOT NULL) OR (e.high_bid IS NOT NULL)) AS has_real_metric_signal,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%armor%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%armour%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shoulder%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shoulders%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bracer%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%arm cuff%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%choker%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%collar%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bodysuit%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%body suit%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%headpiece%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%head piece%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%horn%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%corset%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%skirt%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dress%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%belt%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%chain%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wings%'::text)) AS has_component,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%gold%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%silver%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mirror%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%metallic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%reflective%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%holographic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%chrome%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%leather%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%acrylic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%black%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%white%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%iridescent%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shiny%'::text)) AS has_material_color,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%rave%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%edm%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%festival%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%burning man%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%coachella%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%stage%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%performance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%drag%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%clubwear%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dancer%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%futuristic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cyberpunk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%post apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%desert%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cosmic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci-fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%punk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%glam%'::text)) AS has_event_style,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%outfit%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%costume%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dress%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '% set%'::text)) AS has_visual_product_word,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%price%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cost%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shipping%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%delivery%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%size%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sizing%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%how to%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%what to wear%'::text)) AS is_faq_intent,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%buy%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shop%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%order%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%custom%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%handmade%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%for sale%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%online%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%website%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%store%'::text)) AS is_commercial_intent,
            to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%lego%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokemon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokémon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%barbie%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%disney%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wonder woman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%batman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%harry potter%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%star wars%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mandalorian%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%spongebob%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shrek%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%my little pony%'::text)) THEN 'franchise_brand'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%kids%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '% child%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%children%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%baby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%toddler%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dog costume%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pet costume%'::text)) THEN 'kids_pet'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%diy%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pattern%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%template%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sewing pattern%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%make your own%'::text)) THEN 'diy_pattern'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%bridal%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bride%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wedding%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bridesmaid%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%prom%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%homecoming%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%flapper%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gatsby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%renaissance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medieval%'::text)) THEN 'wrong_occasion'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%n95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%kn95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%surgical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%respirator%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dust mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gas mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%protective face mask%'::text)) THEN 'medical_safety'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%fall protection%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%safety harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%climbing harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wire harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wiring harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%osha%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%ansi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%lanyard%'::text)) THEN 'industrial_harness'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%necklace%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%earrings%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%diamond%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pearl jewelry%'::text)) THEN 'jewelry_only'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text)) AS block_flags
           FROM enriched e
        ), bucketed AS (
         SELECT f.candidate_keyword,
            f.candidate_keyword_norm,
            f.candidate_source,
            f.exists_in_bank,
            f.exists_in_listing_master,
            f.avg_monthly_searches,
            f.competition,
            f.competition_index,
            f.low_bid,
            f.high_bid,
            f.metric_source,
            f.metric_date,
            f.source_review_status,
            f.source_validation_status,
            f.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            f.source_bank_bucket,
            f.source_page_type,
            f.source_role,
            f.source_role_label,
            f.source_clusters,
            f.source_files,
            f.source_reason,
            f.source_notes,
            f.bank_review_status,
            f.bank_bucket,
            f.source_raw_json,
            f.match_text,
            f.has_metric,
            f.has_real_metric_signal,
            f.has_component,
            f.has_material_color,
            f.has_event_style,
            f.has_visual_product_word,
            f.is_faq_intent,
            f.is_commercial_intent,
            f.block_flags,
                CASE
                    WHEN f.is_faq_intent THEN 'faq'::text
                    WHEN f.is_commercial_intent THEN 'commercial_collection'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_component AND f.has_material_color) THEN 'product_or_alt'::text
                    WHEN f.has_component THEN 'product'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_material_color AND f.has_visual_product_word) THEN 'visual_collection'::text
                    WHEN f.has_event_style THEN 'collection'::text
                    ELSE 'hold'::text
                END AS proposed_bank_bucket
           FROM flags f
        ), decided AS (
         SELECT b.candidate_keyword,
            b.candidate_keyword_norm,
            b.candidate_source,
            b.exists_in_bank,
            b.exists_in_listing_master,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.metric_source,
            b.metric_date,
            b.source_review_status,
            b.source_validation_status,
            b.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            b.source_bank_bucket,
            b.source_page_type,
            b.source_role,
            b.source_role_label,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.source_files,
            b.source_reason,
            b.source_notes,
            b.bank_review_status,
            b.bank_bucket,
            b.source_raw_json,
            b.match_text,
            b.has_metric,
            b.has_real_metric_signal,
            b.has_component,
            b.has_material_color,
            b.has_event_style,
            b.has_visual_product_word,
            b.is_faq_intent,
            b.is_commercial_intent,
            b.block_flags,
            b.proposed_bank_bucket,
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(b.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'reject'::text
                    WHEN b.exists_in_bank THEN b.bank_review_status
                    WHEN (NOT b.has_metric) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (b.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND (b.competition IS NULL)) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (NOT b.has_real_metric_signal) THEN 'hold'::text
                    ELSE 'approved_draft'::text
                END AS proposed_review_status
           FROM bucketed b
        ), actioned AS (
         SELECT d.candidate_keyword,
            d.candidate_keyword_norm,
            d.candidate_source,
            d.exists_in_bank,
            d.exists_in_listing_master,
            d.avg_monthly_searches,
            d.competition,
            d.competition_index,
            d.low_bid,
            d.high_bid,
            d.metric_source,
            d.metric_date,
            d.source_review_status,
            d.source_validation_status,
            d.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            d.source_bank_bucket,
            d.source_page_type,
            d.source_role,
            d.source_role_label,
            d.source_clusters,
            d.source_files,
            d.source_reason,
            d.source_notes,
            d.bank_review_status,
            d.bank_bucket,
            d.source_raw_json,
            d.match_text,
            d.has_metric,
            d.has_real_metric_signal,
            d.has_component,
            d.has_material_color,
            d.has_event_style,
            d.has_visual_product_word,
            d.is_faq_intent,
            d.is_commercial_intent,
            d.block_flags,
            d.proposed_bank_bucket,
            d.proposed_review_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.exists_in_bank THEN 'excluded_duplicate'::text
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(d.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'excluded_noise'::text
                    WHEN (NOT d.has_metric) THEN 'needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text
                    WHEN (d.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text
                    WHEN (((d.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (d.competition IS NULL) AND (d.competition_index IS NULL) AND (d.low_bid IS NULL) AND (d.high_bid IS NULL)) OR ((COALESCE(d.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND (d.competition IS NULL))) THEN 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text
                    WHEN (d.proposed_review_status = 'approved_draft'::text) THEN 'would_insert'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text
                END AS dry_run_action
           FROM decided d
        )
 SELECT candidate_keyword,
    candidate_keyword_norm,
    candidate_source,
    exists_in_bank,
    exists_in_listing_master,
    has_metric,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_bid,
    high_bid,
    metric_source,
    metric_date,
    source_review_status,
    source_validation_status,
    cleanup_pipeline_status,
    source_bank_bucket,
    source_page_type,
    source_role,
    source_role_label,
    proposed_bank_bucket,
    proposed_review_status,
    block_flags,
    dry_run_action,
        CASE
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text) THEN 'Уже есть в canonical seo_keyword_bank_v1; не вставлять повторно.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'excluded_noise'::text) THEN ('Исключено rule-based block flags: '::text || (block_flags)::text)
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text) THEN 'Нет метрик и нет metric source; сначала отправить на Google Ads / ручную проверку.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text) THEN 'Не удалось уверенно определить валидный bucket; нужен ручной review.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text) THEN 'Метрика пустая или нулевая; не auto-approve.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) THEN 'Чистый кандидат: не дубликат, без block flags, есть метрики, bucket валиден; можно готовить guarded insert.'::text
            ELSE 'Нужен ручной review.'::text
        END AS reason,
    source_clusters,
    source_files,
    source_reason,
    source_notes,
    (source_raw_json || jsonb_build_object('exists_in_bank', exists_in_bank, 'exists_in_listing_master', exists_in_listing_master, 'has_metric', has_metric, 'has_real_metric_signal', has_real_metric_signal, 'bank_review_status', bank_review_status, 'bank_bucket', bank_bucket, 'classification_flags', jsonb_build_object('has_component', has_component, 'has_material_color', has_material_color, 'has_event_style', has_event_style, 'is_faq_intent', is_faq_intent, 'is_commercial_intent', is_commercial_intent, 'has_visual_product_word', has_visual_product_word))) AS raw_json
   FROM actioned;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_export_google_ads_keywords_o
feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_export_google_ads_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY
        CASE suggested_page_level
            WHEN 'product'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'collection'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'image_alt'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 9
        END, keyword_axis, keyword_for_validation) AS export_row_num,
    keyword_for_validation AS keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_id,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    should_use_for_product,
    should_use_for_collection,
    should_use_for_image_alt,
    metric_geo AS geo,
    metric_language AS language,
    'feya_seo_metric_import_001'::text AS suggested_batch_code,
    metric_validation_status
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1
  WHERE (metric_validation_status = ANY (ARRAY['needs_metric_import'::text, 'metrics_stale'::text]));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_ready_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT s.import_row_id,
    s.batch_code,
    COALESCE(s.keyword, m.keyword) AS keyword,
    regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm,
    s.geo,
    s.language,
    s.avg_monthly_searches,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.competition IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'низкая'::text) THEN 'LOW'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'средняя'::text) THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'высокая'::text) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            ELSE upper(s.competition)
        END AS competition,
    s.competition_index,
    s.low_top_of_page_bid,
    s.high_top_of_page_bid,
    s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
    s.source_file_name,
    s.imported_at,
    s.import_status,
    s.import_note
   FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
     JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
     JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
  WHERE ((NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (s.competition IS NULL) AND (s.competition_index IS NULL))) AND ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) OR (s.avg_monthly_searches >= 0)) AND ((s.competition IS NULL) OR (lower(s.competition) = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_template_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'feya_seo_metric_import_001'::text AS batch_code,
    keyword,

    'US'::text AS geo,
    'en'::text AS language,
    NULL::integer AS avg_monthly_searches,
    NULL::text AS competition,
    NULL::numeric AS competition_index,
    NULL::numeric AS low_top_of_page_bid,
    NULL::numeric AS high_top_of_page_bid,
    NULL::text AS monthly_search_volumes_raw,
    'google_ads_keyword_planner_csv'::text AS source_file_name,

   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_export_google_ads_v1
