relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_validation_report_v1
relations.definition:
WITH staging AS (
         SELECT s.import_row_id,
            s.batch_code,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.geo,
            s.language,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            s.source_file_name,
            s.imported_at,
            s.import_status,
            s.import_note,
            s.created_at,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            m.keyword_id,
            m.keyword AS master_keyword,
            m.validation_status AS master_validation_status,
            m.priority_tier AS master_priority_tier,
            m.validation_priority AS master_validation_priority,
            e.keyword_norm AS export_keyword_norm
           FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
        ), row_checks AS (
         SELECT staging.import_row_id,
            staging.batch_code,
            staging.keyword,
            staging.keyword_norm,
            staging.geo,
            staging.language,
            staging.avg_monthly_searches,
            staging.competition,
            staging.competition_index,
            staging.low_top_of_page_bid,
            staging.high_top_of_page_bid,
            staging.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            staging.source_file_name,
            staging.imported_at,
            staging.import_status,
            staging.import_note,
            staging.created_at,
            staging.keyword_norm_clean,
            staging.keyword_id,
            staging.master_keyword,
            staging.master_validation_status,
            staging.master_priority_tier,
            staging.master_validation_priority,
            staging.export_keyword_norm,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(staging.keyword_norm_clean, ''::text) IS NULL) THEN 'invalid_empty_keyword_norm'::text
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN 'not_matched_to_keyword_master'::text
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN 'not_in_expected_export_batch'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (staging.competition IS NULL) AND (staging.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN 'missing_metrics'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.competition IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(staging.competition) <> ALL (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))) THEN 'competition_value_needs_review'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) AND (staging.avg_monthly_searches < 0)) THEN 'negative_volume_invalid'::text
                    ELSE 'ready_for_snapshot'::text
                END AS validation_result,
                CASE
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (staging.competition IS NULL) AND (staging.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.competition IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(staging.competition) <> ALL (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) AND (staging.avg_monthly_searches < 0)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS needs_manual_review
           FROM staging
        ), summary AS (
         SELECT 'summary'::text AS section,
            'imported_rows'::text AS metric,
            NULL::text AS batch_code,
            NULL::text AS keyword,
            NULL::text AS keyword_norm,
            count(*) AS row_count,
            NULL::text AS validation_result,
            NULL::boolean AS needs_manual_review
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'matched_to_keyword_master'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.keyword_id IS NOT NULL)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'not_matched_to_keyword_master'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.keyword_id IS NULL)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'ready_for_snapshot'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'ready_for_snapshot'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'missing_metrics'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'missing_metrics'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'competition_value_needs_review'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'competition_value_needs_review'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'needs_manual_review'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.needs_manual_review IS TRUE)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        ), detail AS (
         SELECT 'detail'::text AS section,
            COALESCE(row_checks.validation_result, 'unknown'::text) AS metric,
            row_checks.batch_code,
            COALESCE(row_checks.keyword, row_checks.master_keyword) AS keyword,
            row_checks.keyword_norm_clean AS keyword_norm,
            NULL::bigint AS row_count,
            row_checks.validation_result,
            row_checks.needs_manual_review
           FROM row_checks
        )
 SELECT summary.section,
    summary.metric,
    summary.batch_code,
    summary.keyword,
    summary.keyword_norm,
    summary.row_count,
    summary.validation_result,
    summary.needs_manual_review
   FROM summary
UNION ALL
 SELECT detail.section,
    detail.metric,
    detail.batch_code,
    detail.keyword,
    detail.keyword_norm,
    detail.row_count,
    detail.validation_result,
    detail.needs_manual_review
   FROM detail;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1
relations.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c_1.cleanup_id,
            c_1.run_id,
            c_1.keyword_id,
            c_1.keyword_norm,
            c_1.original_keyword,
            c_1.cleaned_keyword,
            c_1.suggested_keyword,
            c_1.keyword_axis,
            c_1.keyword_pattern,
            c_1.suggested_page_level,
            c_1.ai_intent,
            c_1.ai_rewrite_status,
            c_1.should_validate_api,
            c_1.should_use_for_product,
            c_1.should_use_for_collection,
            c_1.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c_1.should_hold,
            c_1.warning_flags,
            c_1.ai_reason,
            c_1.model_name,
            c_1.prompt_version,
            c_1.source_queue_snapshot,
            c_1.raw_ai_response_json,
            c_1.review_status,
            c_1.approved_keyword,
            c_1.approved_keyword_norm,
            c_1.approved_at,
            c_1.approved_by,
            c_1.created_at,
            c_1.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_1.keyword_norm ORDER BY c_1.created_at DESC, c_1.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c_1
        ), latest_metrics AS (
         SELECT m.snapshot_id,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.source_api,
            m.geo,
            m.language,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            m.competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            m.data_freshness_status,
            m.created_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.keyword_norm, m.geo, m.language ORDER BY m.fetched_at DESC, m.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 m
        )
 SELECT c.cleanup_id,
    c.keyword_id,
    c.keyword_norm,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.suggested_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(c.cleaned_keyword, ''::text), c.keyword_norm) AS keyword_for_validation,
    c.original_keyword,
    c.cleaned_keyword,
    c.suggested_keyword,
    c.keyword_axis,
    c.keyword_pattern,
    c.suggested_page_level,
    c.ai_intent,
    c.ai_rewrite_status,
    c.should_validate_api,
    c.should_use_for_product,
    c.should_use_for_collection,
    c.should_use_for_image_alt,
    c.should_hold,
    c.warning_flags,
    c.ai_reason,
    c.review_status,
    COALESCE(lm.geo, 'US'::text) AS metric_geo,
    COALESCE(lm.language, 'en'::text) AS metric_language,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.low_top_of_page_bid,
    lm.high_top_of_page_bid,
    lm.fetched_at AS latest_metric_fetched_at,
        CASE
            WHEN c.should_hold THEN 'hold'::text
            WHEN (c.should_validate_api IS NOT TRUE) THEN 'no_metric_needed'::text
            WHEN (lm.snapshot_id IS NULL) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(lm.data_freshness_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['api_not_connected'::text, 'placeholder'::text, 'mock'::text, 'no_real_metrics'::text])) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN ((lm.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (lm.competition IS NULL) AND (lm.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN (lm.fetched_at < (now() - '90 days'::interval)) THEN 'metrics_stale'::text
            ELSE 'has_fresh_metrics'::text
        END AS metric_validation_status,
    c.created_at AS cleanup_created_at,
    c.updated_at AS cleanup_updated_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_data_freshness_status
   FROM (latest_cleanup c
     LEFT JOIN latest_metrics lm ON (((lm.keyword_norm = c.keyword_norm) AND (lm.rn = 1))))
  WHERE ((c.rn = 1) AND (c.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) AND (c.should_validate_api IS TRUE) AND (c.should_hold IS FALSE));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_p1_guarded_promotion_dry_run_v1
relations.definition:
WITH p1_batches(batch_code) AS (
         VALUES ('P1_CRITICAL_BATCH_01_GOOGLE_ADS_2026_07_08'::text), ('P1_CRITICAL_BATCH_02_GOOGLE_ADS_2026_07_08'::text), ('P1_CRITICAL_BATCH_03_GOOGLE_ADS_2026_07_08'::text)
        ), latest_staging_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            s.batch_code,
            s.keyword,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.imported_at,
            s.import_status,
            s.import_note,
            s.source_file_name,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"source_row_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS source_row_type,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"currency"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS bid_currency,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"metric_source"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS metric_source,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END, s.imported_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.import_row_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
             JOIN p1_batches b ON ((b.batch_code = s.batch_code)))
          WHERE (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), latest_staging AS (
         SELECT latest_staging_ranked.keyword_norm_clean,
            latest_staging_ranked.batch_code,
            latest_staging_ranked.keyword,
            latest_staging_ranked.avg_monthly_searches,
            latest_staging_ranked.competition,
            latest_staging_ranked.competition_index,
            latest_staging_ranked.low_top_of_page_bid,
            latest_staging_ranked.high_top_of_page_bid,
            latest_staging_ranked.imported_at,
            latest_staging_ranked.import_status,
            latest_staging_ranked.import_note,
            latest_staging_ranked.source_file_name,
            latest_staging_ranked.source_row_type,
            latest_staging_ranked.bid_currency,
            latest_staging_ranked.metric_source,
            latest_staging_ranked.rn
           FROM latest_staging_ranked
          WHERE (latest_staging_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), latest_snapshot_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            m.competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.source_api,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            (m.raw_payload_json ->> 'batch_code'::text) AS batch_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'import_row_id'::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text) THEN ((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'import_row_id'::text))::bigint
                    ELSE NULL::bigint
                END AS import_row_id,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (m.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END, m.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, m.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 m
             JOIN p1_batches b ON ((b.batch_code = (m.raw_payload_json ->> 'batch_code'::text))))
          WHERE (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), latest_snapshot AS (
         SELECT m.keyword_norm_clean,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            m.competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.source_api,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            m.batch_code,
            m.import_row_id,
            m.rn,
            st.source_row_type AS staging_source_row_type,
            st.bid_currency AS staging_bid_currency,
            st.metric_source AS staging_metric_source,
            st.source_file_name AS staging_source_file_name,
            st.import_status AS staging_import_status,
            st.import_note AS staging_import_note
           FROM (latest_snapshot_ranked m
             LEFT JOIN latest_staging st ON ((st.keyword_norm_clean = m.keyword_norm_clean)))
          WHERE (m.rn = 1)
        ), p1_metric_keywords AS (
         SELECT latest_staging.keyword_norm_clean
           FROM latest_staging
        UNION
         SELECT latest_snapshot.keyword_norm_clean
           FROM latest_snapshot
        ), bank_best_ranked AS (
         SELECT b.keyword_norm,
            b.review_status,
            b.bank_bucket,
            b.page_type,
            b.role,
            b.role_label,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.metric_source,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.keyword_norm ORDER BY
                CASE b.review_status
                    WHEN 'approved_draft'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'hold'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'reject'::text THEN 3
                    ELSE 9
                END, b.avg_monthly_searches DESC NULLS LAST, b.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
           FROM seo_keyword_bank_v1 b
        ), bank_best AS (
         SELECT bank_best_ranked.keyword_norm,
            bank_best_ranked.review_status,
            bank_best_ranked.bank_bucket,
            bank_best_ranked.page_type,
            bank_best_ranked.role,
            bank_best_ranked.role_label,
            bank_best_ranked.avg_monthly_searches,
            bank_best_ranked.competition,
            bank_best_ranked.competition_index,
            bank_best_ranked.metric_source,
            bank_best_ranked.low_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.high_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.updated_at,
            bank_best_ranked.rn
           FROM bank_best_ranked
          WHERE (bank_best_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), lm_norms AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT vw_seo_keyword_bank_v1_for_listing_master.keyword_norm
           FROM vw_seo_keyword_bank_v1_for_listing_master
        ), base AS (
         SELECT v2.candidate_keyword,
            v2.candidate_keyword_norm,
            v2.candidate_source,
            v2.source_batch,
            v2.source_row_type,
            v2.exists_in_bank,
            v2.exists_in_listing_master,
            v2.has_metric,
            v2.avg_monthly_searches,
            v2.competition,
            v2.competition_index,
            v2.low_bid,
            v2.high_bid,
            v2.bid_currency,
            v2.metric_source,
            v2.metric_date,
            v2.source_review_status,
            v2.source_validation_status,
            v2.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            v2.source_bank_bucket,
            v2.source_page_type,
            v2.source_role,
            v2.source_role_label,
            v2.proposed_bank_bucket,
            v2.proposed_review_status,
            v2.block_flags,
            v2.dry_run_action,
            v2.reason,
            v2.source_clusters,
            v2.source_files,
            v2.source_reason,
            v2.source_notes,
            v2.raw_json,
            COALESCE(ls.batch_code, st.batch_code, v2.source_batch) AS p1_source_batch,
            COALESCE(ls.staging_source_row_type, st.source_row_type, v2.source_row_type) AS p1_source_row_type,
            COALESCE(ls.avg_monthly_searches, st.avg_monthly_searches, v2.avg_monthly_searches) AS p1_avg_monthly_searches,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(ls.competition, ''::text), NULLIF(st.competition, ''::text), NULLIF(v2.competition, ''::text)) AS p1_competition,
            COALESCE(ls.competition_index, st.competition_index, v2.competition_index) AS p1_competition_index,
            COALESCE(ls.low_top_of_page_bid, st.low_top_of_page_bid, v2.low_bid) AS p1_low_bid,
            COALESCE(ls.high_top_of_page_bid, st.high_top_of_page_bid, v2.high_bid) AS p1_high_bid,
            COALESCE(ls.staging_bid_currency, st.bid_currency, v2.bid_currency) AS p1_bid_currency,
            COALESCE(ls.staging_metric_source, st.metric_source, v2.metric_source, ls.source_api) AS p1_metric_source,
            COALESCE(ls.fetched_at, st.imported_at, v2.metric_date) AS p1_metric_date,
            bb.review_status AS current_bank_review_status,
            bb.bank_bucket AS current_bank_bucket,
            bb.page_type AS current_page_type,
            (lm.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) AS current_visible_in_listing_master
           FROM ((((feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_candidate_promotion_dry_run_v2 v2
             LEFT JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ((ls.keyword_norm_clean = v2.candidate_keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN latest_staging st ON ((st.keyword_norm_clean = v2.candidate_keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN bank_best bb ON ((bb.keyword_norm = v2.candidate_keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN lm_norms lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = v2.candidate_keyword_norm)))
          WHERE ((v2.source_batch IN ( SELECT p1_batches.batch_code
                   FROM p1_batches)) OR (v2.candidate_keyword_norm IN ( SELECT p1_metric_keywords.keyword_norm_clean
                   FROM p1_metric_keywords)))
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT b.candidate_keyword,
            b.candidate_keyword_norm,
            b.candidate_source,
            b.source_batch,
            b.source_row_type,
            b.exists_in_bank,
            b.exists_in_listing_master,
            b.has_metric,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.bid_currency,
            b.metric_source,
            b.metric_date,
            b.source_review_status,
            b.source_validation_status,
            b.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            b.source_bank_bucket,
            b.source_page_type,
            b.source_role,
            b.source_role_label,
            b.proposed_bank_bucket,
            b.proposed_review_status,
            b.block_flags,
            b.dry_run_action,
            b.reason,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.source_files,
            b.source_reason,
            b.source_notes,
            b.raw_json,
            b.p1_source_batch,
            b.p1_source_row_type,
            b.p1_avg_monthly_searches,
            b.p1_competition,
            b.p1_competition_index,
            b.p1_low_bid,
            b.p1_high_bid,
            b.p1_bid_currency,
            b.p1_metric_source,
            b.p1_metric_date,
            b.current_bank_review_status,
            b.current_bank_bucket,
            b.current_page_type,
            b.current_visible_in_listing_master,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.exists_in_bank OR (b.dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text)) THEN 'EXISTING_BANK_REVIEW'::text
                    WHEN (b.dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) THEN 'NEW_INSERT_CANDIDATE'::text
                    ELSE 'HOLD_OR_BLOCKED_REVIEW'::text
                END AS review_group,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.proposed_bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product_or_alt'::text, 'product'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN b.proposed_bank_bucket
                    ELSE 'hold'::text
                END AS proposed_page_type_calc,
            ((b.dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_source_row_type, b.source_row_type) = 'input_seed'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_avg_monthly_searches, b.avg_monthly_searches) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_competition, b.competition) IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(b.p1_competition, b.competition)) <> 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (b.proposed_bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) AND (COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(b.block_flags), 0) = 0) AND (b.exists_in_bank = false)) AS proposed_insert_allowed_calc
           FROM base b
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT c.candidate_keyword,
            c.candidate_keyword_norm,
            c.candidate_source,
            c.source_batch,
            c.source_row_type,
            c.exists_in_bank,
            c.exists_in_listing_master,
            c.has_metric,
            c.avg_monthly_searches,
            c.competition,
            c.competition_index,
            c.low_bid,
            c.high_bid,
            c.bid_currency,
            c.metric_source,
            c.metric_date,
            c.source_review_status,
            c.source_validation_status,
            c.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            c.source_bank_bucket,
            c.source_page_type,
            c.source_role,
            c.source_role_label,
            c.proposed_bank_bucket,
            c.proposed_review_status,
            c.block_flags,
            c.dry_run_action,
            c.reason,
            c.source_clusters,
            c.source_files,
            c.source_reason,
            c.source_notes,
            c.raw_json,
            c.p1_source_batch,
            c.p1_source_row_type,
            c.p1_avg_monthly_searches,
            c.p1_competition,
            c.p1_competition_index,
            c.p1_low_bid,
            c.p1_high_bid,
            c.p1_bid_currency,
            c.p1_metric_source,
            c.p1_metric_date,
            c.current_bank_review_status,
            c.current_bank_bucket,
            c.current_page_type,
            c.current_visible_in_listing_master,
            c.review_group,
            c.proposed_page_type_calc,
            c.proposed_insert_allowed_calc,
            LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ((((50 +
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 300) THEN 25
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 100) THEN 18
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 50) THEN 12
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 20) THEN 8
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 10) THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE upper(COALESCE(c.p1_competition, c.competition, ''::text))
                    WHEN 'LOW'::text THEN 12
                    WHEN 'MEDIUM'::text THEN 8
                    WHEN 'HIGH'::text THEN 2
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE c.proposed_bank_bucket
                    WHEN 'product_or_alt'::text THEN 8
                    WHEN 'product'::text THEN 6
                    WHEN 'collection'::text THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE COALESCE(c.p1_source_row_type, c.source_row_type)
                    WHEN 'input_seed'::text THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END))) AS proposed_score_calc
           FROM classified c
        )
 SELECT review_group,
    candidate_keyword,
    candidate_keyword_norm,
    p1_source_batch AS source_batch,
    COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type) AS source_row_type,
    dry_run_action,
    exists_in_bank,
    exists_in_listing_master,
    proposed_insert_allowed_calc AS proposed_insert_allowed,
    proposed_bank_bucket,
    proposed_page_type_calc AS proposed_page_type,
        CASE
            WHEN proposed_insert_allowed_calc THEN 'approved_draft'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type) = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'hold'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = ANY (ARRAY['needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text, 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text])) THEN 'hold'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'excluded_noise'::text) THEN 'reject'::text
            WHEN exists_in_bank THEN COALESCE(current_bank_review_status, 'existing_bank_review'::text)
            ELSE COALESCE(proposed_review_status, 'hold'::text)
        END AS proposed_review_status,
    proposed_score_calc AS proposed_score,
    p1_avg_monthly_searches AS avg_monthly_searches,
    p1_competition AS competition,
    p1_competition_index AS competition_index,
    p1_bid_currency AS bid_currency,
    p1_low_bid AS low_bid,
    p1_high_bid AS high_bid,
    p1_metric_source AS metric_source,
    p1_metric_date AS metric_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p1_bid_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (p1_bid_currency <> 'USD'::text)) THEN 'UAH bids preserved for provenance only; do not copy to seo_keyword_bank_v1 until currency-aware logic exists'::text
            WHEN (p1_bid_currency IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Bid fields preserved for provenance only; promotion payload must not copy low_bid/high_bid in this dry-run'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS do_not_copy_bid_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN proposed_insert_allowed_calc THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (exists_in_bank OR (dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text)) THEN 'already_exists_in_bank_no_insert'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(block_flags), 0) > 0) THEN ('blocked_by_flags: '::text || (block_flags)::text)
            WHEN (COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type) = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'google_ads_related_idea_requires_manual_review'::text
            WHEN ((p1_avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) OR (p1_competition IS NULL) OR (upper(p1_competition) = 'UNKNOWN'::text)) THEN 'no_usable_metric'::text
            WHEN (proposed_bank_bucket <> ALL (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN 'unsafe_or_hold_bucket'::text
            WHEN (proposed_review_status = ANY (ARRAY['hold'::text, 'reject'::text])) THEN 'review_status_not_approved'::text
            ELSE 'not_allowed_by_guard'::text
        END AS insert_block_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN (exists_in_bank AND exists_in_listing_master) THEN 'already_visible_update_metrics_only'::text
            WHEN (exists_in_bank AND (NOT exists_in_listing_master)) THEN 'bank_exists_but_not_listing_master_check_status_bucket'::text
            ELSE 'not_existing'::text
        END AS existing_bank_review_action,
    reason,
    (raw_json || jsonb_build_object('p1_source_batch', p1_source_batch, 'p1_source_row_type', COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type), 'p1_metric_values', jsonb_build_object('avg_monthly_searches', p1_avg_monthly_searches, 'competition', p1_competition, 'competition_index', p1_competition_index, 'bid_currency', p1_bid_currency, 'low_bid', p1_low_bid, 'high_bid', p1_high_bid), 'current_bank', jsonb_build_object('review_status', current_bank_review_status, 'bank_bucket', current_bank_bucket, 'page_type', current_page_type, 'visible_in_listing_master', current_visible_in_listing_master), 'proposed_insert_allowed', proposed_insert_allowed_calc, 'proposed_score', proposed_score_calc, 'insert_payload_excludes_bid_fields', true)) AS raw_json
   FROM scored;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_p1_insert_payload_preview_v1
relations.definition:
WITH source_rows AS (
         SELECT g.review_group,
            g.candidate_keyword,
            g.candidate_keyword_norm,
            g.source_batch,
            g.source_row_type,
            g.dry_run_action,
            g.exists_in_bank,
            g.exists_in_listing_master,
            g.proposed_insert_allowed,
            g.proposed_bank_bucket,
            g.proposed_page_type,
            g.proposed_review_status,
            g.proposed_score,
            g.avg_monthly_searches,
            g.competition,
            g.competition_index,
            g.bid_currency,
            g.low_bid,
            g.high_bid,
            g.metric_source,
            g.metric_date,
            g.do_not_copy_bid_reason,
            g.insert_block_reason,
            g.existing_bank_review_action,
            g.reason,
            g.raw_json,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM seo_keyword_bank_v1 b
                  WHERE (b.keyword_norm = g.candidate_keyword_norm))) AS exact_duplicate_exists,
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'cyberpunk shoulder armor'::text) THEN 'cyberpunk, shoulder_armor, p1_google_ads'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'futuristic shoulder armor'::text) THEN 'futuristic, shoulder_armor, p1_google_ads'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'post apocalyptic shoulder armor'::text) THEN 'post_apocalyptic, shoulder_armor, p1_google_ads'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = ANY (ARRAY['warrior shoulder armor'::text, 'warrior shoulders'::text])) THEN 'warrior, shoulder_armor, p1_google_ads'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'gold shoulders'::text) THEN 'gold, shoulders, p1_google_ads'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'cyberpunk festival outfit'::text) THEN 'cyberpunk, festival, collection, p1_google_ads'::text
                    ELSE 'p1_google_ads'::text
                END AS proposed_source_clusters,
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'gold shoulders'::text) THEN 'support/product_or_alt; not primary title keyword without shoulder armor context'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'warrior shoulders'::text) THEN 'support/product keyword; use with costume/armor context, not generic body/fitness context'::text
                    WHEN (g.candidate_keyword_norm = 'cyberpunk festival outfit'::text) THEN 'collection keyword, not product component keyword'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS semantic_note
           FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_p1_guarded_promotion_dry_run_v1 g
          WHERE (g.proposed_insert_allowed = true)
        ), payload AS (
         SELECT source_rows.candidate_keyword AS keyword,
            source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm AS keyword_norm,
            source_rows.proposed_bank_bucket AS bank_bucket,
            source_rows.proposed_page_type AS page_type,
            'approved_draft'::text AS review_status,
            source_rows.proposed_score AS score,
            source_rows.avg_monthly_searches,
            source_rows.competition,
            source_rows.competition_index,
            NULL::numeric AS low_bid,
            NULL::numeric AS high_bid,
            'google_ads_keyword_planner'::text AS metric_source,
            'US'::text AS metric_region,
            'en'::text AS metric_language,
            source_rows.metric_date,
            source_rows.source_batch,
            source_rows.source_row_type,
            source_rows.proposed_source_clusters AS source_clusters,
            'P1 critical Google Ads metric refresh; source batches 01/02/03; generated via guarded promotion dry-run'::text AS source_files,
            'P1 critical Google Ads metric refresh. UAH bids were preserved in metric snapshots but were not copied into payload low_bid/high_bid.'::text AS reason,
            concat_ws(' | '::text, 'Generated via public.feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_p1_guarded_promotion_dry_run_v1', 'UAH bids were not copied', ('source_batch='::text || source_rows.source_batch), ('source_row_type='::text || source_rows.source_row_type), source_rows.semantic_note) AS notes,
                CASE
                    WHEN source_rows.exact_duplicate_exists THEN 'blocked_duplicate'::text
                    WHEN ((source_rows.candidate_keyword IS NULL) OR (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm IS NULL) OR (source_rows.proposed_bank_bucket IS NULL) OR (source_rows.proposed_review_status IS NULL)) THEN 'blocked_schema_missing'::text
                    WHEN (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm = ANY (ARRAY['gold shoulders'::text, 'warrior shoulders'::text, 'cyberpunk festival outfit'::text])) THEN 'hold_semantic_review'::text
                    ELSE 'ready'::text
                END AS insert_safety_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN source_rows.exact_duplicate_exists THEN 'exact keyword_norm already exists in seo_keyword_bank_v1'::text
                    WHEN ((source_rows.candidate_keyword IS NULL) OR (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm IS NULL) OR (source_rows.proposed_bank_bucket IS NULL) OR (source_rows.proposed_review_status IS NULL)) THEN 'required insert field cannot be filled'::text
                    WHEN (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm = 'gold shoulders'::text) THEN 'semantic review: support/product_or_alt; not primary title keyword without shoulder armor context'::text
                    WHEN (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm = 'warrior shoulders'::text) THEN 'semantic review: support/product keyword; use with costume/armor context, not generic body/fitness context'::text
                    WHEN (source_rows.candidate_keyword_norm = 'cyberpunk festival outfit'::text) THEN 'semantic review: collection keyword, not product component keyword'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS insert_block_reason
           FROM source_rows
        )
 SELECT keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    bank_bucket,
    page_type,
    review_status,
    score,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_bid,
    high_bid,
    metric_source,
    metric_region,
    metric_language,
    metric_date,
    source_batch,
    source_row_type,
    source_clusters,
    source_files,
    reason,
    notes,
    insert_safety_status,
    insert_block_reason,
    jsonb_build_object('keyword', keyword, 'keyword_norm', keyword_norm, 'bank_bucket', bank_bucket, 'page_type', page_type, 'review_status', review_status, 'score', score, 'avg_monthly_searches', avg_monthly_searches, 'competition', competition, 'competition_index', competition_index, 'low_bid', NULL::unknown, 'high_bid', NULL::unknown, 'metric_source', metric_source, 'region', metric_region, 'language', metric_language, 'source_clusters', source_clusters, 'source_files', source_files, 'reason', reason, 'notes', notes, 'source_batch', source_batch, 'source_row_type', source_row_type, 'insert_safety_status', insert_safety_status, 'insert_block_reason', insert_block_reason, 'uah_bids_not_copied', true) AS payload_json
   FROM payload;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_summary_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT recommendation_status,
    suggested_page_level,
    (count(*))::integer AS keyword_count,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL)))::integer AS with_metric_count,
    (avg(avg_monthly_searches))::numeric(12,2) AS avg_search_volume,
    (avg(competition_index))::numeric(12,2) AS avg_competition_index,
    max(recommendation_score) AS max_score
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1
  GROUP BY recommendation_status, suggested_page_level
  ORDER BY recommendation_status, suggested_page_level;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_id,
    keyword_for_validation AS keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    should_use_for_product,
    should_use_for_collection,
    should_use_for_image_alt,
    should_hold,
    review_status,
    metric_validation_status,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_top_of_page_bid,
    high_top_of_page_bid,
    latest_metric_fetched_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DATA'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches < 10) THEN 'HOLD_LOW_VOLUME'::text
            WHEN ((competition_index IS NOT NULL) AND (competition_index >= (85)::numeric) AND (avg_monthly_searches < 100)) THEN 'HOLD_HIGH_COMPETITION_LOW_VOLUME'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'USE_PRODUCT_SEO'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'USE_COLLECTION_SEO'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'USE_IMAGE_ALT_SUPPORT'::text
            ELSE 'REVIEW_MANUALLY'::text
        END AS recommendation_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 0
            ELSE (((
            CASE
                WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 1000) THEN 40
                WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 100) THEN 30
                WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 10) THEN 15
                WHEN (avg_monthly_searches > 0) THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END +
            CASE
                WHEN (competition_index IS NULL) THEN 0
                WHEN (competition_index < (35)::numeric) THEN 25
                WHEN (competition_index < (70)::numeric) THEN 15
                ELSE 5
            END) +
            CASE
                WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) THEN 20
                WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 15
                WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END) +
            CASE
                WHEN ((high_top_of_page_bid IS NOT NULL) AND (high_top_of_page_bid > (0)::numeric)) THEN 10
                ELSE 0
            END)
        END AS recommendation_score,
    warning_flags,
    ai_reason
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1 q;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_score_preview_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_id,
    keyword_for_validation AS keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    should_use_for_product,
    should_use_for_collection,
    should_use_for_image_alt,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_top_of_page_bid,
    high_top_of_page_bid,
    latest_metric_fetched_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DATA'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 1000) THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 100) THEN 'MID_DEMAND'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 10) THEN 'LOW_DEMAND'::text
            ELSE 'VERY_LOW_DEMAND'::text
        END AS demand_band,
        CASE
            WHEN (competition_index IS NULL) THEN 'UNKNOWN_COMPETITION'::text
            WHEN (competition_index >= (70)::numeric) THEN 'HIGH_COMPETITION'::text
            WHEN (competition_index >= (35)::numeric) THEN 'MID_COMPETITION'::text
            ELSE 'LOW_COMPETITION'::text
        END AS competition_band,
    (((
        CASE
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 0
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 1000) THEN 40
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 100) THEN 30
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 10) THEN 15
            ELSE 5
        END +
        CASE
            WHEN (competition_index IS NULL) THEN 0
            WHEN (competition_index < (35)::numeric) THEN 25
            WHEN (competition_index < (70)::numeric) THEN 15
            ELSE 5
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) THEN 20
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 15
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((high_top_of_page_bid IS NOT NULL) AND (high_top_of_page_bid > (0)::numeric)) THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END) AS pilot_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DATA'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches < 10) THEN 'HOLD_LOW_VOLUME'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'PRODUCT_CANDIDATE'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'COLLECTION_CANDIDATE'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'IMAGE_ALT_CANDIDATE'::text
            ELSE 'REVIEW'::text
        END AS pilot_recommendation,
    metric_validation_status,
    warning_flags,
    ai_reason
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1 q
  WHERE (metric_validation_status = 'has_fresh_metrics'::text);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ranked_queue AS (
         SELECT q.keyword,
            q.keyword_norm,
            q.priority_tier,
            q.keyword_axis,
            q.keyword_pattern,
            q.product_count,
            q.suggested_page_level,
            q.source,
            'US'::text AS geo,
            'en'::text AS language,
            'us_en_tier1_controlled_150'::text AS batch_code,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY q.product_count DESC, q.keyword) AS export_rank
           FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_queue_v1 q
          WHERE ((q.priority_tier = 'tier_1'::text) AND (q.requires_api_validation IS TRUE) AND (q.keyword_word_count >= 2) AND (q.validation_priority <> 'low'::text) AND (q.keyword_norm <> ALL (ARRAY['full set'::text, 'whole product'::text, 'choose your set'::text, 'полный комплект'::text])) AND (q.keyword_norm !~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])(xxs|xs|s us|m us|l us|xl|2x|3x|size|размер|буквенный)([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text))
        )
 SELECT keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    priority_tier,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    product_count,
    suggested_page_level,
    source,
    geo,
    language,
    batch_code,
    export_rank
   FROM ranked_queue
  WHERE (export_rank <= 150);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_metric_system_status_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'cleanup_candidates'::text AS section,
    'needs_human_review'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1.cleanup_pipeline_status = 'needs_human_review'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'cleanup_candidates'::text AS section,
    'needs_ai_cleanup'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1.cleanup_pipeline_status = 'needs_ai_cleanup'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_validation'::text AS section,
    feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1.metric_validation_status AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1
  GROUP BY feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1.metric_validation_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_import_staging'::text AS section,
    COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'null_status'::text) AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1
  GROUP BY COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'null_status'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'score_preview'::text AS section,
    'score_ready_rows'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_score_preview_v1;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_next_action_queue_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 1 AS priority,
    'METRICS_REQUIRED'::text AS action_code,
    'Load real Google Ads / Keyword Planner metrics for cleaned keyword candidates.'::text AS action_title,
    (count(*))::integer AS affected_rows,
    'feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_template_v1'::text AS source_view,
    'No final SEO keyword scoring can be trusted until real avg_monthly_searches/competition metrics are imported.'::text AS reason
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1.recommendation_status = 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text)
 HAVING (count(*) > 0)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 2 AS priority,
    'READY_FOR_SCORING'::text AS action_code,
    'Review scored keyword candidates and approve product/collection/image-alt usage.'::text AS action_title,
    (count(*))::integer AS affected_rows,
    'feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1'::text AS source_view,
    'Real metrics exist for these keywords, so recommendation_status and score can be reviewed.'::text AS reason
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1.recommendation_status <> 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text)
 HAVING (count(*) > 0)
  ORDER BY 1;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_product_brief_readiness_v1
relations.definition:
WITH media_counts AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_media_drafts.canonical_product_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS media_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_media_drafts.use_publicly_flag IS TRUE)))::integer AS public_media_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((feya_commerce_media_drafts.alt_text_draft IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(feya_commerce_media_drafts.alt_text_draft) <> ''::text))))::integer AS alt_text_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((feya_commerce_media_drafts.filename_suggestion IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(feya_commerce_media_drafts.filename_suggestion) <> ''::text))))::integer AS filename_suggestion_count
           FROM feya_commerce_media_drafts
          GROUP BY feya_commerce_media_drafts.canonical_product_id
        ), config_counts AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_sellable_configurations.canonical_product_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS sellable_configuration_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (feya_commerce_sellable_configurations.is_public_candidate IS TRUE)))::integer AS public_configuration_count
           FROM feya_commerce_sellable_configurations
          GROUP BY feya_commerce_sellable_configurations.canonical_product_id
        ), content_status AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_content_drafts.canonical_product_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS content_draft_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((feya_commerce_content_drafts.seo_title IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(feya_commerce_content_drafts.seo_title) <> ''::text))))::integer AS content_seo_title_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((feya_commerce_content_drafts.meta_description IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(feya_commerce_content_drafts.meta_description) <> ''::text))))::integer AS content_meta_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((feya_commerce_content_drafts.full_description IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(feya_commerce_content_drafts.full_description) <> ''::text))))::integer AS content_full_description_count
           FROM feya_commerce_content_drafts
          GROUP BY feya_commerce_content_drafts.canonical_product_id
        )
 SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
    p.source_shop_code,
    p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    p.source_url,
    p.draft_site_title,
    p.card_title,
    p.h1,
    p.seo_title,
    p.meta_description,
    p.product_type,
    p.material,
    p.color,
    p.size_mode,
    p.fit_type,
    p.handmade_flag,
    p.styled_imagery_flag,
    p.publish_status,
    p.readiness_status,
    p.do_not_publish_flag,
    COALESCE(m.media_count, 0) AS media_count,
    COALESCE(m.public_media_count, 0) AS public_media_count,
    COALESCE(m.alt_text_count, 0) AS alt_text_count,
    COALESCE(m.filename_suggestion_count, 0) AS filename_suggestion_count,
    COALESCE(cfg.sellable_configuration_count, 0) AS sellable_configuration_count,
    COALESCE(cfg.public_configuration_count, 0) AS public_configuration_count,
    COALESCE(cs.content_draft_count, 0) AS content_draft_count,
    COALESCE(cs.content_seo_title_count, 0) AS content_seo_title_count,
    COALESCE(cs.content_meta_count, 0) AS content_meta_count,
    COALESCE(cs.content_full_description_count, 0) AS content_full_description_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.do_not_publish_flag IS TRUE) THEN 'DO_NOT_PUBLISH'::text
            WHEN ((p.draft_site_title IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.draft_site_title) = ''::text)) THEN 'MISSING_TITLE'::text
            WHEN ((p.product_type IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.product_type) = ''::text)) THEN 'MISSING_PRODUCT_TYPE'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.public_media_count, 0) = 0) THEN 'MISSING_PUBLIC_MEDIA'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(cfg.public_configuration_count, 0) = 0) THEN 'MISSING_PUBLIC_CONFIGURATION'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(cs.content_full_description_count, 0) = 0) THEN 'NEEDS_CONTENT_BRIEF'::text
            WHEN ((p.seo_title IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.seo_title) = ''::text)) THEN 'NEEDS_SEO_TITLE'::text
            WHEN ((p.meta_description IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.meta_description) = ''::text)) THEN 'NEEDS_META_DESCRIPTION'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.alt_text_count, 0) < GREATEST(1, COALESCE(m.public_media_count, 0))) THEN 'NEEDS_IMAGE_ALT_TEXT'::text
            ELSE 'BRIEF_READY_REVIEW'::text
        END AS seo_brief_readiness_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.do_not_publish_flag IS TRUE) THEN 99
            WHEN ((p.draft_site_title IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.draft_site_title) = ''::text)) THEN 10
            WHEN ((p.product_type IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.product_type) = ''::text)) THEN 20
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.public_media_count, 0) = 0) THEN 30
            WHEN (COALESCE(cfg.public_configuration_count, 0) = 0) THEN 40
            WHEN (COALESCE(cs.content_full_description_count, 0) = 0) THEN 50
            WHEN ((p.seo_title IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.seo_title) = ''::text)) THEN 60
            WHEN ((p.meta_description IS NULL) OR (btrim(p.meta_description) = ''::text)) THEN 70
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.alt_text_count, 0) < GREATEST(1, COALESCE(m.public_media_count, 0))) THEN 80
            ELSE 90
        END AS seo_brief_priority_order
   FROM (((feya_commerce_product_drafts p
     LEFT JOIN media_counts m ON ((m.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN config_counts cfg ON ((cfg.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN content_status cs ON ((cs.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_step6_product_builder_detail
relations.definition:
SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
    p.source_shop_code,
    p.primary_source_listing_id,
    p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    p.source_url,
    p.draft_site_title,
    p.card_title,
    p.h1,
    p.seo_title,
    p.meta_description,
    p.product_type,
    p.material,
    p.color,
    p.size_mode,
    p.production_profile,
    p.shipping_profile,
    p.handmade_flag,
    p.styled_imagery_flag,
    p.publish_status,
    p.readiness_status,
    p.do_not_publish_flag,
    p.notes,
    COALESCE(configs.configurations, '[]'::jsonb) AS configurations,
    COALESCE(media.media_items, '[]'::jsonb) AS media_items,
    COALESCE(content.content_items, '[]'::jsonb) AS content_items,
    COALESCE(matches.match_items, '[]'::jsonb) AS match_items
   FROM ((((feya_commerce_product_drafts p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sellable_configuration_id', sc.sellable_configuration_id, 'configuration_name', sc.configuration_name, 'normalized_key', sc.normalized_key, 'is_default_whole_product', sc.is_default_whole_product, 'is_sampler', sc.is_sampler, 'is_public_candidate', sc.is_public_candidate, 'sort_order', sc.sort_order, 'review_status', sc.review_status, 'prices', COALESCE(prices.price_items, '[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY sc.sort_order, sc.configuration_name) AS configurations
           FROM (feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('configuration_price_id', cp.configuration_price_id, 'source_price_row_id', cp.source_price_row_id, 'source_amount', cp.source_amount, 'source_currency', cp.source_currency, 'public_price_amount', cp.public_price_amount, 'manual_override_amount', cp.manual_override_amount, 'confidence', cp.confidence, 'fallback_flag', cp.fallback_flag, 'sampler_excluded_flag', cp.sampler_excluded_flag, 'review_status', cp.review_status, 'price_status', cp.price_status) ORDER BY cp.public_price_amount, cp.source_amount) AS price_items
                   FROM feya_commerce_configuration_prices cp
                  WHERE (cp.sellable_configuration_id = sc.sellable_configuration_id)) prices ON (true))
          WHERE (sc.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)) configs ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('media_draft_id', md.media_draft_id, 'source_image_url', md.source_image_url, 'source_image_order', md.source_image_order, 'assigned_role', md.assigned_role, 'role_confidence', md.role_confidence, 'alt_text_draft', md.alt_text_draft, 'ai_styled_image_flag', md.ai_styled_image_flag, 'use_publicly_flag', md.use_publicly_flag, 'readiness_status', md.readiness_status, 'review_status', md.review_status) ORDER BY md.source_image_order) AS media_items
           FROM feya_commerce_media_drafts md
          WHERE (md.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)) media ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('content_draft_id', cd.content_draft_id, 'content_language', cd.content_language, 'site_title', cd.site_title, 'card_title', cd.card_title, 'h1', cd.h1, 'seo_title', cd.seo_title, 'meta_description', cd.meta_description, 'snippet_status', cd.snippet_status, 'ai_content_status', cd.ai_content_status, 'review_status', cd.review_status) ORDER BY cd.content_language) AS content_items
           FROM feya_commerce_content_drafts cd
          WHERE (cd.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)) content ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('listing_match_id', lm.listing_match_id, 'source_listing_id', lm.source_listing_id, 'source_price_row_id', lm.source_price_row_id, 'match_status', lm.match_status, 'match_confidence', lm.match_confidence, 'review_status', lm.review_status, 'do_not_import_flag', lm.do_not_import_flag, 'notes', lm.notes) ORDER BY lm.match_status, lm.created_at) AS match_items
           FROM feya_commerce_listing_matches lm
          WHERE (lm.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)) matches ON (true));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_cards
relations.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
            p.source_shop_code,
            p.primary_source_listing_id,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            p.source_url,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cd.card_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.card_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.draft_site_title), ''::text), 'Untitled Product'::text) AS card_title,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cd.h1), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.h1), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.card_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.draft_site_title), ''::text), 'Untitled Product'::text) AS h1,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cd.seo_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.seo_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.card_title), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.draft_site_title), ''::text), 'Untitled Product'::text) AS seo_title,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cd.meta_description), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM p.meta_description), ''::text)) AS meta_description,
            p.product_type,
            p.material,
            p.color,
            p.size_mode,
            p.production_profile,
            p.shipping_profile,
            p.handmade_flag,
            p.styled_imagery_flag,
            p.publish_status,
            p.readiness_status,
            p.do_not_publish_flag,
            md.source_image_url AS primary_image_url,
            md.alt_text_draft AS primary_image_alt,
            min(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS min_price,
            max(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS max_price,
            COALESCE(max(cp.source_currency) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))), 'USD'::text) AS currency,
            count(DISTINCT sc.sellable_configuration_id) FILTER (WHERE ((sc.is_public_candidate = true) AND (sc.is_sampler = false))) AS public_configuration_count,
            count(DISTINCT cp.configuration_price_id) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS public_price_row_count,
            bool_or(cp.fallback_flag) AS has_fallback_price,
            bool_or(cp.sampler_excluded_flag) AS has_sampler_excluded_price,
            count(DISTINCT cp.configuration_price_id) FILTER (WHERE (cp.price_status = 'missing_price'::text)) AS missing_price_row_count,
            count(DISTINCT md_all.media_draft_id) AS media_count,
            count(DISTINCT cd.content_draft_id) AS content_draft_count
           FROM (((((feya_commerce_product_drafts p
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_content_drafts cd ON (((cd.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id) AND (cd.content_language = 'en'::text))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_media_drafts md ON (((md.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id) AND (md.assigned_role = 'product_card_primary'::text) AND (md.use_publicly_flag = true))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_media_drafts md_all ON ((md_all.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc ON ((sc.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_configuration_prices cp ON ((cp.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
          GROUP BY p.canonical_product_id, p.source_shop_code, p.primary_source_listing_id, p.matched_etsy_listing_id, p.source_url, cd.card_title, cd.h1, cd.seo_title, cd.meta_description, p.card_title, p.draft_site_title, p.h1, p.seo_title, p.meta_description, p.product_type, p.material, p.color, p.size_mode, p.production_profile, p.shipping_profile, p.handmade_flag, p.styled_imagery_flag, p.publish_status, p.readiness_status, p.do_not_publish_flag, md.source_image_url, md.alt_text_draft
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    source_shop_code,
    primary_source_listing_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    source_url,
    feya_commerce_slugify(((card_title || '-'::text) || COALESCE(matched_etsy_listing_id, (canonical_product_id)::text))) AS product_slug,
    card_title,
    h1,
    seo_title,
    meta_description,
    product_type,
    material,
    color,
    size_mode,
    production_profile,
    shipping_profile,
    handmade_flag,
    styled_imagery_flag,
    primary_image_url,
    primary_image_alt,
    min_price,
    max_price,
    currency,
    public_configuration_count,
    public_price_row_count,
    has_fallback_price,
    has_sampler_excluded_price,
    missing_price_row_count,
    media_count,
    content_draft_count,
    publish_status,
    readiness_status,
    do_not_publish_flag,
    ((readiness_status = 'ready_candidate'::text) AND (publish_status = 'draft'::text) AND (do_not_publish_flag = false) AND (primary_image_url IS NOT NULL) AND (min_price IS NOT NULL) AND (public_configuration_count > 0) AND (public_price_row_count > 0) AND (missing_price_row_count = 0)) AS storefront_candidate_flag
   FROM base;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_configurations
relations.definition:
SELECT p.canonical_product_id,
    p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    sc.sellable_configuration_id,
    sc.configuration_name,
    sc.normalized_key,
    sc.sort_order,
    sc.is_default_whole_product,
    sc.is_public_candidate,
    sc.review_status AS configuration_review_status,
    min(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS min_price,
    max(cp.public_price_amount) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS max_price,
    COALESCE(max(cp.source_currency) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))), 'USD'::text) AS currency,
    count(cp.configuration_price_id) FILTER (WHERE ((cp.public_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (cp.sampler_excluded_flag = false))) AS public_price_row_count,
    bool_or(cp.fallback_flag) AS has_fallback_price,
    bool_or(cp.sampler_excluded_flag) AS has_sampler_excluded_price
   FROM ((feya_commerce_product_drafts p
     JOIN feya_commerce_sellable_configurations sc ON ((sc.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_configuration_prices cp ON ((cp.sellable_configuration_id = sc.sellable_configuration_id)))
  WHERE ((sc.is_public_candidate = true) AND (sc.is_sampler = false))
  GROUP BY p.canonical_product_id, p.matched_etsy_listing_id, sc.sellable_configuration_id, sc.configuration_name, sc.normalized_key, sc.sort_order, sc.is_default_whole_product, sc.is_public_candidate, sc.review_status;

relations.name: feya_v_brief_gate_v2
relations.definition:
WITH gated AS (
         SELECT p.brief_queue_id,
            p.canonical_product_id,
            p.brief_type,
            p.target_language,
            p.generation_status,
            p.review_status,
            p.readiness_status,
            p.priority_order,
            p.keyword_metric_status,
            p.current_title,
            p.source_shop_code,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            p.source_url,
            p.draft_site_title,
            p.card_title,
            p.h1,
            p.seo_title,
            p.meta_description,
            p.product_type,
            p.material,
            p.color,
            p.size_mode,
            p.fit_type,
            p.production_profile,
            p.shipping_profile,
            p.handmade_flag,
            p.styled_imagery_flag,
            p.raw_ai_context,
            p.public_media_json,
            p.public_media_count,
            p.public_configurations_json,
            p.public_configuration_count,
            p.existing_content_json,
            p.brand_rules_json,
            p.generation_instructions_json,
            p.compact_payload_json,
            p.normalized_material_primary,
            p.normalized_color_primary,
            p.product_fact_quality_status,
            p.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            p.product_fact_quality_json,
            p.safe_compact_payload_json,
            p.option_mapping_count,
            p.option_part_signal_count,
            p.option_primary_part,
            p.option_derived_product_type,
            p.final_primary_part_v2,
            p.final_product_type_v2,
            p.final_material_primary_v2,
            p.final_color_primary_v2,
            p.final_derivation_warning_codes_v2,
            p.final_product_facts_json_v2,
            p.resolved_compact_payload_json_v2,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((p.product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) AND (p.final_material_primary_v2 IS NULL)) THEN 'BLOCK_UNTIL_FACT_REVIEW'::text
                    WHEN ((p.product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) AND (p.final_material_primary_v2 IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'ALLOW_WITH_STRICT_FACT_GUARDRAILS'::text
                    WHEN ((p.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text) AND (p.final_material_primary_v2 IS NULL)) THEN 'REVIEW_BEFORE_GENERATION'::text
                    WHEN (p.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['FACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text])) THEN 'ALLOW_WITH_FACT_WARNINGS'::text
                    ELSE 'ALLOW'::text
                END AS safe_generation_status_calc
           FROM feya_v_brief_payload_v2 p
        )
 SELECT brief_queue_id,
    canonical_product_id,
    current_title,
    readiness_status,
    priority_order,
    generation_status,
    review_status,
    safe_generation_status_calc AS safe_generation_status,
    product_fact_quality_status,
    final_primary_part_v2 AS final_primary_part,
    final_product_type_v2 AS final_product_type,
    final_material_primary_v2 AS final_material_primary,
    final_color_primary_v2 AS final_color_primary,
    final_derivation_warning_codes_v2 AS final_derivation_warning_codes,
        CASE
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCK_UNTIL_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'REVIEW_BEFORE_GENERATION'::text])) THEN 'BLOCKED_FACT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (final_primary_part_v2 IS NULL) THEN 'BLOCKED_PART_UNRESOLVED'::text
            WHEN (final_material_primary_v2 IS NULL) THEN 'BLOCKED_MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED'::text
            WHEN (final_color_primary_v2 IS NULL) THEN 'READY_NEEDS_COLOR_CAUTION'::text
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = 'ALLOW_WITH_STRICT_FACT_GUARDRAILS'::text) THEN 'READY_STRICT_GUARDRAILS'::text
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = 'ALLOW_WITH_FACT_WARNINGS'::text) THEN 'READY_WITH_WARNINGS'::text
            ELSE 'READY'::text
        END AS generation_gate_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCK_UNTIL_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'REVIEW_BEFORE_GENERATION'::text])) THEN 10
            WHEN (final_primary_part_v2 IS NULL) THEN 20
            WHEN (final_material_primary_v2 IS NULL) THEN 30
            WHEN (final_color_primary_v2 IS NULL) THEN 40
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = 'ALLOW_WITH_STRICT_FACT_GUARDRAILS'::text) THEN 50
            WHEN (safe_generation_status_calc = 'ALLOW_WITH_FACT_WARNINGS'::text) THEN 60
            ELSE 70
        END AS generation_gate_priority,
    resolved_compact_payload_json_v2
   FROM gated g;
