relations.name: feya_v_kw_candidate_v2
relations.definition:
WITH s AS (
         SELECT sel.strategy_selection_id,
            sel.brief_queue_id,
            sel.canonical_product_id,
            sel.page_goal_code,
            sel.primary_axis_code,
            sel.primary_term_code,
            sel.secondary_axes_json,
            sel.focus_mode,
            sel.strictness_mode,
            sel.risk_flags_json,
            sel.evidence_json AS selection_evidence_json,
            q.current_title,
            (q.product_facts_json ->> 'final_primary_part_v2'::text) AS final_primary_part,
            (q.product_facts_json ->> 'final_product_type_v2'::text) AS final_product_type,
            (q.product_facts_json ->> 'final_material_primary_v2'::text) AS final_material_primary,
            (q.product_facts_json ->> 'final_color_primary_v2'::text) AS final_color_primary,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sel.page_goal_code = 'image_seo'::text) THEN 'image_alt'::text
                    WHEN (sel.page_goal_code = 'collection_growth'::text) THEN 'collection'::text
                    ELSE 'product'::text
                END AS target_page_level
           FROM (feya_seo_strategy_selection_v1 sel
             JOIN feya_commerce_product_seo_brief_queue_v1 q ON ((q.brief_queue_id = sel.brief_queue_id)))
          WHERE (sel.selection_status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'selected'::text, 'testing'::text]))
        ), axis AS (
         SELECT s.strategy_selection_id,
            s.brief_queue_id,
            s.canonical_product_id,
            s.page_goal_code,
            s.primary_axis_code,
            s.primary_term_code,
            s.secondary_axes_json,
            s.focus_mode,
            s.strictness_mode,
            s.risk_flags_json,
            s.selection_evidence_json,
            s.current_title,
            s.final_primary_part,
            s.final_product_type,
            s.final_material_primary,
            s.final_color_primary,
            s.target_page_level,
            pt.term_name_ru AS primary_term_name_ru,
            pt.term_name_en AS primary_term_name_en,
            pt.include_regex AS primary_include_regex,
            pt.axis_source AS primary_axis_source,
            pt.dna_canonical_flag AS primary_dna_canonical_flag,
            part_t.include_regex AS product_part_regex,
            mat_t.include_regex AS product_material_regex,
            col_t.include_regex AS product_color_regex
           FROM ((((s
             LEFT JOIN feya_seo_axis_terms_v1 pt ON (((pt.axis_code = s.primary_axis_code) AND (pt.term_code = s.primary_term_code))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_seo_axis_terms_v1 part_t ON (((part_t.axis_code = 'part'::text) AND (part_t.term_code = s.final_primary_part) AND (part_t.active_flag IS TRUE))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_seo_axis_terms_v1 mat_t ON (((mat_t.axis_code = 'material'::text) AND (mat_t.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (((s.final_material_primary = 'mirror acrylic'::text) AND (mat_t.term_code = 'mirror_acrylic'::text)) OR ((s.final_material_primary = 'vegan leather'::text) AND (mat_t.term_code = 'vegan_leather'::text)) OR ((s.final_material_primary = 'silicone'::text) AND (mat_t.term_code = 'silicone'::text))))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_seo_axis_terms_v1 col_t ON (((col_t.axis_code = 'color'::text) AND (col_t.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (col_t.term_code = s.final_color_primary))))
        ), base AS (
         SELECT a.strategy_selection_id,
            a.brief_queue_id,
            a.canonical_product_id,
            a.page_goal_code,
            a.primary_axis_code,
            a.primary_term_code,
            a.secondary_axes_json,
            a.focus_mode,
            a.strictness_mode,
            a.risk_flags_json,
            a.selection_evidence_json,
            a.current_title,
            a.final_primary_part,
            a.final_product_type,
            a.final_material_primary,
            a.final_color_primary,
            a.target_page_level,
            a.primary_term_name_ru,
            a.primary_term_name_en,
            a.primary_include_regex,
            a.primary_axis_source,
            a.primary_dna_canonical_flag,
            a.product_part_regex,
            a.product_material_regex,
            a.product_color_regex,
            k.keyword_id,
            k.keyword,
            k.keyword_norm,
            k.keyword_axis,
            k.keyword_pattern,
            k.suggested_page_level,
            k.metric_validation_status,
            k.recommendation_status,
            k.recommendation_score,
            k.avg_monthly_searches,
            k.competition,
            k.competition_index,
            lower(k.keyword) AS keyword_lc
           FROM (axis a
             JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_recommendation_v1 k ON ((((a.target_page_level = 'product'::text) AND (COALESCE(k.should_use_for_product, false) IS TRUE)) OR ((a.target_page_level = 'collection'::text) AND (COALESCE(k.should_use_for_collection, false) IS TRUE)) OR ((a.target_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) AND (COALESCE(k.should_use_for_image_alt, false) IS TRUE)) OR (k.suggested_page_level = a.target_page_level))))
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT b.strategy_selection_id,
            b.brief_queue_id,
            b.canonical_product_id,
            b.page_goal_code,
            b.primary_axis_code,
            b.primary_term_code,
            b.secondary_axes_json,
            b.focus_mode,
            b.strictness_mode,
            b.risk_flags_json,
            b.selection_evidence_json,
            b.current_title,
            b.final_primary_part,
            b.final_product_type,
            b.final_material_primary,
            b.final_color_primary,
            b.target_page_level,
            b.primary_term_name_ru,
            b.primary_term_name_en,
            b.primary_include_regex,
            b.primary_axis_source,
            b.primary_dna_canonical_flag,
            b.product_part_regex,
            b.product_material_regex,
            b.product_color_regex,
            b.keyword_id,
            b.keyword,
            b.keyword_norm,
            b.keyword_axis,
            b.keyword_pattern,
            b.suggested_page_level,
            b.metric_validation_status,
            b.recommendation_status,
            b.recommendation_score,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.keyword_lc,
            ((b.product_part_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~ b.product_part_regex)) AS matches_product_part_regex,
            ((b.final_primary_part IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(b.final_primary_part)) || '%'::text))) AS matches_product_part_literal,
            ((b.product_material_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~ b.product_material_regex)) AS matches_product_material_regex,
            ((b.final_material_primary IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(b.final_material_primary)) || '%'::text))) AS matches_product_material_literal,
            ((b.product_color_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~ b.product_color_regex)) AS matches_product_color_regex,
            ((b.primary_include_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~ b.primary_include_regex)) AS matches_primary_axis_regex,
            ((b.primary_term_code IS NOT NULL) AND (b.keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || replace(lower(b.primary_term_code), '_'::text, ' '::text)) || '%'::text))) AS matches_primary_axis_literal,
            (b.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])(black|gold|golden|silver|white|red|blue|green|pink|purple|transparent|clear|holographic)([^a-z]|$)'::text) AS keyword_has_color_word
           FROM base b
        ), gated AS (
         SELECT s.strategy_selection_id,
            s.brief_queue_id,
            s.canonical_product_id,
            s.page_goal_code,
            s.primary_axis_code,
            s.primary_term_code,
            s.secondary_axes_json,
            s.focus_mode,
            s.strictness_mode,
            s.risk_flags_json,
            s.selection_evidence_json,
            s.current_title,
            s.final_primary_part,
            s.final_product_type,
            s.final_material_primary,
            s.final_color_primary,
            s.target_page_level,
            s.primary_term_name_ru,
            s.primary_term_name_en,
            s.primary_include_regex,
            s.primary_axis_source,
            s.primary_dna_canonical_flag,
            s.product_part_regex,
            s.product_material_regex,
            s.product_color_regex,
            s.keyword_id,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.keyword_axis,
            s.keyword_pattern,
            s.suggested_page_level,
            s.metric_validation_status,
            s.recommendation_status,
            s.recommendation_score,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.keyword_lc,
            s.matches_product_part_regex,
            s.matches_product_part_literal,
            s.matches_product_material_regex,
            s.matches_product_material_literal,
            s.matches_product_color_regex,
            s.matches_primary_axis_regex,
            s.matches_primary_axis_literal,
            s.keyword_has_color_word,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.keyword_has_color_word IS FALSE) THEN false
                    WHEN (s.final_color_primary IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'gold'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])(gold|golden)([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'silver'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])silver([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'black'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])black([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'white'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])white([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'red'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])red([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'holographic'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])(holographic|iridescent)([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    WHEN ((s.final_color_primary = 'transparent'::text) AND (s.keyword_lc ~ '(^|[^a-z])(transparent|clear)([^a-z]|$)'::text)) THEN false
                    ELSE true
                END AS color_primary_block_flag
           FROM scored s
        )
 SELECT strategy_selection_id,
    brief_queue_id,
    canonical_product_id,
    page_goal_code,
    primary_axis_code,
    primary_term_code,
    secondary_axes_json,
    focus_mode,
    strictness_mode,
    risk_flags_json,
    selection_evidence_json,
    current_title,
    final_primary_part,
    final_product_type,
    final_material_primary,
    final_color_primary,
    target_page_level,
    primary_term_name_ru,
    primary_term_name_en,
    primary_include_regex,
    primary_axis_source,
    primary_dna_canonical_flag,
    product_part_regex,
    product_material_regex,
    product_color_regex,
    keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    metric_validation_status,
    recommendation_status,
    recommendation_score,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    keyword_lc,
    matches_product_part_regex,
    matches_product_part_literal,
    matches_product_material_regex,
    matches_product_material_literal,
    matches_product_color_regex,
    matches_primary_axis_regex,
    matches_primary_axis_literal,
    keyword_has_color_word,
    color_primary_block_flag,
    ((((((((COALESCE(recommendation_score, 0) +
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status = 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 60
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (matches_product_part_regex OR matches_product_part_literal) THEN 100
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (matches_product_material_regex OR matches_product_material_literal) THEN 45
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_color_regex THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (matches_primary_axis_regex OR matches_primary_axis_literal) THEN 35
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'long_tail'::text) AND (array_length(regexp_split_to_array(keyword_lc, '\s+'::text), 1) >= 3)) THEN 20
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'image_seo'::text) AND (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text)) THEN 30
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'collection_growth'::text) AND (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text)) THEN 30
            ELSE 0
        END) AS axis_keyword_score,
    ((matches_product_part_regex OR matches_product_part_literal) AND (color_primary_block_flag IS FALSE) AND (NOT ((keyword_lc ~ '(corset|top|bodysuit|skirt|mask|headpiece|crown|choker|bracelet|glove|shoulder|leg|garter)'::text) AND (NOT (matches_product_part_regex OR matches_product_part_literal))))) AS primary_candidate_flag,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 'WAITING_FOR_REAL_METRICS'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN color_primary_block_flag THEN 'BLOCK_PRIMARY_COLOR_MISMATCH_OR_UNKNOWN'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_part_regex THEN 'MATCH_PRODUCT_PART_REGEX'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_part_literal THEN 'MATCH_PRODUCT_PART_LITERAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_material_regex THEN 'MATCH_PRODUCT_MATERIAL_FAMILY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_material_literal THEN 'MATCH_PRODUCT_MATERIAL_LITERAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_product_color_regex THEN 'MATCH_PRODUCT_COLOR'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_primary_axis_regex THEN 'MATCH_PRIMARY_AXIS_REGEX'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN matches_primary_axis_literal THEN 'MATCH_PRIMARY_AXIS_TERM'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'long_tail'::text) AND (array_length(regexp_split_to_array(keyword_lc, '\s+'::text), 1) >= 3)) THEN 'MATCH_LONG_TAIL_GOAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'image_seo'::text) AND (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_IMAGE_SEO_GOAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((page_goal_code = 'collection_growth'::text) AND (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_COLLECTION_GOAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (primary_dna_canonical_flag IS FALSE) THEN 'PRIMARY_AXIS_NOT_CANONICAL_DNA'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS axis_keyword_evidence_codes
   FROM gated g;

    competition,
    competition_index,
    keyword_lc,
    (((((((((((strategy_match_score +
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status = 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 40
            ELSE 0
        END) + COALESCE(recommendation_score, 0)) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_primary_part IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_primary_part)) || '%'::text))) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_material_primary IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_material_primary)) || '%'::text))) THEN 20
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_color_primary IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_color_primary)) || '%'::text))) THEN 15
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'burning_man'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'burning man|festival|desert|rave'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'cyberpunk_futuristic'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'cyberpunk|futuristic|sci|robot|armor'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'apocalyptic_wasteland'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'apocalyptic|wasteland|warrior|armor'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'stage_performance'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'stage|performance|dance|show'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'drag_show'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'drag|queen|performer|showgirl'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'mirror_armor'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'mirror|acrylic|reflective|armor|metallic'::text)) THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END) AS placement_candidate_score,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 'WAITING_FOR_REAL_METRICS'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_primary_part IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_primary_part)) || '%'::text))) THEN 'MATCH_PART'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_material_primary IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_material_primary)) || '%'::text))) THEN 'MATCH_MATERIAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((final_color_primary IS NOT NULL) AND (keyword_lc ~~ (('%'::text || lower(final_color_primary)) || '%'::text))) THEN 'MATCH_COLOR'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'burning_man'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'burning man|festival|desert|rave'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_BURNING_MAN_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'cyberpunk_futuristic'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'cyberpunk|futuristic|sci|robot|armor'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_CYBERPUNK_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'apocalyptic_wasteland'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'apocalyptic|wasteland|warrior|armor'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_APOCALYPTIC_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'stage_performance'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'stage|performance|dance|show'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_STAGE_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'drag_show'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'drag|queen|performer|showgirl'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_DRAG_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((strategy_code = 'mirror_armor'::text) AND (keyword_lc ~ 'mirror|acrylic|reflective|armor|metallic'::text)) THEN 'MATCH_MIRROR_ARMOR_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS placement_evidence_codes
   FROM base b;

relations.name: feya_v_kw_plan_pipeline_status_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'strategies'::text AS section,
    feya_seo_strategy_profiles_v1.strategy_code AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_seo_strategy_profiles_v1
  WHERE (feya_seo_strategy_profiles_v1.active_flag IS TRUE)
  GROUP BY feya_seo_strategy_profiles_v1.strategy_code
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'candidate_pairs'::text AS section,
    feya_v_kw_plan_candidates_v1.strategy_code AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_v_kw_plan_candidates_v1
  GROUP BY feya_v_kw_plan_candidates_v1.strategy_code
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'placement_plans'::text AS section,
    ((feya_seo_keyword_placement_plan_v1.strategy_code || ':'::text) || feya_seo_keyword_placement_plan_v1.plan_status) AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_seo_keyword_placement_plan_v1
  GROUP BY feya_seo_keyword_placement_plan_v1.strategy_code, feya_seo_keyword_placement_plan_v1.plan_status
  ORDER BY 1, 2;

relations.name: feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1
relations.definition:
WITH product_source AS (
         SELECT q.brief_queue_id,
            q.canonical_product_id,
            s.product_slug,
            q.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            q.current_title AS product_title,
            q.h1,
            q.card_title,
            q.product_type,
            COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part_v2}'::text[]), (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part}'::text[]), (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,derived_primary_part}'::text[])) AS final_primary_part,
            COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_material_primary_v2}'::text[]), (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_material_primary}'::text[]), q.normalized_material_primary) AS material_detail,
            COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_color_primary_v2}'::text[]), (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_color_primary}'::text[]), q.normalized_color_primary) AS color,
            q.product_fact_quality_status,
            lower(((((((((COALESCE(q.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(q.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(q.card_title, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((q.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json)::text, ''::text))) AS product_text,
            lower(((COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part_v2}'::text[]), ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part}'::text[]), ''::text))) AS final_primary_part_text,
            lower((((COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts_v2,title_derivation,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,derived_product_facts,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text)) AS derived_component_text,
            lower(((COALESCE((q.public_configurations_json)::text, ''::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts_v2,configuration_derivation,public_config_components}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text)) AS configuration_component_text,
            d.do_not_publish_flag,
            d.publish_status,
            d.readiness_status AS detail_readiness_status
           FROM ((feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_safe_generation_queue_v1 q
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_products_api s ON ((s.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_step6_product_builder_detail d ON ((d.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
        ), product_terms AS (
         SELECT ps.brief_queue_id,
            ps.canonical_product_id,
            ps.product_slug,
            ps.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            ps.product_title,
            ps.h1,
            ps.card_title,
            ps.product_type,
            ps.final_primary_part,
            ps.material_detail,
            ps.color,
            ps.product_fact_quality_status,
            ps.product_text,
            ps.final_primary_part_text,
            ps.derived_component_text,
            ps.configuration_component_text,
            ps.do_not_publish_flag,
            ps.publish_status,
            ps.detail_readiness_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'burning man'::text) THEN 'Burning Man'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(festival|rave|edm|edc|coachella|tomorrowland|club)'::text) THEN 'Festival/Rave'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(stage|performance|performer|dance|show|dj|burlesque|drag)'::text) THEN 'Stage/Performance'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(editorial|red carpet|fashion)'::text) THEN 'Fashion/Editorial/Red Carpet'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'cosplay'::text) THEN 'Cosplay'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS context_primary,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(cyberpunk|cyber)'::text) THEN 'cyberpunk'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'futuristic'::text) THEN 'futuristic'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(desert|dune|apocalyptic|mad max)'::text) THEN 'desert apocalyptic'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(goth|gothic)'::text) THEN 'gothic'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'punk'::text) THEN 'punk'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ '(glam|high fashion)'::text) THEN 'glam'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS context_secondary,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'drag'::text) THEN 'drag queen'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'warrior'::text) THEN 'warrior'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'goddess'::text) THEN 'goddess'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'alien'::text) THEN 'alien'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'demon'::text) THEN 'demon'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'angel'::text) THEN 'angel'::text
                    WHEN (ps.product_text ~ 'queen'::text) THEN 'queen'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS persona,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((((COALESCE(ps.product_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(ps.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(ps.card_title, ''::text))) ~ '(digital download|ai try on|preview from your photo|photo \+ 5 sec video|photo \+ video|video preview|individual sizes|delivery for|shipping|service item|sampler|probnik)'::text) THEN true
                    WHEN (COALESCE(ps.do_not_publish_flag, false) = true) THEN true
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(ps.detail_readiness_status, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(ps.publish_status, ''::text))) ~ '(storefront_excluded|do_not_publish)'::text) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS product_not_seo_target_flag,
            lower(((((COALESCE(ps.final_primary_part_text, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(ps.derived_component_text, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(ps.configuration_component_text, ''::text))) AS confirmed_component_text,
            lower(COALESCE(ps.material_detail, ''::text)) AS material_l,
            lower(COALESCE(ps.color, ''::text)) AS color_l
           FROM product_source ps
        ), product_arrays AS (
         SELECT pt.brief_queue_id,
            pt.canonical_product_id,
            pt.product_slug,
            pt.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            pt.product_title,
            pt.h1,
            pt.card_title,
            pt.product_type,
            pt.final_primary_part,
            pt.material_detail,
            pt.color,
            pt.product_fact_quality_status,
            pt.product_text,
            pt.final_primary_part_text,
            pt.derived_component_text,
            pt.configuration_component_text,
            pt.do_not_publish_flag,
            pt.publish_status,
            pt.detail_readiness_status,
            pt.context_primary,
            pt.context_secondary,
            pt.persona,
            pt.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            pt.confirmed_component_text,
            pt.material_l,
            pt.color_l,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ '(top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text) THEN 'top'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'corset'::text) OR (pt.product_text ~ '(corset|breastplate|chest plate|overbust)'::text)) THEN 'corset'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.product_text ~ '(breastplate|chest plate)'::text) THEN 'chest plate'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'harness'::text) THEN 'harness'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'skirt'::text) THEN 'skirt'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'panties'::text) THEN 'panties'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ '(garter|leg)'::text) THEN 'leg garters'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ '(choker|collar)'::text) THEN 'choker'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'shoulder'::text) THEN 'shoulder armor'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ '(arm|sleeve|glove|bracer)'::text) THEN 'arm cuffs'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'mask'::text) THEN 'mask'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text) THEN 'headpiece'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'wing'::text) THEN 'wings'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'tail'::text) THEN 'tail'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'spine'::text) THEN 'spine'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'bodysuit'::text) THEN 'bodysuit'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.confirmed_component_text ~ 'dress'::text) THEN 'dress'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS component_terms,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.material_l ~ '(mirror acrylic|acrylic)'::text) THEN 'mirror acrylic'::text
                    WHEN (pt.material_l ~ 'vegan leather'::text) THEN 'vegan leather'::text
                    WHEN (pt.material_l ~ 'fabric'::text) THEN 'fabric'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS safe_material_term,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.material_l ~ '(mirror acrylic|acrylic)'::text) THEN 'mirror'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS visual_effect_term
           FROM product_terms pt
        ), component_rows AS (
         SELECT pa.brief_queue_id,
            pa.canonical_product_id,
            pa.product_slug,
            pa.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            pa.product_title,
            pa.h1,
            pa.card_title,
            pa.product_type,
            pa.final_primary_part,
            pa.material_detail,
            pa.color,
            pa.product_fact_quality_status,
            pa.product_text,
            pa.final_primary_part_text,
            pa.derived_component_text,
            pa.configuration_component_text,
            pa.do_not_publish_flag,
            pa.publish_status,
            pa.detail_readiness_status,
            pa.context_primary,
            pa.context_secondary,
            pa.persona,
            pa.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            pa.confirmed_component_text,
            pa.material_l,
            pa.color_l,
            pa.component_terms,
            pa.safe_material_term,
            pa.visual_effect_term,
            c.component_term,
            cardinality(pa.component_terms) AS component_count
           FROM (product_arrays pa
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pa.component_terms) c(component_term))
          WHERE (NOT pa.product_not_seo_target_flag)
        ), expansion_union AS (
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            component_rows.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            component_rows.product_slug,
            component_rows.product_title,
            component_rows.h1,
            component_rows.card_title,
            component_rows.product_type,
            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'color_material_part'::text AS pattern_code,
            concat_ws(' '::text, NULLIF(component_rows.color_l, ''::text), component_rows.safe_material_term, component_rows.component_term) AS generated_keyword,
            'product'::text AS generated_page_level,
            'exact_product_candidate'::text AS generated_role_hint,
            10 AS pattern_priority,
            'confirmed component + color + material'::text AS expansion_reason
           FROM component_rows
          WHERE ((component_rows.safe_material_term IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(component_rows.color_l, ''::text) IS NOT NULL))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            component_rows.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            component_rows.product_slug,
            component_rows.product_title,
            component_rows.h1,
            component_rows.card_title,
            component_rows.product_type,
            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'material_part'::text,
            concat_ws(' '::text, component_rows.safe_material_term, component_rows.component_term) AS concat_ws,
            'product'::text,
            'exact_product_candidate'::text,
            20,
            'confirmed component + material'::text
           FROM component_rows
          WHERE (component_rows.safe_material_term IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            component_rows.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            component_rows.product_slug,
            component_rows.product_title,
            component_rows.h1,
            component_rows.card_title,
            component_rows.product_type,
            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'color_part'::text,
            concat_ws(' '::text, NULLIF(component_rows.color_l, ''::text), component_rows.component_term) AS concat_ws,
            'product'::text,
            'exact_product_candidate'::text,
            30,
            'confirmed component + color'::text
           FROM component_rows
          WHERE (NULLIF(component_rows.color_l, ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            component_rows.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            component_rows.product_slug,
            component_rows.product_title,
            component_rows.h1,
            component_rows.card_title,
            component_rows.product_type,
            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'visual_effect_part'::text,
            concat_ws(' '::text, component_rows.visual_effect_term, component_rows.component_term) AS concat_ws,
            'image_alt'::text,
            'image_alt_or_product_candidate'::text,
            40,
            'visual/material effect + confirmed component'::text
           FROM component_rows
          WHERE (component_rows.visual_effect_term IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,
            component_rows.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            component_rows.product_slug,
            component_rows.product_title,
            component_rows.h1,
            component_rows.card_title,
            component_rows.product_type,
            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'context_part'::text,
            concat_ws(' '::text, lower(component_rows.context_primary), component_rows.component_term) AS concat_ws,
            'collection_or_product'::text,
            'context_candidate'::text,
            50,
            'canonical context + confirmed component'::text
           FROM component_rows

        UNION ALL

         SELECT component_rows.canonical_product_id,

            component_rows.card_title,

            component_rows.final_primary_part,
            component_rows.material_detail,
            component_rows.color,
            component_rows.context_primary,
            component_rows.context_secondary,
            component_rows.persona,
            component_rows.component_terms,
            component_rows.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            component_rows.product_fact_quality_status,
            component_rows.safe_material_term,
            component_rows.visual_effect_term,
            component_rows.component_term,
            component_rows.component_count,
            'style_part'::text,
            concat_ws(' '::text, component_rows.persona, component_rows.component_term) AS concat_ws,
            'product_or_collection'::text,
            'persona_candidate'::text,
            65,
            'confirmed persona + component'::text
           FROM component_rows
          WHERE (component_rows.persona IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT product_arrays.canonical_product_id,
            product_arrays.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            product_arrays.product_slug,
            product_arrays.product_title,
            product_arrays.h1,
            product_arrays.card_title,
            product_arrays.product_type,
            product_arrays.final_primary_part,
            product_arrays.material_detail,
            product_arrays.color,
            product_arrays.context_primary,
            product_arrays.context_secondary,
            product_arrays.persona,
            product_arrays.component_terms,
            product_arrays.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            product_arrays.product_fact_quality_status,
            product_arrays.safe_material_term,
            product_arrays.visual_effect_term,
            product_arrays.component_terms[1] AS component_terms,
            cardinality(product_arrays.component_terms) AS cardinality,
            'component_pair'::text,
            concat(product_arrays.component_terms[1], ' and ', product_arrays.component_terms[2]) AS concat,
            'product'::text,
            'component_pair_candidate'::text,
            70,
            'two confirmed components'::text
           FROM product_arrays
          WHERE ((NOT product_arrays.product_not_seo_target_flag) AND (cardinality(product_arrays.component_terms) >= 2))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT product_arrays.canonical_product_id,
            product_arrays.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            product_arrays.product_slug,
            product_arrays.product_title,
            product_arrays.h1,
            product_arrays.card_title,
            product_arrays.product_type,
            product_arrays.final_primary_part,
            product_arrays.material_detail,
            product_arrays.color,
            product_arrays.context_primary,
            product_arrays.context_secondary,
            product_arrays.persona,
            product_arrays.component_terms,
            product_arrays.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            product_arrays.product_fact_quality_status,
            product_arrays.safe_material_term,
            product_arrays.visual_effect_term,
            product_arrays.component_terms[1] AS component_terms,
            cardinality(product_arrays.component_terms) AS cardinality,
            'bundle_look'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (product_arrays.context_primary = 'Burning Man'::text) THEN 'burning man outfit set'::text
                    WHEN (product_arrays.context_primary = 'Stage/Performance'::text) THEN 'stage costume set'::text
                    WHEN (product_arrays.material_l ~ '(mirror acrylic|acrylic)'::text) THEN 'mirror outfit set'::text
                    ELSE 'festival outfit set'::text
                END AS "case",
            'collection_or_bundle'::text,
            'bundle_look_candidate'::text,
            80,
            'confirmed multi-component bundle/look; set is not product type'::text
           FROM product_arrays
          WHERE ((NOT product_arrays.product_not_seo_target_flag) AND (cardinality(product_arrays.component_terms) >= 2))
        ), cleaned AS (
         SELECT expansion_union.canonical_product_id,
            expansion_union.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            expansion_union.product_slug,
            expansion_union.product_title,
            expansion_union.h1,
            expansion_union.card_title,
            expansion_union.product_type,
            expansion_union.final_primary_part,
            expansion_union.material_detail,
            expansion_union.color,
            expansion_union.context_primary,
            expansion_union.context_secondary,
            expansion_union.persona,
            expansion_union.component_terms,
            expansion_union.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            expansion_union.product_fact_quality_status,
            expansion_union.safe_material_term,
            expansion_union.visual_effect_term,
            expansion_union.component_term,
            expansion_union.component_count,
            expansion_union.pattern_code,
            expansion_union.generated_keyword,
            expansion_union.generated_page_level,
            expansion_union.generated_role_hint,
            expansion_union.pattern_priority,
            expansion_union.expansion_reason,
            lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM regexp_replace(expansion_union.generated_keyword, '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text))) AS generated_keyword_norm
           FROM expansion_union
          WHERE ((expansion_union.generated_keyword IS NOT NULL) AND (TRIM(BOTH FROM expansion_union.generated_keyword) <> ''::text) AND (lower(expansion_union.generated_keyword) !~ '(real leather|genuine leather|natural leather|real metal|metal armor|metal armour|latex|theatre|theater|opera|sports|cultural festival|seasonal peaks)'::text) AND (lower(expansion_union.generated_keyword) !~ '(^|\s)leather(\s|$)'::text))
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT x.canonical_product_id,
            x.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            x.product_slug,
            x.product_title,
            x.h1,
            x.card_title,
            x.product_type,
            x.final_primary_part,
            x.material_detail,
            x.color,
            x.context_primary,
            x.context_secondary,
            x.persona,
            x.component_terms,
            x.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            x.product_fact_quality_status,
            x.safe_material_term,
            x.visual_effect_term,
            x.component_term,
            x.component_count,
            x.pattern_code,
            x.generated_keyword,
            x.generated_page_level,
            x.generated_role_hint,
            x.pattern_priority,
            x.expansion_reason,
            x.generated_keyword_norm,
            x.dedupe_rank,
            x.product_candidate_rank
           FROM ( SELECT c.canonical_product_id,
                    c.matched_etsy_listing_id,
                    c.product_slug,
                    c.product_title,
                    c.h1,
                    c.card_title,
                    c.product_type,
                    c.final_primary_part,
                    c.material_detail,
                    c.color,
                    c.context_primary,
                    c.context_secondary,
                    c.persona,
                    c.component_terms,
                    c.product_not_seo_target_flag,
                    c.product_fact_quality_status,
                    c.safe_material_term,
                    c.visual_effect_term,
                    c.component_term,
                    c.component_count,
                    c.pattern_code,
                    c.generated_keyword,
                    c.generated_page_level,
                    c.generated_role_hint,
                    c.pattern_priority,
                    c.expansion_reason,
                    c.generated_keyword_norm,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.canonical_product_id, c.generated_keyword_norm ORDER BY c.pattern_priority, c.generated_keyword_norm) AS dedupe_rank,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.canonical_product_id ORDER BY c.pattern_priority, c.generated_keyword_norm) AS product_candidate_rank
                   FROM cleaned c) x
          WHERE ((x.dedupe_rank = 1) AND (x.product_candidate_rank <= 30))
        ), latest_metrics AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm) feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.data_freshness_status
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1
          ORDER BY feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm, feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id DESC
        ), metric_batch AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT feya_metric_request_batch_keywords_v1.keyword_norm
           FROM feya_metric_request_batch_keywords_v1
        )
 SELECT r.canonical_product_id,
    r.matched_etsy_listing_id,
    r.product_slug,
    r.product_title,
    r.h1,
    r.card_title,
    r.product_type,
    r.final_primary_part,
    r.final_primary_part AS part,
    r.material_detail,
    r.color,
    r.context_primary,
    r.context_secondary,
    r.persona,
    r.component_terms AS components,
    r.generated_keyword,
    r.generated_keyword_norm,
    r.pattern_code,
    r.generated_page_level,
    r.generated_role_hint,
    'candidate_generated'::text AS expansion_status,
    r.expansion_reason,
    false AS product_not_seo_target_flag,
    'confirmed_component_text'::text AS component_source,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.safe_material_term IS NOT NULL) THEN 'final_material_primary'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS material_source,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.context_primary IS NOT NULL) THEN 'inferred_canonical_context'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS context_source,
    (u.kw_universe_id IS NOT NULL) AS already_in_keyword_universe,
    u.kw_universe_id AS keyword_id,
    (lm.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_metric_snapshot,
        CASE
            WHEN (u.kw_universe_id IS NULL) THEN 'not_in_universe_yet'::text
            WHEN (lm.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'has_metric_snapshot'::text
            WHEN ((mb.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) OR (u.metric_status = 'needs_metric_validation'::text)) THEN 'wait_for_metrics'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(u.metric_status, 'needs_metric_validation'::text)
        END AS metric_status,
    (lm.snapshot_id IS NULL) AS needs_metric_validation,
    ((r.pattern_code = ANY (ARRAY['component_pair'::text, 'bundle_look'::text, 'style_part'::text])) OR (r.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text]))) AS needs_human_review,
    r.product_candidate_rank
   FROM (((ranked r
     LEFT JOIN feya_kw_universe_v1 u ON ((u.keyword_norm = r.generated_keyword_norm)))
     LEFT JOIN latest_metrics lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = r.generated_keyword_norm)))
     LEFT JOIN metric_batch mb ON ((mb.keyword_norm = r.generated_keyword_norm)));

relations.name: feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidate_summary_v1
relations.definition:
WITH c AS (
         SELECT feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.canonical_product_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.product_slug,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.product_title,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.h1,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.card_title,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.source_listing_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.product_type,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.part,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.part_subtype,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.material,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.material_detail,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.color,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.context_primary,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.context_secondary,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.persona,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.gender,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.components,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.page_goal,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_norm,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_axis,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_pattern,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.suggested_page_level,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.evidence_count,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.source_count,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.has_metric_snapshot,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.metric_status,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.fit_status,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.fit_score_pre_metric,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.page_level_recommendation,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.compatibility_status,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.blocked_reason,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.needs_human_review,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.fit_reason,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.evaluated_at
           FROM feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1
        ), product_base AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_safe_generation_queue_v1.canonical_product_id
           FROM feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_safe_generation_queue_v1
        ), non_blocked AS (
         SELECT c.canonical_product_id
           FROM c
          WHERE (c.fit_status <> 'blocked'::text)
          GROUP BY c.canonical_product_id
        ), strong AS (
         SELECT c.canonical_product_id
           FROM c
          WHERE (c.fit_status = 'strong_fit'::text)
          GROUP BY c.canonical_product_id
        ), keyword_product_counts AS (
         SELECT c.keyword_norm,
            (count(DISTINCT c.canonical_product_id))::integer AS product_count
           FROM c
          WHERE (c.fit_status = ANY (ARRAY['strong_fit'::text, 'medium_fit'::text, 'collection_fit'::text, 'image_alt_fit'::text]))
          GROUP BY c.keyword_norm
        )
 SELECT 'total_candidate_rows'::text AS section,
    'all'::text AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM c
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'fit_status'::text AS section,
    c.fit_status AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM c
  GROUP BY c.fit_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_status'::text AS section,
    c.metric_status AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM c
  GROUP BY c.metric_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'products_with_zero_non_blocked_candidates'::text AS section,
    'products'::text AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM (product_base pb
     LEFT JOIN non_blocked nb USING (canonical_product_id))
  WHERE (nb.canonical_product_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'products_with_at_least_1_strong_fit'::text AS section,
    'products'::text AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM strong
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'keywords_assigned_to_too_many_products'::text AS section,
    'product_count_gt_50'::text AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    jsonb_build_object('threshold', 50) AS details_json
   FROM keyword_product_counts
  WHERE (keyword_product_counts.product_count > 50)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'top_blocked_reasons'::text AS section,
    COALESCE(c.blocked_reason, 'none'::text) AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM c
  WHERE (c.fit_status = 'blocked'::text)
  GROUP BY c.blocked_reason
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'page_level_recommendation'::text AS section,
    c.page_level_recommendation AS label,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    NULL::jsonb AS details_json
   FROM c
  GROUP BY c.page_level_recommendation;
