relations.name: feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1
relations.definition:
WITH products AS (
         SELECT p.brief_queue_id,
            p.canonical_product_id,
            NULL::text AS product_slug,
            p.current_title,
            COALESCE(p.h1, p.card_title, p.current_title) AS product_title,
            p.card_title,
            p.h1,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id AS source_listing_id,
            p.source_url,
            p.product_type,
            COALESCE((p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part_v2}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,derived_primary_part}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_product_facts,final_primary_part}'::text[])) AS part,
            NULL::text AS part_subtype,
            p.material,
            COALESCE((p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_material_primary_v2}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_material_primary}'::text[]), p.normalized_material_primary) AS material_detail,
            p.color,
            COALESCE((p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_color_primary_v2}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_color_primary}'::text[]), p.normalized_color_primary) AS color_detail,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'burning man'::text) THEN 'Burning Man'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(festival|rave|edm|edc|coachella|tomorrowland|club)'::text) THEN 'Festival/Rave'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(stage|performance|performer|dance|show|dj|burlesque|drag)'::text) THEN 'Stage/Performance'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(editorial|red carpet|fashion)'::text) THEN 'Fashion/Editorial/Red Carpet'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'cosplay'::text) THEN 'Cosplay'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS context_primary,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(cyberpunk|cyber)'::text) THEN 'Cyberpunk'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'futuristic'::text) THEN 'Futuristic'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(desert|dune|apocalyptic|mad max)'::text) THEN 'Desert/Apocalyptic'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(goth|gothic)'::text) THEN 'Goth'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'punk'::text) THEN 'Punk'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(glam|high fashion)'::text) THEN 'Glam/High Fashion'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS context_secondary,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'drag'::text) THEN 'drag queen'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'warrior'::text) THEN 'warrior'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'goddess'::text) THEN 'goddess'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'alien'::text) THEN 'alien'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'demon'::text) THEN 'demon'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'angel'::text) THEN 'angel'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ 'queen'::text) THEN 'queen'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS persona,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(men|mens|male)'::text) THEN 'male'::text
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text))) ~ '(women|womens|female)'::text) THEN 'female'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS gender,
            COALESCE((p.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts_v2,title_derivation,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts,title_derivation,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), (p.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,derived_product_facts,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb) AS components,
            lower(((((((((((((((((COALESCE(p.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.card_title, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.material, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.color, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.normalized_material_primary, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(p.normalized_color_primary, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.raw_ai_context)::text, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((p.safe_compact_payload_json)::text, ''::text))) AS product_text,
            p.keyword_metric_status,
            p.product_fact_quality_status,
            p.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            p.safe_generation_status,
            p.priority_order,
            now() AS evaluated_at
           FROM feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_safe_generation_queue_v1 p
        ), evidence_by_product AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(e.brief_queue_id, p.brief_queue_id) AS brief_queue_id,
            COALESCE(e.canonical_product_id, p.canonical_product_id) AS canonical_product_id,
            e.kw_universe_id,
            e.keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::integer AS evidence_count,
            max((e.axis_json ->> 'keyword_axis'::text)) AS keyword_axis,
            max((e.axis_json ->> 'keyword_pattern'::text)) AS keyword_pattern,
            max(e.target_page_level) AS suggested_page_level,
            bool_or((e.source_code = 'legacy_archive_v33'::text)) AS has_legacy_evidence,
            bool_or((e.source_type = 'metric_request'::text)) AS has_metric_request_evidence,
            jsonb_agg(DISTINCT e.source_code) AS source_codes_json
           FROM (feya_kw_universe_evidence_v1 e
             JOIN products p ON (((e.brief_queue_id = p.brief_queue_id) OR (e.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id))))
          GROUP BY COALESCE(e.brief_queue_id, p.brief_queue_id), COALESCE(e.canonical_product_id, p.canonical_product_id), e.kw_universe_id, e.keyword_norm
        ), latest_metrics AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm) feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.avg_monthly_searches,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition_index,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.data_freshness_status
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1
          ORDER BY feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm, feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id DESC
        ), metric_batch AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT feya_metric_request_batch_keywords_v1.keyword_norm
           FROM feya_metric_request_batch_keywords_v1
        ), base AS (
         SELECT p.brief_queue_id,
            p.canonical_product_id,
            p.product_slug,
            p.current_title,
            p.product_title,
            p.card_title,
            p.h1,
            p.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            p.source_listing_id,
            p.source_url,
            p.product_type,
            p.part,
            p.part_subtype,
            p.material,
            p.material_detail,
            p.color,
            p.color_detail,
            p.context_primary,
            p.context_secondary,
            p.persona,
            p.gender,
            p.components,
            p.product_text,
            p.keyword_metric_status,
            p.product_fact_quality_status,
            p.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            p.safe_generation_status,
            p.priority_order,
            p.evaluated_at,
            u.kw_universe_id AS keyword_id,
            u.keyword_text AS keyword,
            u.keyword_norm,
            ep.keyword_axis,
            ep.keyword_pattern,
            ep.suggested_page_level,
            ep.evidence_count,
            u.source_count,
            (lm.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_metric_snapshot,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'has_metric_snapshot'::text
                    WHEN ((mb.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) OR (u.metric_status = 'needs_metric_validation'::text)) THEN 'wait_for_metrics'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(ep.has_legacy_evidence, false) THEN 'seed_only_needs_validation'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(u.metric_status, 'unknown'::text)
                END AS resolved_metric_status,
            COALESCE(ep.source_codes_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS source_codes_json,
            lower(u.keyword_norm) AS kw,
            lower(COALESCE(p.part, ''::text)) AS part_l,
            lower(COALESCE(p.material_detail, ''::text)) AS material_l,
            lower(COALESCE(p.color_detail, ''::text)) AS color_l,
            lower(COALESCE(p.context_primary, ''::text)) AS context_l,
            lower(COALESCE(p.context_secondary, ''::text)) AS context_secondary_l,
            lower(COALESCE(p.persona, ''::text)) AS persona_l,
            lower(COALESCE((p.components)::text, ''::text)) AS components_l
           FROM ((((evidence_by_product ep
             JOIN products p ON (((p.brief_queue_id = ep.brief_queue_id) AND (p.canonical_product_id = ep.canonical_product_id))))
             JOIN feya_kw_universe_v1 u ON ((u.kw_universe_id = ep.kw_universe_id)))
             LEFT JOIN latest_metrics lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = u.keyword_norm)))
             LEFT JOIN metric_batch mb ON ((mb.keyword_norm = u.keyword_norm)))
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT b.brief_queue_id,
            b.canonical_product_id,
            b.product_slug,
            b.current_title,
            b.product_title,
            b.card_title,
            b.h1,
            b.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            b.source_listing_id,
            b.source_url,
            b.product_type,
            b.part,
            b.part_subtype,
            b.material,
            b.material_detail,
            b.color,
            b.color_detail,
            b.context_primary,
            b.context_secondary,
            b.persona,
            b.gender,
            b.components,
            b.product_text,
            b.keyword_metric_status,
            b.product_fact_quality_status,
            b.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            b.safe_generation_status,
            b.priority_order,
            b.evaluated_at,
            b.keyword_id,
            b.keyword,
            b.keyword_norm,
            b.keyword_axis,
            b.keyword_pattern,
            b.suggested_page_level,
            b.evidence_count,
            b.source_count,
            b.has_metric_snapshot,
            b.resolved_metric_status,
            b.source_codes_json,
            b.kw,
            b.part_l,
            b.material_l,
            b.color_l,
            b.context_l,
            b.context_secondary_l,
            b.persona_l,
            b.components_l,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])latex([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) AND (b.material_l !~ 'latex'::text)) THEN 'blocked_latex_not_product_truth'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(real leather|natural leather|genuine leather)'::text) THEN 'blocked_real_leather_claim'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(real metal|metal armor|metal armour)'::text) AND (b.material_l !~ '(metal|chrome)'::text)) THEN 'blocked_real_metal_claim'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(acrylic|mirror)'::text) AND (b.material_l !~ '(acrylic|mirror)'::text) AND (b.product_text !~ '(acrylic|mirror|breastplate|chest plate)'::text)) THEN 'blocked_acrylic_not_product_truth'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text) AND (b.part_l !~ '(headpiece)'::text) AND (b.components_l !~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text)) THEN 'blocked_headpiece_not_component'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])mask([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) AND (b.part_l !~ 'mask'::text) AND (b.components_l !~ 'mask'::text)) THEN 'blocked_mask_not_component'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(theatre|theater|opera|sports|cultural festival|seasonal peaks)'::text) THEN 'blocked_event_not_canon'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ 'warrior'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.persona_l, ''::text) <> 'warrior'::text) AND (b.product_text !~ 'warrior'::text)) THEN 'blocked_warrior_not_persona'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS blocked_reason,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'top'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(top|corset|bra top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'harness'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'harness'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'skirt'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'skirt'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'mask'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'mask'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'headpiece'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'bodysuit'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'bodysuit'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'dress'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'dress'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'shoulders'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(shoulder|shoulders)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'arms'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(arm|arms|glove|bracelet|bracer)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'legs'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(leg|legs|garter|garters)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.components_l ~ '(top|corset|skirt|mask|headpiece|crown|harness|shoulder|arm|leg|garter|glove|choker|belt|panties|bodysuit)'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(top|corset|skirt|mask|headpiece|crown|harness|shoulder|arm|leg|garter|glove|choker|belt|panties|bodysuit)'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS part_component_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ '(mirror acrylic|acrylic)'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(mirror|acrylic|reflective)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ 'vegan leather'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(vegan leather|leather|harness)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ 'fabric'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'fabric'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS material_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.color_l <> ''::text) AND (b.kw ~~ (('%'::text || b.color_l) || '%'::text))) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS color_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'burning man'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'burning man'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'festival/rave'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(festival|rave|edm|edc|coachella|tomorrowland|club)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'stage/performance'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(stage|performance|dance|drag|burlesque|show|dj)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'fashion/editorial/red carpet'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(fashion|editorial|red carpet)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'cosplay'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'cosplay'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS context_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.persona_l <> ''::text) AND (b.kw ~~ (('%'::text || b.persona_l) || '%'::text))) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS persona_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(outfit|costume|festival|rave|burning man|stage|performance|cosplay|drag|dance)'::text) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS collection_intent,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(gold|silver|black|white|red|holographic|mirror|acrylic|vegan leather|leather|metallic|futuristic|cyberpunk|goth|punk)'::text) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS image_alt_intent
           FROM base b
        ), final AS (
         SELECT s.brief_queue_id,
            s.canonical_product_id,
            s.product_slug,
            s.current_title,
            s.product_title,
            s.card_title,
            s.h1,
            s.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            s.source_listing_id,
            s.source_url,
            s.product_type,
            s.part,
            s.part_subtype,
            s.material,
            s.material_detail,
            s.color,
            s.color_detail,
            s.context_primary,
            s.context_secondary,
            s.persona,
            s.gender,
            s.components,
            s.product_text,
            s.keyword_metric_status,
            s.product_fact_quality_status,
            s.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            s.safe_generation_status,
            s.priority_order,
            s.evaluated_at,
            s.keyword_id,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.keyword_axis,
            s.keyword_pattern,
            s.suggested_page_level,
            s.evidence_count,
            s.source_count,
            s.has_metric_snapshot,
            s.resolved_metric_status,
            s.source_codes_json,
            s.kw,
            s.part_l,
            s.material_l,
            s.color_l,
            s.context_l,
            s.context_secondary_l,
            s.persona_l,
            s.components_l,
            s.blocked_reason,
            s.part_component_match,
            s.material_match,
            s.color_match,
            s.context_match,
            s.persona_match,
            s.collection_intent,
            s.image_alt_intent,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (s.part_component_match AND (s.material_match OR s.color_match OR s.context_match OR s.persona_match)) THEN 'strong_fit'::text
                    WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 'medium_fit'::text
                    WHEN (s.collection_intent AND s.context_match) THEN 'collection_fit'::text
                    WHEN (s.image_alt_intent AND (s.material_match OR s.color_match)) THEN 'image_alt_fit'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_review'::text
                END AS fit_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 0
                    ELSE ((((((
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 40
                        ELSE 0
                    END +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.material_match THEN 15
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.color_match THEN 15
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.context_match THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.persona_match THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) + LEAST(15, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(s.evidence_count, 0)))) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) THEN '-10'::integer
                        WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text) THEN '-5'::integer
                        ELSE 0
                    END)
                END AS fit_score_pre_metric,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'none'::text
                    WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 'product'::text
                    WHEN s.collection_intent THEN 'collection'::text
                    WHEN s.image_alt_intent THEN 'image_alt'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(s.suggested_page_level, 'needs_review'::text)
                END AS page_level_recommendation,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text])) THEN 'needs_fact_review'::text
                    ELSE 'compatible_candidate'::text
                END AS compatibility_status,
            ((s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (s.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text]))) AS needs_human_review
           FROM scored s
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    product_slug,
    product_title,
    h1,
    card_title,
    source_listing_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_type,
    part,
    part_subtype,
    material,
    material_detail,
    color_detail AS color,
    context_primary,
    context_secondary,
    persona,
    gender,
    components,
    NULL::text AS page_goal,
    keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    evidence_count,
    source_count,
    has_metric_snapshot,
    resolved_metric_status AS metric_status,
    fit_status,
    fit_score_pre_metric,
    page_level_recommendation,
    compatibility_status,
    blocked_reason,
    needs_human_review,
    jsonb_build_object('part_component_match', part_component_match, 'material_match', material_match, 'color_match', color_match, 'context_match', context_match, 'persona_match', persona_match, 'collection_intent', collection_intent, 'image_alt_intent', image_alt_intent, 'product_fact_quality_status', product_fact_quality_status, 'formula', 'part_component +40, material +15, color +15, context +10, persona +10, evidence up to +15, fact warning -5/-10, blocked=0') AS fit_reason,
    evaluated_at
   FROM final;

WITH product_extra AS (

            (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part_v2}'::text[]) AS final_primary_part_v2,
            (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_material_primary_v2}'::text[]) AS final_material_primary_v2,
            (q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_color_primary_v2}'::text[]) AS final_color_primary_v2,
            lower(((COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part_v2}'::text[]), ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #>> '{product_facts,final_primary_part}'::text[]), ''::text))) AS final_primary_part_text,
            lower((((COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts_v2,title_derivation,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,derived_product_facts,derived_component_tags}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text)) AS derived_component_text,
            lower(((COALESCE((q.public_configurations_json)::text, ''::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE((q.safe_compact_payload_json #> '{product_facts,final_product_facts_v2,configuration_derivation,public_config_components}'::text[]), '[]'::jsonb))::text)) AS configuration_component_text,
            lower(((((COALESCE(q.current_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(q.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(q.card_title, ''::text))) AS title_text,
            d.do_not_publish_flag,
            d.publish_status,
            d.readiness_status AS detail_readiness_status
           FROM ((feya_commerce_v_product_seo_brief_safe_generation_queue_v1 q
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_step7_storefront_products_api s ON ((s.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_step6_product_builder_detail d ON ((d.canonical_product_id = q.canonical_product_id)))
        ), broad_keywords AS (
         SELECT feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_norm,
            (count(DISTINCT feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.canonical_product_id))::integer AS v1_nonblocked_product_count
           FROM feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1
          WHERE (feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.fit_status <> 'blocked'::text)
          GROUP BY feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1.keyword_norm
        ), base AS (
         SELECT v1.canonical_product_id,
            v1.product_slug,
            v1.product_title,

            COALESCE(pe.product_slug, v1.product_slug) AS product_slug_v2,

            COALESCE(bk.v1_nonblocked_product_count, 0) AS v1_nonblocked_product_count,
            lower(COALESCE(v1.keyword_norm, ''::text)) AS kw
           FROM ((feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v1 v1
             LEFT JOIN product_extra pe ON ((pe.canonical_product_id = v1.canonical_product_id)))
             LEFT JOIN broad_keywords bk ON ((bk.keyword_norm = v1.keyword_norm)))
        ), detected AS (
         SELECT b.canonical_product_id,

                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(garter|garters)'::text) THEN 'garters'::text

                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(headpiece|headdress)'::text) THEN 'headpiece'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(crown)'::text) THEN 'crown'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])mask([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) THEN 'mask'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(shoulder|shoulders)'::text) THEN 'shoulders'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(arm cuff|arm cuffs|armour arms|armor arms|arm covers|arms)'::text) THEN 'arms'::text

                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(glove|gloves)'::text) THEN 'gloves'::text

                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(harness)'::text) THEN 'harness'::text

                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])bra([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) THEN 'bra'::text

                    WHEN ((COALESCE(((b.fit_reason ->> 'material_match'::text))::boolean, false) = true) AND (COALESCE(((b.fit_reason ->> 'part_component_match'::text))::boolean, false) = false)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS material_only_match_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(((((COALESCE(b.product_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(b.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(b.card_title, ''::text))) ~ '(digital download|ai try on|preview from your photo|photo \+ 5 sec video|photo \+ video|video preview|individual sizes|delivery for|shipping|service item)'::text) THEN true
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b.do_not_publish_flag, false) = true) THEN true
                    WHEN (lower(((COALESCE(b.detail_readiness_status, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(b.publish_status, ''::text))) ~ '(storefront_excluded|do_not_publish)'::text) THEN true

        ), component_eval AS (

            d.material_only_match_flag,
            d.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            (d.keyword_component_detected IS NOT NULL) AS component_required_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN (d.keyword_component_detected IS NULL) THEN false
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'panties'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'panties'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'panties'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'panties'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'leg_covers'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(leg|legs)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(leg|legs)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(leg|legs)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'garters'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(garter|leg)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(garter|leg)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(garter|leg)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = ANY (ARRAY['open_skirt'::text, 'skirt'::text])) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'skirt'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'skirt'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'skirt'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'choker'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'choker'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'choker'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'choker'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'collar'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(collar|choker)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(collar|choker)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(collar|choker)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = ANY (ARRAY['headpiece'::text, 'crown'::text])) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'mask'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'mask'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'mask'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'mask'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'shoulders'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'shoulder'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'shoulder'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'shoulder'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = ANY (ARRAY['arms'::text, 'sleeves'::text, 'gloves'::text])) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(arm|arms|sleeve|glove|bracer)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(arm|arms|sleeve|glove|bracer)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(arm|arms|sleeve|glove|bracer)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'wings'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'wing'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'wing'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'wing'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'tail'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'tail'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'tail'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'tail'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'spine'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'spine'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'spine'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'spine'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'harness'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'harness'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'harness'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'harness'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'corset'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(corset|top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(corset|top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(corset|top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = ANY (ARRAY['top'::text, 'bra'::text])) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ '(top|bra|corset|breastplate|chest plate)'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ '(top|bra|corset|breastplate|chest plate)'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ '(top|bra|corset|breastplate|chest plate)'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'bodysuit'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'bodysuit'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'bodysuit'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'bodysuit'::text))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'dress'::text) AND ((d.final_primary_part_text ~ 'dress'::text) OR (d.derived_component_text ~ 'dress'::text) OR (d.configuration_component_text ~ 'dress'::text))) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS component_confirmed_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected IS NOT NULL) AND (d.title_text ~ d.keyword_component_detected)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'leg_covers'::text) AND (d.title_text ~ '(leg|legs)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = 'garters'::text) AND (d.title_text ~ '(garter|leg)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((d.keyword_component_detected = ANY (ARRAY['open_skirt'::text, 'skirt'::text])) AND (d.title_text ~ 'skirt'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS title_component_hint_flag
           FROM detected d
        ), final AS (
         SELECT c.canonical_product_id,
            c.product_slug,
            c.product_title,
            c.h1,
            c.card_title,
            c.source_listing_id,
            c.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            c.product_type,
            c.part,
            c.part_subtype,
            c.material,
            c.material_detail,
            c.color,
            c.context_primary,
            c.context_secondary,
            c.persona,
            c.gender,
            c.components,
            c.page_goal,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.evidence_count,
            c.source_count,
            c.has_metric_snapshot,
            c.metric_status,
            c.fit_status,
            c.fit_score_pre_metric,
            c.page_level_recommendation,
            c.compatibility_status,
            c.blocked_reason,
            c.needs_human_review,
            c.fit_reason,
            c.evaluated_at,
            c.fit_status_v1,
            c.fit_score_pre_metric_v1,
            c.product_slug_v2,
            c.safe_compact_payload_json,
            c.public_configurations_json,
            c.product_fact_quality_status,
            c.final_product_type_v2,
            c.final_primary_part,
            c.final_material_primary,
            c.final_color_primary,
            c.final_primary_part_text,
            c.derived_component_text,
            c.configuration_component_text,
            c.title_text,
            c.do_not_publish_flag,
            c.publish_status,
            c.detail_readiness_status,
            c.v1_nonblocked_product_count,
            c.kw,
            c.keyword_component_detected,
            c.broad_collection_term_flag,
            c.too_broad_keyword_flag,
            c.supporting_only_flag,
            c.material_only_match_flag,
            c.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            c.component_required_flag,
            c.component_confirmed_flag,
            c.title_component_hint_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.product_not_seo_target_flag THEN 'blocked_product_not_seo_target'::text
                    WHEN (c.component_required_flag AND (NOT c.component_confirmed_flag)) THEN (('blocked_'::text || c.keyword_component_detected) || '_not_component'::text)
                    WHEN (c.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN c.blocked_reason
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS blocked_reason_v2,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.product_not_seo_target_flag THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (c.component_required_flag AND (NOT c.component_confirmed_flag)) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (c.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (c.component_confirmed_flag AND (NOT c.too_broad_keyword_flag) AND (NOT c.supporting_only_flag) AND (NOT c.broad_collection_term_flag) AND (NOT c.material_only_match_flag) AND (c.fit_status_v1 = ANY (ARRAY['strong_fit'::text, 'medium_fit'::text]))) THEN 'strong_fit'::text
                    WHEN (c.component_confirmed_flag AND (c.too_broad_keyword_flag OR c.supporting_only_flag OR c.broad_collection_term_flag)) THEN 'medium_fit'::text
                    WHEN c.broad_collection_term_flag THEN 'collection_fit'::text
                    WHEN c.material_only_match_flag THEN 'needs_review'::text
                    WHEN (c.fit_status_v1 = 'image_alt_fit'::text) THEN 'image_alt_fit'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_review'::text
                END AS fit_status_v2,
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.product_not_seo_target_flag OR (c.component_required_flag AND (NOT c.component_confirmed_flag)) OR (c.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL)) THEN 0
                    ELSE (((((((((
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.component_confirmed_flag THEN 40
                        ELSE 0
                    END +
                    CASE
                        WHEN (c.component_required_flag AND c.component_confirmed_flag) THEN 30
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(((c.fit_reason ->> 'material_match'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 15
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(((c.fit_reason ->> 'color_match'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(((c.fit_reason ->> 'context_match'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(((c.fit_reason ->> 'persona_match'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END) + LEAST(15, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(c.evidence_count, 0)))) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.has_metric_snapshot THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END) -
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.too_broad_keyword_flag THEN 20
                        ELSE 0
                    END) -
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.supporting_only_flag THEN 20
                        ELSE 0
                    END)
                END AS fit_score_pre_metric_v2
           FROM component_eval c
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    COALESCE(product_slug_v2, product_slug) AS product_slug,
    product_title,
    h1,
    card_title,
    source_listing_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_type,
    final_product_type_v2,
    final_primary_part AS part,
    part_subtype,
    material,
    final_material_primary AS material_detail,
    final_color_primary AS color,
    context_primary,
    context_secondary,
    persona,
    gender,
    components,
    page_goal,
    keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    evidence_count,
    source_count,
    has_metric_snapshot,
    metric_status,
    fit_status_v1,
    fit_status_v2,
    fit_score_pre_metric_v1,
    fit_score_pre_metric_v2,
    component_required_flag,
    keyword_component_detected,
    component_confirmed_flag,
    material_only_match_flag,
    supporting_only_flag,
    too_broad_keyword_flag,
    product_not_seo_target_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = 'blocked'::text) THEN COALESCE(blocked_reason_v2, 'blocked'::text)
            WHEN (product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text])) THEN 'needs_fact_review'::text
            ELSE 'compatible_candidate'::text
        END AS compatibility_status_v2,
    blocked_reason_v2,
    jsonb_build_object('component_required', component_required_flag, 'keyword_component_detected', keyword_component_detected, 'component_confirmed_strict', component_confirmed_flag, 'title_component_hint_only', title_component_hint_flag, 'too_broad_keyword_product_count', v1_nonblocked_product_count, 'supporting_only', supporting_only_flag, 'material_only_match', material_only_match_flag, 'product_not_seo_target', product_not_seo_target_flag, 'formula', 'exact component +40, confirmed component +30, material +15, color +10, context +10, persona +5, evidence up to +15, metric snapshot +5, too broad -20, supporting-only -20, blocked=0') AS fit_reason_v2,
        CASE
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = 'blocked'::text) THEN 'do_not_insert'::text
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = ANY (ARRAY['needs_review'::text, 'medium_fit'::text])) THEN 'human_review_before_insert'::text
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = 'collection_fit'::text) THEN 'consider_collection_page_not_product_primary'::text
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = 'image_alt_fit'::text) THEN 'use_for_image_alt_not_primary'::text
            WHEN (fit_status_v2 = 'strong_fit'::text) THEN 'candidate_for_next_insert_review'::text
            ELSE 'review'::text
        END AS recommended_next_action,
    evaluated_at
   FROM final;

relations.name: feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v3
relations.definition:
WITH generated_counts AS (
         SELECT feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1.generated_keyword_norm,
            (count(DISTINCT feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1.canonical_product_id))::integer AS generated_product_count
           FROM feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1
          GROUP BY feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1.generated_keyword_norm
        ), v2_rows AS (
         SELECT 'existing_v2'::text AS candidate_source,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.canonical_product_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.product_slug,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.product_title,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.h1,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.card_title,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.product_type,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.final_product_type_v2,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.part AS final_primary_part,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.part,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.material,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.material_detail,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.color,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.context_primary,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.context_secondary,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.persona,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.gender,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword_norm,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword_axis,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword_pattern,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.suggested_page_level,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.evidence_count,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.source_count,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.has_metric_snapshot,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.metric_status,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.fit_status_v2 AS fit_status_v3,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.compatibility_status_v2 AS compatibility_status_v3,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.fit_score_pre_metric_v2 AS fit_score_pre_metric_v3,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.component_required_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.keyword_component_detected,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.component_confirmed_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.material_only_match_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.supporting_only_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.too_broad_keyword_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.blocked_reason_v2 AS blocked_reason_v3,
            NULL::text AS pattern_code,
            true AS already_in_keyword_universe,
                CASE
                    WHEN feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.has_metric_snapshot THEN 'metric_validated'::text
                    WHEN (feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.metric_status = 'wait_for_metrics'::text) THEN 'wait_for_metrics'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_metric_validation'::text
                END AS metric_lane,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.fit_reason_v2 AS fit_reason_v3,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.recommended_next_action,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2.evaluated_at
           FROM feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2
        ), gen_rows AS (
         SELECT 'generated_product_fact'::text AS candidate_source,
            g.canonical_product_id,
            g.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            g.product_slug,
            g.product_title,
            g.h1,
            g.card_title,
            g.product_type,
            NULL::text AS final_product_type_v2,
            g.final_primary_part,
            g.part,
            NULL::text AS material,
            g.material_detail,
            g.color,
            g.context_primary,
            g.context_secondary,
            g.persona,
            NULL::text AS gender,
            g.keyword_id,
            g.generated_keyword AS keyword,
            g.generated_keyword_norm AS keyword_norm,
            NULL::text AS keyword_axis,
            g.pattern_code AS keyword_pattern,
            g.generated_page_level AS suggested_page_level,
            1 AS evidence_count,
            1 AS source_count,
            g.has_metric_snapshot,
            g.metric_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.needs_human_review AND (g.pattern_code = ANY (ARRAY['bundle_look'::text, 'component_pair'::text, 'style_part'::text]))) THEN 'medium_fit'::text
                    ELSE 'strong_fit'::text
                END AS fit_status_v3,
                CASE
                    WHEN g.needs_human_review THEN 'needs_fact_review'::text
                    ELSE 'compatible_candidate'::text
                END AS compatibility_status_v3,
            (((
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'color_material_part'::text) THEN 85
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'material_part'::text) THEN 75
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'color_part'::text) THEN 70
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'visual_effect_part'::text) THEN 65
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'context_part'::text) THEN 60
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'style_part'::text) THEN 55
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'component_pair'::text) THEN 50
                    WHEN (g.pattern_code = 'bundle_look'::text) THEN 45
                    ELSE 40
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN g.has_metric_snapshot THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END) -
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(gc.generated_product_count, 0) > 50) THEN 20
                    ELSE 0
                END))::numeric AS fit_score_pre_metric_v3,
            true AS component_required_flag,
            g.part AS keyword_component_detected,
            true AS component_confirmed_flag,
            false AS material_only_match_flag,
            false AS supporting_only_flag,
            (COALESCE(gc.generated_product_count, 0) > 50) AS too_broad_keyword_flag,
            g.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            NULL::text AS blocked_reason_v3,
            g.pattern_code,
            g.already_in_keyword_universe,
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.already_in_keyword_universe = false) THEN 'not_in_universe_yet'::text
                    WHEN g.has_metric_snapshot THEN 'metric_validated'::text
                    WHEN (g.metric_status = 'wait_for_metrics'::text) THEN 'wait_for_metrics'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_metric_validation'::text
                END AS metric_lane,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'deterministic_product_fact_expansion', 'pattern_code', g.pattern_code, 'expansion_reason', g.expansion_reason, 'component_source', g.component_source, 'material_source', g.material_source, 'context_source', g.context_source, 'already_in_keyword_universe', g.already_in_keyword_universe, 'generated_product_count', COALESCE(gc.generated_product_count, 0)) AS fit_reason_v3,
                CASE
                    WHEN (g.already_in_keyword_universe = false) THEN 'not_insert_ready_until_universe_seeded'::text
                    WHEN g.needs_human_review THEN 'human_review_before_insert'::text
                    ELSE 'candidate_for_insert_preview'::text
                END AS recommended_next_action,
            now() AS evaluated_at
           FROM (feya_v_kw_product_fact_expansion_candidates_v1 g
             LEFT JOIN generated_counts gc ON ((gc.generated_keyword_norm = g.generated_keyword_norm)))
        )
 SELECT v2_rows.candidate_source,

relations.name: feya_v_kw_product_fit_insert_preview_summary_v1
relations.definition:
WITH p AS (
         SELECT feya_v_kw_product_fit_insert_preview_v1.canonical_product_id,
            feya_v_kw_product_fit_insert_preview_v1.matched_etsy_listing_id,

relations.definition:
WITH filtered AS (
         SELECT v2.canonical_product_id,

            v2.card_title,

            v2.keyword_id,
            v2.keyword,
            v2.keyword_norm,
            v2.keyword_axis,
            v2.keyword_pattern,
            v2.suggested_page_level,
            v2.evidence_count,
            v2.source_count,
            v2.has_metric_snapshot,
            v2.metric_status,
            v2.fit_status_v1,
            v2.fit_status_v2,
            v2.fit_score_pre_metric_v1,
            v2.fit_score_pre_metric_v2,
            v2.component_required_flag,
            v2.keyword_component_detected,
            v2.component_confirmed_flag,
            v2.material_only_match_flag,
            v2.supporting_only_flag,
            v2.too_broad_keyword_flag,
            v2.product_not_seo_target_flag,
            v2.compatibility_status_v2,
            v2.blocked_reason_v2,
            v2.fit_reason_v2,
            v2.recommended_next_action,
            v2.evaluated_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN v2.has_metric_snapshot THEN 'metric_validated'::text
                    WHEN (v2.metric_status = 'wait_for_metrics'::text) THEN 'wait_for_metrics'::text
                    ELSE 'seed_only_needs_validation'::text
                END AS metric_lane,
            GREATEST(1, cardinality(regexp_split_to_array(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(v2.keyword_norm, ''::text)), '\s+'::text))) AS keyword_word_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((v2.fit_status_v2 = 'image_alt_fit'::text) OR (v2.suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS image_alt_like_flag
           FROM feya_v_kw_product_fit_candidates_v2 v2
          WHERE ((v2.fit_status_v2 = 'strong_fit'::text) AND (v2.compatibility_status_v2 = 'compatible_candidate'::text) AND (COALESCE(v2.too_broad_keyword_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(v2.supporting_only_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(v2.product_not_seo_target_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(v2.component_confirmed_flag, false) = true) AND ((COALESCE(v2.component_required_flag, false) = false) OR (COALESCE(v2.component_confirmed_flag, false) = true)) AND (v2.blocked_reason_v2 IS NULL) AND (lower(((((COALESCE(v2.product_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(v2.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(v2.card_title, ''::text))) !~ '(digital download|ai try on|preview from your photo|photo \+ 5 sec video|photo \+ video|video preview|individual sizes|delivery for|shipping|service item|sampler|probnik)'::text))
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT f.canonical_product_id,
            f.product_slug,
            f.product_title,
            f.h1,
            f.card_title,
            f.source_listing_id,
            f.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            f.product_type,
            f.final_product_type_v2,
            f.part,
            f.part_subtype,
            f.material,
            f.material_detail,
            f.color,
            f.context_primary,
            f.context_secondary,
            f.persona,
            f.gender,
            f.components,
            f.page_goal,
            f.keyword_id,

          WHERE ((v3.fit_status_v3 = 'strong_fit'::text) AND (v3.compatibility_status_v3 = ANY (ARRAY['compatible_candidate'::text, 'needs_fact_review'::text])) AND (COALESCE(v3.product_not_seo_target_flag, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(v3.component_confirmed_flag, false) = true) AND (v3.blocked_reason_v3 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE(v3.supporting_only_flag, false) = false))
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT c.candidate_source,
            c.canonical_product_id,
            c.matched_etsy_listing_id,

            r.keyword_word_count,
            r.candidate_rank_for_product,
                CASE
                    WHEN (r.candidate_rank_for_product = 1) THEN 'primary_candidate'::text
                    WHEN ((r.candidate_rank_for_product >= 2) AND (r.candidate_rank_for_product <= 5)) THEN 'secondary_candidate'::text
                    WHEN ((r.candidate_rank_for_product >= 6) AND (r.candidate_rank_for_product <= 10)) THEN 'semantic_support_candidate'::text
                    ELSE 'overflow_not_for_insert_yet'::text
                END AS recommended_keyword_role
           FROM ranked r
        ), eligibility AS (
         SELECT roles.candidate_source,

            roles.recommended_keyword_role,
            ((roles.candidate_rank_for_product <= 10) AND (roles.recommended_keyword_role = ANY (ARRAY['primary_candidate'::text, 'secondary_candidate'::text, 'semantic_support_candidate'::text])) AND (roles.already_in_keyword_universe = true) AND (roles.metric_lane <> 'not_in_universe_yet'::text) AND (roles.compatibility_status_v3 = 'compatible_candidate'::text) AND (COALESCE(roles.too_broad_keyword_flag, false) = false)) AS insert_eligible_flag
           FROM roles
        ), product_readiness AS (

            WHEN ((COALESCE(pr.insert_eligible_count, 0) < 3) AND (COALESCE(pr.not_in_universe_count, 0) > 0)) THEN 'needs_universe_seed_and_more_keywords'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(pr.insert_eligible_count, 0) < 3) THEN 'needs_more_keywords'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(pr.metric_validated_primary_count, 0) >= 1) THEN 'ready_for_metric_validated_draft'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pr.wait_for_metrics_count, 0) >= 1) AND (COALESCE(pr.metric_validated_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 'ready_for_wait_metrics_draft'::text
            ELSE 'needs_more_keywords'::text
        END AS seo_pack_readiness_status,
    e.component_required_flag,
    e.keyword_component_detected,
    e.component_confirmed_flag,
    e.material_only_match_flag,
    e.supporting_only_flag,
    e.too_broad_keyword_flag,
    e.product_not_seo_target_flag,

            WHEN (e.already_in_keyword_universe = false) THEN 'not_insert_ready_until_universe_seeded'::text
            WHEN e.insert_eligible_flag THEN 'eligible_for_future_fit_insert'::text
            WHEN (e.candidate_rank_for_product > 10) THEN 'overflow_not_for_insert_yet'::text
            WHEN (e.compatibility_status_v3 <> 'compatible_candidate'::text) THEN 'human_review_before_insert'::text
            ELSE e.recommended_next_action
        END AS recommended_next_action,

   FROM (eligibility e
     LEFT JOIN product_readiness pr USING (canonical_product_id));

relations.name: feya_v_manual_keyword_metric_export_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_norm,
    min(keyword_text) AS keyword_text,
    suggested_page_level,
    metrics_status,
    candidate_status,
    candidate_source,
    (count(*))::integer AS product_candidate_count,
    (count(DISTINCT canonical_product_id))::integer AS affected_product_count,
    array_agg(DISTINCT reason_code) AS reason_codes,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('manual_keyword_candidate_id', manual_keyword_candidate_id, 'brief_queue_id', brief_queue_id, 'canonical_product_id', canonical_product_id, 'source_kw_plan_v2_id', source_kw_plan_v2_id, 'reason_code', reason_code, 'axis', axis_json) ORDER BY created_at) AS evidence_json
   FROM feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1
  WHERE ((candidate_status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'queued'::text, 'approved'::text])) AND (metrics_status = 'needs_metric_import'::text))
  GROUP BY keyword_norm, suggested_page_level, metrics_status, candidate_status, candidate_source
  ORDER BY ((count(DISTINCT canonical_product_id))::integer) DESC, keyword_norm;

    c.metrics_status,
    c.reason_code,
    c.axis_json,
    m.import_row_id,
    m.batch_code,
    m.geo,
    m.language,
    m.avg_monthly_searches,
    m.competition,
    m.competition_index,
    m.low_top_of_page_bid,
    m.high_top_of_page_bid,
    m.imported_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.import_row_id IS NULL) THEN 'NO_IMPORTED_METRIC'::text
            ELSE 'HAS_IMPORTED_METRIC'::text
        END AS metric_match_status
   FROM (feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1 c
     LEFT JOIN latest_metric m ON ((m.keyword_norm = c.keyword_norm)));

relations.name: feya_v_metric_export_center_keywords_only_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (keyword_norm) keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    suggested_batch_code,
    geo,
    language,
    export_priority,
    source_type,
    affected_product_count
   FROM feya_v_metric_export_center_v1
  WHERE ((export_status = 'NEEDS_EXPORT'::text) AND (keyword IS NOT NULL))
  ORDER BY keyword_norm, export_priority, affected_product_count DESC, source_type;

relations.name: feya_v_metric_export_center_sum_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT source_type,
    export_status,
    metrics_status,
    suggested_page_level,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count,
    (count(DISTINCT keyword_norm))::integer AS unique_keyword_count,
    (sum(COALESCE(affected_product_count, 0)))::integer AS total_affected_product_refs,
    min(export_priority) AS best_export_priority
   FROM feya_v_metric_export_center_v1
  GROUP BY source_type, export_status, metrics_status, suggested_page_level
  ORDER BY (min(export_priority)), source_type, export_status;

relations.name: feya_v_metric_export_center_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'core_keyword_pool'::text AS source_type,
    (e.keyword_id)::text AS source_ref_id,
    e.keyword,
    e.keyword_norm,
    e.suggested_page_level,
    e.keyword_axis,
    e.keyword_pattern,
    e.geo,
    e.language,
    e.suggested_batch_code,
    e.metric_validation_status AS metrics_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (e.metric_validation_status = 'needs_metric_import'::text) THEN 'NEEDS_EXPORT'::text
            WHEN (e.metric_validation_status = ANY (ARRAY['has_fresh_metrics'::text, 'has_metric_import'::text])) THEN 'HAS_METRICS'::text
            ELSE 'CHECK_STATUS'::text
        END AS export_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (e.metric_validation_status = 'needs_metric_import'::text) THEN 20
            ELSE 80
        END AS export_priority,
    1 AS affected_product_count,
    jsonb_build_object('keyword_id', e.keyword_id, 'keyword_axis', e.keyword_axis, 'keyword_pattern', e.keyword_pattern, 'suggested_page_level', e.suggested_page_level, 'should_use_for_product', e.should_use_for_product, 'should_use_for_collection', e.should_use_for_collection, 'should_use_for_image_alt', e.should_use_for_image_alt) AS evidence_json
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_export_google_ads_v1 e
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'manual_missing_primary'::text AS source_type,
    NULL::text AS source_ref_id,
    m.keyword_text AS keyword,
    m.keyword_norm,
    m.suggested_page_level,
    'manual_missing_primary'::text AS keyword_axis,
    NULL::text AS keyword_pattern,
    'US'::text AS geo,
    'en'::text AS language,
    ('manual_keywords_'::text || to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD'::text)) AS suggested_batch_code,
    m.metrics_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.metrics_status = 'needs_metric_import'::text) THEN 'NEEDS_EXPORT'::text
            WHEN (m.metrics_status = 'has_metric_import'::text) THEN 'HAS_METRICS'::text
            ELSE 'CHECK_STATUS'::text
        END AS export_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.reason_codes @> ARRAY['NO_SAFE_PRIMARY_IN_KEYWORD_POOL'::text]) THEN 10
            WHEN (m.metrics_status = 'needs_metric_import'::text) THEN 15
            ELSE 80
        END AS export_priority,
    m.affected_product_count,
    m.evidence_json
   FROM feya_v_manual_keyword_metric_export_v1 m;

relations.name: feya_v_metric_import_center_status_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'combined_export_keywords'::text AS section,
    'NEEDS_EXPORT'::text AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_v_metric_export_center_keywords_only_v1
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'manual_candidates'::text AS section,
    feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1.metrics_status AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1
  GROUP BY feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1.metrics_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'keyword_plans_v2'::text AS section,
    feya_kw_place_plan_v2.plan_status AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_kw_place_plan_v2
  GROUP BY feya_kw_place_plan_v2.plan_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_staging'::text AS section,
    COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'unknown'::text) AS status,
    (count(*))::integer AS rows_count
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1
  GROUP BY COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'unknown'::text)
  ORDER BY 1, 2;

relations.name: feya_v_metric_next_action_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'connect_google_ads_api'::text AS action_code,
    'Подключить Google Ads API, чтобы не работать вручную через CSV.'::text AS action_ru,
    'HIGH'::text AS priority,
    feya_metric_provider_config_v1.provider_code,
    feya_metric_provider_config_v1.connection_status,
    feya_metric_provider_config_v1.required_credentials_json AS details_json
   FROM feya_metric_provider_config_v1
  WHERE ((feya_metric_provider_config_v1.provider_code = 'google_ads_api'::text) AND (feya_metric_provider_config_v1.connection_status <> 'connected'::text))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'export_metric_keywords'::text AS action_code,
    'Создать или использовать batch ключей для проверки метрик.'::text AS action_ru,
    'MEDIUM'::text AS priority,
    NULL::text AS provider_code,
    'NEEDS_EXPORT'::text AS connection_status,
    jsonb_build_object('keywords_to_export', count(*)) AS details_json
   FROM feya_v_metric_export_center_keywords_only_v1 e
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (feya_metric_request_batch_keywords_v1 bk
             JOIN feya_metric_request_batch_v1 b ON ((b.metric_batch_id = bk.metric_batch_id)))
          WHERE ((bk.keyword_norm = e.keyword_norm) AND (b.batch_status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'applied'::text]))))))
 HAVING (count(*) > 0);

relations.name: feya_v_strategy_product_candidates_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT r.brief_queue_id,
    r.canonical_product_id,
    r.current_title,
    r.generation_gate_status,
    r.final_primary_part,
    r.final_product_type,
    r.final_material_primary,
    r.final_color_primary,
    s.strategy_code,
    s.strategy_name_ru,
    s.strategy_name_en,
    s.strategy_group,
    s.target_page_level,
    s.intent_type,
    s.strategy_description_ru,
    s.priority AS strategy_priority,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'balanced_product'::text) THEN 80
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'long_tail_conversion'::text) THEN 65
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'image_seo'::text) THEN 60
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'collection_growth'::text) THEN 50
            WHEN ((s.include_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(COALESCE(r.current_title, ''::text)) ~ s.include_regex)) THEN 85
            WHEN ((s.include_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(((((((COALESCE(r.final_product_type, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_primary_part, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_material_primary, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_color_primary, ''::text))) ~ s.include_regex)) THEN 70
            ELSE 25
        END AS strategy_match_score,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'balanced_product'::text) THEN 'DEFAULT_SAFE_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'long_tail_conversion'::text) THEN 'LONG_TAIL_TESTABLE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'image_seo'::text) THEN 'IMAGE_SEO_SUPPORT'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.strategy_code = 'collection_growth'::text) THEN 'COLLECTION_SIGNAL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((s.include_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(COALESCE(r.current_title, ''::text)) ~ s.include_regex)) THEN 'TITLE_MATCHES_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((s.include_regex IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(((((((COALESCE(r.final_product_type, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_primary_part, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_material_primary, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(r.final_color_primary, ''::text))) ~ s.include_regex)) THEN 'FACTS_MATCH_STRATEGY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.final_color_primary IS NULL) THEN 'COLOR_CAUTION'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.generation_gate_status = 'READY_STRICT_GUARDRAILS'::text) THEN 'STRICT_FACT_GUARDRAILS'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS strategy_evidence_codes
   FROM (feya_v_brief_ready_to_generate_v1 r
     CROSS JOIN feya_seo_strategy_profiles_v1 s)
  WHERE (s.active_flag IS TRUE);

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_commerce_slugify(input_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    nullif(
      btrim(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            lower(coalesce(input_text, '')),
            '[^a-z0-9]+',
            '-',
            'g'
          ),
          '(^-+|-+$)',
          '',
          'g'
        ),
        '-'
      ),
      ''
    ),
    'product'
  );
$function$
